items.title_zh: 瑞典长读基因组测序的国家生态系统
items.summary_zh: 为了评估长读基因组测序（lrGS）的临床应用并建立支持其在诊断中使用的人口参考资源，我们整合了两个互补的项目：瑞典基因组（GoS）和瑞典基因组医学-罕见疾病（GMS-RD）长读测序试点。GoS首次发布了576个个体的数据，提供了人口规模的遗传和表观遗传变异图谱。在485名GMS-RD的样本中，161名（33.2%）获得了分子诊断，其中lrGS在40名（24.8%）中提供了额外的临床价值。作为一线检测，lrGS可以避免至少42次后续分析，并在7.2%的样本中减少额外的检测周期，从而降低成本和患者负担。通过整合人口和临床长读基因组学，瑞典建立了一个国家级的基因组研究和临床诊断生态系统。我们的研究结果支持lrGS的临床实施，并为国家合作提供了可扩展的模型。

items.title: NESTApp: A GUI-Based MATLAB Application for Auditable TMS-EEG Preprocessing with EEGLAB
items.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) preprocessing determines signal quality and interpretation, particularly for transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with EEG (TMS-EEG), where recordings are affected by large and complex stimulation-related artifacts. Several preprocessing approaches have been developed, but substantial variability remains in how pipelines are implemented, documented, and evaluated across recordings, limiting reproducibility and comparability across studies. We developed NESTApp, a MATLAB-based graphical interface built on EEGLAB, to provide an accessible and reproducible framework for implementing and evaluating TMS-EEG preprocessing pipelines. Rather than prescribing a specific pipeline, NESTApp allows users to construct and consistently apply customisable workflows incorporating established EEGLAB and TMS-EEG processing tools, while automatically documenting processing decisions and parameters. Integrated quality-control procedures track data removal and flag recordings based on user-defined criteria, facilitating systematic evaluation across participants. The application also supports group-level visualisation and export of processed TMS-EEG measures for subsequent analyses. Applied to 29 recordings from 16 participants, NESTApp processed 27 and identified those requiring further inspection. By integrating pipeline implementation, documentation, quality control, and group-level evaluation within a single interface, NESTApp provides a transparent framework for TMS-EEG preprocessing that may improve reproducibility, facilitate consistent processing across cohorts, and lower technical barriers to the implementation of established preprocessing approaches.
items.authors: Pariz, A.; Dunne, W.; Lefebvre, J.; Tremblay, S.

items.title: Development and Evaluation of an Offline Vision-Language Model System for Estimating Nutrients from Meal Photographs on Personal Devices: The PLANS (Personal-device Local Assessment of Nutrients System) Study
items.abstract: Background: Estimating nutrient intake from meal photographs with vision-language models (VLMs) is now practical, but patient photographs often cannot leave the institution. We developed PLANS (Personal-device Local Assessment of Nutrients System), in which a small open VLM runs entirely on a personal device. Methods: Open VLMs were compared on two image sets with reference values (NutriImage, 887 Japanese meals; SNAPMe, 1,134 US meals), and the selected model (Qwen3-VL-4B, 4-bit) was run on an iPad Air without network access. Energy (primary outcome), protein, fat, carbohydrate and salt were evaluated by median absolute percentage error (MedAPE) and Spearman rank correlation (rho). The effect of supplying the food weight, including errors in it, was examined. Results: Energy estimates on the iPad were identical to those of a desktop-computer run for 84-86% of images (other values, 75-87%). MedAPE on the iPad was 37.0% and 36.5% for energy (26-28% of images within +/-20%), 43-65% for the macronutrients and 68-101% for salt (rho 0.51-0.85). On the desktop computer, supplying the true weight reduced MedAPE of the 4B model on NutriImage from 37.0% to 32.5% for energy and from 100.0% to 66.8% for salt; energy MedAPE stayed below the base value for declared weights of 0.5-1.25 times the true weight or rounded to 50 g, but rose markedly when the container weight was included. Conclusions: An offline VLM on a tablet reproduced server-side energy accuracy and is a candidate tool for dietary counselling where photographs cannot leave the institution; given the wide limits of agreement, its usefulness in practice remains to be examined.
items.authors: Nakagawa, S.; Yamamoto, A.

items.title: Development and Cross-Database External Validation of 24-Hour Landmark Models for ICU Mortality After Intracerebral Hemorrhage: Incremental Value of Routine Coagulation Markers
items.abstract: Background: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) is associated with high early mortality. Although routine coagulation markers are clinically relevant, their incremental value for mortality prediction beyond neurologic and physiologic information is uncertain. We developed and externally validated models using first-24-hour ICU data and evaluated the added predictive value of routine coagulation measurements. Methods: We used MIMIC-IV for model development and eICU-CRD for external validation. The development cohort included 2,669 adults with non-traumatic ICH and 388 ICU deaths. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were evaluated using a patient-level 70:30 holdout split and 5-fold stratified cross-validation. External validation used a high-specificity primary eICU cohort (396 patients; 39 deaths) and a broader secondary hemorrhagic-stroke/likely-ICH cohort (1,555 patients; 168 deaths). Performance was assessed using AUROC, AUPRC, Brier score, calibration, and paired bootstrap comparisons. GCS-only and age-plus-GCS models served as clinical benchmarks. Coagulation-only, clinical-only, and combined XGBoost models were compared to assess incremental value. Results: In the internal holdout cohort, AUROCs were 0.870 for logistic regression, 0.859 for random forest, and 0.867 for XGBoost. In the primary external cohort, corresponding AUROCs were 0.804, 0.839, and 0.817; AUPRCs were 0.342, 0.419, and 0.406; and Brier scores were 0.080, 0.072, and 0.074. In the broader cohort, AUROCs were 0.826, 0.848, and 0.838. Random forest showed the numerically strongest external performance, but pairwise AUROC differences among multivariable models were not clearly supported. GCS-only achieved AUROCs of 0.780 and 0.813 in the primary and broader cohorts. Coagulation-only XGBoost showed weak discrimination (AUROC 0.598 internally, 0.598 primary external, and 0.566 broader external). Adding coagulation variables to the clinical model produced AUROC differences of 0.014 (95% CI -0.009 to 0.037) and 0.003 (95% CI -0.007 to 0.013) in the two external cohorts. Conclusions: Multivariable models based on first-24-hour ICU data retained useful discrimination across external cohorts and provided modest gains over simple GCS-based benchmarks. Routine coagulation markers alone were weak predictors and did not provide clearly supported incremental discrimination beyond broader clinical information. Cross-database transportability should be interpreted together with phenotype alignment and calibration.
items.authors: Pathak, S.; Si, Y.; Sanjaya, J.; Haghi, M.; Kudrot, N. T.; Placencia, G.; Alaei, K.; Pishgar, M.
items.title_zh: ICU脑出血后24小时死亡预测模型的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 背景：脑出血（ICH）早期死亡率高。尽管常规凝血指标在临床上相关，但其在超越神经和生理信息的死亡预测中的增值作用尚不明确。本研究开发并外部验证了基于首24小时ICU数据的预测模型，并评估常规凝血测量的附加预测价值。方法：使用MIMIC-IV进行模型开发，eICU-CRD进行外部验证。开发队列包括2669名非创伤性ICH成人患者及388例ICU死亡病例。采用逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost进行评估。外部验证使用高特异性eICU队列（396名患者；39例死亡）及更广泛的出血性中风/可能ICH队列（1555名患者；168例死亡）。结果：内部持出队列中，逻辑回归AUROC为0.870，随机森林为0.859，XGBoost为0.867。主要外部队列中，AUROC分别为0.804、0.839和0.817。

items.title: The impact of COVID-19 vaccination on long COVID prevention in the Omicron era: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: Objectives To evaluate the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on the prevention of long COVID (LC) in the Omicron era through an updated systematic review and meta-analysis. Methods We performed an update of our previously published systematic review and meta-analysis of vaccination and LC risk (searches between 1 January 2022 and 1 March 2024). Databases (Embase, MEDLINE, PubMed, Europe PMC, LILACS, Cochrane COVID-19 Study Register) were searched for studies published between 1 March 2024 and 13 July 2026. Observational studies assessing the impact of vaccination on the risk of LC four or more weeks after SARS-CoV-2 infection were included. Vaccines were restricted to those centrally authorised in the European Union. Random-effects meta-analyses, restricted to adults, were performed to calculate pooled odds ratios (OR) of LC in three comparisons: vaccinated (any dose) versus unvaccinated; booster vaccination versus unvaccinated; and booster vaccination versus primary course vaccination only. Results Nineteen new studies were identified, of which ten were included in the updated meta-analyses alongside eight studies from the original review. The pooled OR of LC in vaccinated adults (any dose) versus unvaccinated was 0.75 (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.67-0.84; 13 studies). ORs were also lower for booster vaccination versus unvaccinated (0.73; 95% CI 0.65-0.82; 6 studies), and booster vaccination versus primary course vaccination (0.63; 95% CI 0.53-0.75; 6 studies). Significant associations between vaccination and lower LC odds were observed in subgroup analyses of mRNA-only vaccination and LC outcomes three or more months after infection. Conclusions This updated review and meta-analysis reinforces our previous finding that vaccination may reduce the burden of LC in the Omicron era, with booster doses potentially providing additional protection. Although evidence in high-risk groups now prioritised for vaccination in most countries remains limited, these findings clearly demonstrate the benefits of vaccination and support current seasonal vaccination strategies.
items.authors: Marjenberg, Z.; Peluso, M. J.; Wynberg, E.; Abduljawad, S.

items.title: Human-specific CCG-repeat insertion in the RBFOX1 promoter implicated in autism and speech enhances EGR1-responsive activity
items.abstract: Human-specific promoter innovations have been predicted to shape human-specific traits. Here, we investigated the RBFOX1 splice regulator gene, which is specifically upregulated in human and songbird speech/song brain areas. We found that the human RBFOX1 promoter associated with autism and language impairment harbors a human-specific CCG trinucleotide insertion creating a functional CCG-repeat motif. Comparative single-nucleus transcriptome analyses of primate brains indicate that the human promoter drives differential expression in cortical excitatory neurons. Reporter assays show that the human CCG-repeat motif, relative to the chimpanzee allele, increases promoter activity with the EGR1 transcription factor. Genome-wide, the CCG-repeat motif marks core promoters of 104 genes, related to postsynaptic function and autism. In PTCHD1, a clinical duplication in autism patients creates another CCG-repeat motif that similarly increases EGR1-responsive promoter activity. Our findings suggest that small CCG-repeat variants in regulatory regions can exert large effects on gene regulation and apparent associated traits.
items.authors: Lee, C.; Davenport, M. H.; Jarvis, E. D.

items.title: A StayGold-based calcium ion indicator
items.abstract: Genetically encoded calcium ion (Ca2+) indicators (GECIs) enable visualization of Ca2+ dynamics in living systems but often suffer from limited photostability during prolonged imaging. The recent discovery of StayGold, a green fluorescent protein (FP) with exceptional brightness and photostability, opened the possibility of addressing this longstanding challenge. Here, we sought to establish whether a monomeric variant of StayGold (mStayGold) could be converted into a single FP-based GECI. Through extensive protein engineering, we generated a functional mStayGold-based GECI, HiCaRI (Highly intensiometric Ca2+ Responsive Indicator) by fusing Calmodulin (CaM) and the ckkap binding peptide from K-GECO1 into mStayGold(J). HiCaRI exhibits a large Ca2+-dependent inverse fluorescence response ({triangleup}F/Fmin = -15) while retaining high brightness and improved photostability relative to previously reported GFP-based GECIs. Although the current variant represents a first-generation prototype with shortcomings in terms of Ca2+ affinity and photostability (relative to StayGold and mStayGold(J)), this work demonstrates the feasibility of constructing single FP-based GECIs from a highly photostable fluorescent protein.
items.authors: Miyazaki, I.; Tsao, K. K.; Terai, T.; Takahashi-Yamashiro, K.; Campbell, R. E.

items.title: Pupil Dynamics Reflect Uncertainty-Driven Adjustments of Probability Learning
items.abstract: Adaptive learning in dynamic environments depends on the brain's ability to represent and respond to uncertainty. Changes in arousal-mediated pupil diameter provide insight into the neural basis of this process. Prior work has focused on magnitude-based inference tasks and revealed that learning is primarily influenced by the detection of change points and the corresponding modulation of arousal. In comparison, the role of arousal systems in learning contexts where changes are harder to detect, such as in probability learning, remains poorly understood. Here, we combined pupillometry with a probability learning task in which human participants estimated a hidden generative probability of stimuli that changed abruptly and unpredictably. A Bayesian ideal observer model was used to estimate trial-by-trial learning rates and two uncertainty-associated factors: change point probability (the probability that the generative process has abruptly changed) and prior uncertainty (about the current beliefs on this generative process). In line with normative theory, participants relied on prior uncertainty to adjust learning rates. Pupil analyses revealed temporally distinct representations of uncertainty, with phasic dilations tracking change point probability and tonic pupil dilations tracking prior uncertainty. Mediation analyses further indicated that both phasic and tonic pupil signals partially carried the effects of change point probability and prior uncertainty on learning, respectively. Critically, high tonic arousal weakened the coupling between phasic pupil responses and change point probability, accompanied by a reduced influence of change point probability on learning. Together, our results demonstrate that probability learning in a dynamic environment is underpinned by computationally rational integration of latent uncertainty factors and its contribution to belief updating,regulated through arousal-associated responses.
items.authors: Greenhouse-Tucknott, A.; Foucault, C.; Buot, A.; Meyniel, F.

items.title: Environmental co-option of chromatin potential links prenatal hypoxia to persistent cortical circuit dysfunction
items.abstract: Transient prenatal hypoxia is associated with long-term neurodevelopmental impairment without overt structural brain injury, suggesting early regulatory disruptions precede detectable pathology. Whether these disruptions represent transient stress responses or redirect developmental programs remains unknown. Here, we combined single-nucleus RNA sequencing and chromatin accessibility profiling in the late-gestation mouse cortex immediately after transient hypoxia, capturing responses across more than 140,000 nuclei. Hypoxia induced a largely conserved transcriptional stress response across cell types, whereas chromatin accessibility showed more extensive, cell type-specific disruption. Developing glutamatergic neurons showed the strongest disruption of chromatin transcription coupling, with hypoxia-responsive distal regulatory regions associated with genes governing synaptic organization and neuronal excitability. Consistent with these chromatin-associated programs, juvenile offspring displayed reduced dendritic spine density and increased intrinsic excitability in cortical neurons. These results support a model in which transient hypoxia co-opts the developing epigenome's capacity to encode future transcriptional states before persistent circuit dysfunction emerges.
items.authors: Cristancho, A. G.; Joseph, D. J.; Cassidy, M. M.; Chauhan, P. S.; Gadra, E. J.; Gadra, E. C.; Zarrinnegar, D.; Rodriguez, B. N.; Marsh, E. D.

items.title: The essential role of connective-tissue cells during axolotl limb regeneration
items.abstract: Axolotls (Ambystoma mexicanum) are known for their remarkable limb-regeneration abilities, which involve the formation of the blastema, a specialized structure consisting of progenitor cells contributed by all major tissues of the limb. Lateral plate mesoderm (LPM)-derived connective tissue (CT) cells dedifferentiate and play a critical role in blastema formation and subsequent limb regeneration. However, the complexity of the blastema cellular composition and the extent of CT participation and necessity have not been rigorously explored. To address this gap, we conducted spatial transcriptomics using a select array of probes, revealing that CT cells constitute up to 75% of the blastema cells. Genetic ablation of CT cells significantly delays or truncates limb regeneration, underscoring their necessity during this process. Analysis of the molecular profile during blastema formation identifies a temporally ordered gene expression pattern reflecting sequential phases of CT cell dedifferentiation, proliferation, and redifferentiation. Finally, a cell-cell communication inference identifies a CT-cell-autonomous FGFR1/AKT1 signaling axis as a cell-intrinsic molecular requirement for limb regeneration. Together, our work reaffirms the central role of CT cells in axolotl limb regeneration and lays the foundation for identifying molecular mechanisms that govern blastema formation during the initial phases of limb regeneration.
items.authors: Garcia-Garcia, D.; Knapp, D.; Jamwal, K.; Grindle, R. E.; Fuqua, H.; Seaman, R. P.; Sujansky, M.; Kim, M.; Nowoshilow, S.; Novatchkova, M.; Kolling, F. W.; Graber, J. H.; Murawala, P.

items.title: Seasonal Selection Reveals Two Independent Temporal Modes of Genomic Adaptation
items.abstract: Natural populations must adapt to environmental change that unfolds over multiple, overlapping timescales, yet how they do so remains a central question in evolutionary biology. Here we combine seven years of field sampling, common-garden phenotyping and pooled whole-genome sequencing from a single wild Drosophila melanogaster population. We identify two independent modes of selection: a concurrent mode, in which allele frequencies track the environment of the current season, and a lagged mode, in which the environment of one season drives allele-frequency change in the next. The two modes act on largely distinct sets of SNPs, and each responds to different environmental variables depending on which season is exerting selection. Selection signals from different seasons and timings converge on the same genes, and this convergence increases with both pleiotropy and breadth of selection: genes that affect more stress-tolerance traits, and genes that respond to more season-and-timing combinations, are the most likely to be targeted repeatedly. These genes are concentrated in neural and developmental pathways, including genes that govern reproductive behaviour. Our results show that populations adapt to environmental change through multiple strategies that differ in both timing and genomic basis, and that reshape how the organism perceives and responds to its environment. This principle should extend to any system that faces recurring, structured environmental variation.
items.authors: Behrman, E. L.; Schmidt, P.

items.title: Distribution of Gene Tree Topologies with Duplication, Loss, and Coalescence
items.abstract: Motivation: Many methods can be used to infer the number and timing of gene duplication and loss events from gene trees. Most such reconciliation methods use a model of gene duplication that does not include the coalescent process, or that restricts it in important ways. As a result, changes to tree topologies due to coalescence will incur a cost of extra duplications and losses using these methods, events that did not actually occur. Results: Here, we present results from the multispecies coalescent with duplication and loss (MSC-DL) model, which allows for the unrestricted interaction between duplication, loss, and coalescence. Theoretical results show that even histories with only a single duplication event can lead to many more trees than are normally considered: for a species tree with 2 tips, 9 trees are possible, while with 6 tips, more than 19 million trees are possible; adding even a single loss almost doubles the number of possible topologies. The probabilities of different topologies and their branch lengths under the MSC-DL for trees with two species are calculated exactly, and we provide an approach for calculating such probabilities on larger trees. These results have important implications for the accuracy of reconciliation methods, ortholog identification methods, and our understanding of evolutionary histories of duplication and loss. Supplementary Information: Supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/smishra677/ Distribution-of-Gene-Tree-Topologies-with-Duplication-Loss-and-Coalescence.
items.authors: Mishra, S.; Hahn, M. W.
items.title_zh: 基因树拓扑在重复、丢失与汇合中的分布
items.summary_zh: 研究动机：许多方法可用于推断基因树中的基因重复和丢失事件的数量及时间。大多数调和方法使用的基因重复模型未考虑汇合过程或在重要方面受到限制，因此由于汇合导致的树拓扑变化会产生额外的重复和丢失成本，这些事件实际上并未发生。研究结果：本文展示了多物种汇合与重复和丢失（MSC-DL）模型的结果，该模型允许重复、丢失与汇合之间的无限制互动。理论结果表明，即使只有单一重复事件的历史也能产生比通常考虑的更多树：对于具有2个叶子的物种树，可能有9种树形，而对于6个叶子，则可能有超过1900万种树形；即使增加一个丢失事件，可能的拓扑数量几乎翻倍。我们精确计算了在MSC-DL下两种物种树的不同拓扑及其分支长度的概率，并提供了在更大树上计算这些概率的方法。这些结果对调和方法、直系同源基因识别方法的准确性以及我们对重复和丢失的进化历史的理解具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，考虑汇合过程的多物种汇合与重复和丢失模型能显著增加基因树的拓扑多样性，影响基因重复和丢失事件的推断准确性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了基因树拓扑在基因重复、丢失与汇合过程中的分布，重点关注现有调和方法在处理这些事件时的局限性。许多现有的方法虽然能够推断基因树中的基因重复和丢失事件的数量及时间，但大多数调和方法所采用的基因重复模型并未充分考虑汇合（convergence）过程，或在某些重要方面受到限制。这种局限性导致由于汇合引起的树拓扑变化被忽视，从而产生了额外的重复和丢失成本，而这些事件实际上并未发生。

为了解决这一问题，本文提出了多物种汇合与重复和丢失（MSC-DL）模型，该模型允许重复、丢失与汇合之间进行无限制的互动。研究结果表明，即使在仅有单一重复事件的情况下，所能产生的树形数量也远超通常的预期。例如，对于具有2个叶子的物种树，可能存在多达9种不同的树形，而对于6个叶子的物种树，可能的树形数量甚至超过1900万种。此外，研究还发现，即使增加一个丢失事件，可能的拓扑数量几乎会翻倍，这进一步表明重复与丢失事件的复杂性。

在理论分析中，本文精确计算了在MSC-DL模型下两种物种树的不同拓扑及其分支长度的概率，并提供了一种在更大树上计算这些概率的方法。这些研究结果不仅对调和方法的准确性和直系同源基因识别方法的有效性具有重要意义，还深化了我们对基因重复和丢失的进化历史的理解。通过揭示汇合与重复、丢失之间的复杂关系，本文为基因树的推断提供了新的视角和方法论基础。

items.title: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
items.abstract: Identification of amyloid forming regions in proteins remains central to understanding of their aggregation behaviour, which are central to various neurodegenerative and systemic disorders. Many predictors have been designed to identify amyloid forming regions, however they may not necessarily identify total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor-AmyloCore-ML to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. PLMs consistently outperformed physicochemical descriptors, with the best models reaching AUROC values of ~0.88 and AUPRC values of ~0.85. Locked full-length protein scans further localized experimental cores, with ESM-2/ExtraTrees achieving AUROC 0.833, AUPRC 0.751, and a mean peak distance of 12.4 residues. In comparative benchmarking, our predictor showed better performance metrics than CrossBeta and AggrescanAI. The framework therefore provides residue-resolved prediction of structurally incorporated amyloid-core regions directly from sequence.
items.authors: Singh, J.; Jangid, R.; Srivastava, A.

items.title: MtbAIM: AI/ML-guided endpoint-specific prediction of small-molecule activity across drug-susceptible and drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis
items.abstract: The emergence of drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M.tb) presents a major challenge to drug discovery, as compounds active against drug-susceptible (DS) isolates may not retain comparable inhibitory activity against drug-resistant (DR) isolates. Here, we developed an AI/ML workflow to independently prioritize small molecules separately against DS and DR isolates of M.tb and predict MIC, MIC90, and MIC99 as distinct quantitative endpoints. Following curation of data retrieved from the ChEMBL repository, molecular-activity datasets comprised 25,645 and 3,749 compounds tested against whole cell DS and DR isolates respectively. Molecular representations were generated using RDKit descriptors and Morgan fingerprints, along with embeddings from ChemBERTa, MolCLR, and Uni-Mol, and evaluated for binary activity classification and endpoint-specific regression. The best-performing DS classifier combined RDKit/Morgan features with ExtraTrees (balanced accuracy 0.782; AUROC 0.864; AUPRC 0.870), while histogram gradient boosting using the same features performed best for DR classification (balanced accuracy 0.762; AUROC 0.836; AUPRC 0.880). Similarly, RDKit/Morgan features combined with tree-based regressors achieved the best overall performance across all six DS/DR regression endpoints, with pooled out-of-fold RMSE values ranging from 0.604 to 0.784 pMIC units. To facilitate broader application, we developed MtbAIM (https://github.com/jasdeep002/MtbAIM), a Google Colab-based prediction platform that enables users to assess and prioritize small molecules against DS and DR isolates of M.tb.
items.authors: Singh, J.; Singh, K.

items.title: Non-canonical cleavage expands prime editing in 5' direction
items.abstract: Cleavage-dependent CRISPR-Cas gene editing relies on RNA-guided DNA cleavage that drives cellular machinery to incorporate intended edits. Beyond canonical cleavage, CRISPR nucleases can also execute non-canonical cleavage on the displaced DNA strand. Here, we report a modified design principle for prime editing that leverages the non-canonical cleavage activity, enabling editing in the 5' direction of a classic nick site. We elucidate the non-canonical-cleavage-driven reverse transcription pathway that initiates upstream of the classic nick site. We identify competition between the canonical and non-canonical routes, which can be modulated by rationally designing RNA templates carrying the intended edits. We demonstrate that cellular physiology enhances editing efficiency from individual reverse-transcription product yet exerts limited influence on pathway competitions. Our findings revise the design principle of prime editing and establish a new dimension for engineering CRISPR-Cas systems by harnessing its intrinsic, non-host-specific, non-canonical cleavage activity.
items.authors: Chen, P.-R.; Yuan, X.-Z.; Wang, S.-G.; Xia, P.-F.
items.title_zh: 非典型切割扩展了原始编辑的5'方向编辑能力
items.summary_zh: 依赖于切割的CRISPR-Cas基因编辑依靠RNA引导的DNA切割来驱动细胞机制进行预期编辑。除了典型切割外，CRISPR核酸酶还可以在位移的DNA链上执行非典型切割。本文报告了一种改进的原始编辑设计原则，利用非典型切割活性，使得在经典切口位点的5'方向进行编辑成为可能。我们阐明了非典型切割驱动的逆转录途径，该途径在经典切口位点的上游启动。我们发现典型和非典型途径之间存在竞争，这种竞争可以通过合理设计携带预期编辑的RNA模板进行调节。我们的研究表明，细胞生理增强了单个逆转录产物的编辑效率，但对途径竞争的影响有限。我们的发现修订了原始编辑的设计原则，并为利用CRISPR-Cas系统的内在非宿主特异性非典型切割活性提供了新的工程维度。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，非典型切割可以扩展CRISPR原始编辑在5'方向的编辑能力，优化了基因编辑设计原则并提高了编辑效率。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了一种改进的原始编辑（prime editing）设计原则，该原则利用非典型切割（non-canonical cutting）活性，扩展了CRISPR-Cas基因编辑在经典切口位点（canonical cut site）5'方向的编辑能力。传统的CRISPR-Cas基因编辑依赖于RNA引导的DNA切割来实现预期的基因编辑，而非典型切割则能够在位移的DNA链上进行切割，从而为基因编辑提供了新的可能性。

研究中，作者阐明了非典型切割驱动的逆转录途径（reverse transcription pathway），该途径在经典切口位点的上游启动。通过实验，发现典型和非典型途径之间存在竞争关系，这种竞争可以通过合理设计携带预期编辑的RNA模板进行调节。具体而言，细胞生理条件的变化增强了单个逆转录产物的编辑效率，但对途径竞争的影响却相对有限。

研究结果表明，非典型切割的引入为原始编辑的设计原则提供了新的视角，修订了以往的理解，并为利用CRISPR-Cas系统的内在非宿主特异性非典型切割活性开辟了新的工程维度。这一发现不仅丰富了基因编辑的技术手段，也为未来的基因治疗和生物工程应用提供了更为广泛的可能性。

items.title: Computation or Weight Adaptation? Rethinking the Role of Plasticity in Learning
items.abstract: The human brain is an adaptive learning system that can generalize to new tasks and unfamiliar environments. The traditional view is that such adaptive behavior requires a structural change of the learning system (e.g., via neural plasticity). In this work, we use artificial neural networks, specifically large language models (LLMs), to challenge this traditional view and suggest that such adaptive behavior can be also achieved solely through computation if the learning system is sufficiently trained. We focus on statistical learning paradigms. These require identifying underlying regularities in seemingly arbitrary word sequences and are primarily considered to require neural plasticity. LLMs can capture arbitrary structures without requiring weight adaptation, despite divergence from their natural language training data. Our work provides novel insights into the role of plasticity in learning, demonstrating that sufficiently trained learning systems are highly flexible, adapting to new tasks and environments solely through computation, much more than previously acknowledged. Furthermore, our work opens the door for future research to use deep learning models to conjure hypotheses about the brain.
items.authors: Lior, G.; Shalev, Y.; Stanovsky, G.; Goldstein, A.

items.title: InfluProto: Predicting Cross-Species Transmission of Influenza A Virus via Prototype Learning
items.abstract: Zoonotic influenza A viruses pose constitute a significant persistent threat to global public health, yet quantitative approaches for assessing their cross-species transmission potential remain limited. Here, we present InfluProto, a deep learning model that introduces prototype learning into host prediction for influenza A virus, framing conceptualizing host adaptation as a continuous process rather than a discrete outcome. InfluProto embeds viral sequences into a continuous representation space anchored by human, swine, and avian prototypes, using cosine distances as a quantitative measure of host adaptation. InfluProto accurately discriminated among the three host classes, achieving recall and precision exceeding 0.97, and substantially outperformed conventional classification models models--particularly on challenging zoonotic strains, including the 2009 pandemic H1N1 (pdm09) lineage. Beyond host classification, the learned representations captured biologically meaningful host-adaptive signatures,; notably, with pdm09 viruses occupying occupied an intermediate position between human and swine clusters, consistent with their evolutionary origin. Analysis of simulated reassortment further revealed that the introduction of human-origin segments into swine influenza viruses reduced their distance to the human prototype, indicating that InfluProto can detect reassortment-associated shifts in host adaptation. To facilitate broad public useaccess, we have developed an interactive web service for InfluProto. Collectively, our work establishes a continuous framework for characterizing host adaptation and evaluating zoonotic risk in influenza A viruses, with potential implications for pandemic surveillance and preparedness.
items.authors: Geng, Z.; Li, L.; Ye, R.; Wang, Y.; Song, S.

items.title: Quantification of grapevine yield losses as a function downy mildew severity on foliage and cluster
items.abstract: To quantify the relationship between grapevine disease severity and crop losses at the plant scale, we conducted a three-year field experiment at two sites near Bordeaux (France), monitoring mildews and rots on both foliage and clusters. Preliminary analyses revealed that only downy mildew (DM) significantly impacted yield under our experimental conditions. We capitalized on this single-disease dominance to isolate the effect of DM severity (assessed via standardized AUDPC), on both foliage and clusters, on yield loss at the individual vine scale. At a cluster AUDPC of 5%, yield consistently declined by 24% across all years and sites. Conversely, yield loss at a 5% foliar AUDPC ranged from 9% to 60% depending on the site and year, reflecting a tenfold variation in the damage coefficient. This variability strongly correlated with a moisture risk index computed between the phenological stages of visible inflorescences and pre-ripening berries. Specifically, at 5% foliar AUDPC, the expected yield loss escalated from 9% in a dry season (10th percentile of the index) to 15% in an intermediate season (median), reaching 39% in a wet season (90th percentile). Future research should aim to validate these statistical models across broader climatic, geographic, and agronomic contexts, including the characterization of cultivar-specific responses.
items.authors: Fabre, F.; Delbac, L.; Poeydebat, C.; Zaffaroni, M.

items.title: Identifiability of metabolic resilience from sparse longitudinal metabolomics
items.abstract: Sparse and irregular longitudinal metabolomic measurements can make dynamical quantities numerically estimable without making them scientifically identifiable. We formulate effective-landscape inference as an observation-timescale inverse problem and evaluate its operating characteristics using stochastic systems with known ground truth and longitudinal stool metabolomics from the Integrative Human Microbiome Project. Across simulation ensembles, recovery of a known double-well topology declined sharply as observations became sparse, whereas the tested monostable controls did not generate spurious secondary minima. Findings establish an identifiability hierarchy: global topology requires sufficient within-subject state-space coverage, whereas local return descriptors remain vulnerable to bias from the observation process. The framework therefore shifts the emphasis from assigning stability labels to determining what a sampling design can support. It provides a basis for designing denser longitudinal experiments and for validating clinical and machine-learning studies in which sparse observations might otherwise be overinterpreted as evidence about underlying dynamics.
items.authors: Aminian-Dehkordi, J.; Mofrad, M.
items.title_zh: 稀疏纵向代谢组学的代谢韧性可识别性研究
items.summary_zh: 稀疏且不规则的纵向代谢组学测量可能使动态量在数值上可估计，但不一定在科学上可识别。我们将有效景观推断形式化为观察时间尺度的逆问题，并使用已知真值的随机系统和整合人类微生物组项目的纵向粪便代谢组学数据评估其操作特性。在模拟集合中，已知双井拓扑的恢复随着观察的稀疏性急剧下降，而测试的单稳态控制未产生虚假的次极小值。研究结果建立了可识别性层级：全球拓扑需要足够的个体状态空间覆盖，而局部返回描述则易受观察过程的偏差影响。因此，该框架将重点从赋予稳定性标签转向确定采样设计所能支持的内容，为设计更密集的纵向实验和验证临床及机器学习研究提供了基础。
items.l1_lead: 稀疏纵向代谢组学的研究表明，动态量的可识别性受观察稀疏性的影响，强调了设计密集实验的重要性以提高科学可识别性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了稀疏且不规则的纵向代谢组学测量在动态量估计中的可识别性问题。研究者将有效景观推断形式化为观察时间尺度的逆问题，并通过已知真值的随机系统以及整合人类微生物组项目的纵向粪便代谢组学数据来评估其操作特性。在模拟集合中，研究发现已知双井拓扑的恢复随着观察的稀疏性急剧下降，这表明在稀疏数据条件下，拓扑结构的识别变得更加困难。同时，测试的单稳态控制未产生虚假的次极小值，进一步验证了模型的有效性。

研究结果建立了可识别性层级，指出全球拓扑需要足够的个体状态空间覆盖才能被有效识别，而局部返回描述则易受到观察过程的偏差影响。这一发现强调了在设计纵向代谢组学实验时，采样设计的重要性。研究者提出，重点应从简单的稳定性标签转向确定采样设计所能支持的内容，以便为设计更密集的纵向实验提供基础，并为临床及机器学习研究的验证提供支持。

总的来说，本研究为稀疏纵向代谢组学的可识别性提供了新的视角，强调了在数据采集和实验设计中考虑观察稀疏性的重要性，为未来的研究提供了理论基础和实践指导。

items.title: Chromid transforms opportunistic pathogen into beneficial symbiont to raise coral's thermal tipping point
items.abstract: Resilient turbid coral reefs, found 1{degrees} north of the equator, experience fewer and less intense bleaching events despite being situated within the world's busiest shipping port in highly urbanised Singapore. We hypothesised that bacteria within the coral holobiont play a role in maintaining coral health by conferring traits that enhance thermal tolerance. Eleven Pseudovibrio isolates were obtained from the scleractinian coral Pachyseris speciosa, and their genomes differed by only four single nucleotide polymorphisms. A ~490 kbp chromid, pCJH, was present in 7 of the 11 isolates. A Pseudovibrio isolate without pCJH is an opportunistic pathogen of P. speciosa, accelerating bleaching disease. In contrast, the chromid reduces Pseudovibrio's fecundity, enhances its host colonisation and consequently increases P. speciosa's thermal tolerance by 1 {degrees}C. Interaction analyses in experimentally heat-stressed corals revealed a negative interaction between Pseudovibrio and Vibrio ASVs. The Pseudovibrio genomes and chromid encode several diffusible antibiotic biosynthetic gene clusters and two type six secretion systems (T6SS) for contact-dependent inhibition, with both types of inhibitory activity shown against opportunistic coral pathogens from local (i.e. isolated from the same coral host) and type-strain Vibrio spp. Together, these findings support the Coral Probiotic Hypothesis that bacteria enhance coral resilience, and identify a chromid responsible for Pseudovibrio's climatically driven Jekyll-and-Hyde lifestyle from opportunistic pathogen to beneficial symbiont.

items.title: Spatiotemporal distribution of Delta-like protein 1 during mouse pituitary ontogeny and its relationship with differentiating endocrine cell populations
items.abstract: Delta-like protein 1 (DLK1) is a transmembrane protein involved in the regulation of cellular differentiation and stem cell maintenance in several tissues, including the pituitary gland. Although DLK1 expression has been reported in the adult pituitary, its spatiotemporal distribution during mouse pituitary development remains incompletely characterized. The aim of this study was to analyse the distribution of DLK1 during embryonic and postnatal development of the mouse pituitary gland and to characterize its relationship with hormone-producing cell populations. Immunohistochemistry was performed in Swiss albino mice from embryonic day 9.5 (e9.5) to postnatal day 15 (p15). Double immunofluorescence was used at e18.5 and p15 to examine the association of DLK1 immunoreactivity with ACTH-, TSH-, GH-, FSH- and PRL-producing cells. DLK1 immunoreactivity was detected from the earliest stages of pituitary development in Rathke`s pouch and the ventral diencephalon. During embryonic development, DLK1-ir cells were widely distributed throughout adenohypophyseal and neurohypophyseal primordia. As development progressed, DLK1 immunoreactivity became progressively regionalized within the anterior, intermediate and tuberal lobes, as well as in the median eminence of the hypothalamus and the posterior pituitary lobe. Colocalization of DLK1 with each of the hormone-producing cell populations analysed was observed at e18.5 and p15. Semiquantitative analysis at p15 indicated that approximately 32% of adenohypophyseal cells were DLK1-immunoreactive. These findings provide a detailed description of the spatiotemporal distribution of DLK1 during mouse pituitary ontogeny and suggest that DLK1 immunoreactivity is associated with differentiating endocrine cell populations throughout pituitary development.
items.authors: Reyes, R.; Gomez, A. R.; Diaz, C.; Bello, A. R.
items.title_zh: 小鼠垂体发育过程中Delta样蛋白1的时空分布及其与内分泌细胞的关系
items.summary_zh: Delta样蛋白1（DLK1）是一种跨膜蛋白，参与多种组织的细胞分化和干细胞维持，包括垂体。尽管已有研究报道了成人垂体中DLK1的表达，但其在小鼠垂体发育过程中的时空分布尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在分析小鼠垂体在胚胎和出生后发育过程中DLK1的分布，并探讨其与激素产生细胞群体的关系。采用免疫组化技术对瑞士白鼠进行研究，从胚胎第9.5天（e9.5）到出生后第15天（p15）。在e18.5和p15时使用双重免疫荧光法检查DLK1与ACTH、TSH、GH、FSH和PRL产生细胞的关联。结果显示，DLK1在垂体发育的早期阶段即在Rathke囊和腹侧间脑中被检测到，随着发育的进行，DLK1的免疫反应逐渐在前叶、中间叶和 tuberal叶以及下丘脑的中位隆起和后叶中区域化。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了Delta样蛋白1在小鼠垂体发育过程中具有特定的时空分布，并与多种内分泌细胞的产生密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了Delta样蛋白1（DLK1）在小鼠垂体发育过程中的时空分布及其与内分泌细胞的关系。DLK1是一种跨膜蛋白，已知参与多种组织的细胞分化和干细胞维持，尤其是在垂体的发育中发挥重要作用。尽管已有研究显示成人垂体中DLK1的表达，但其在小鼠胚胎及出生后发育过程中的具体分布尚未得到充分阐明。为此，研究团队采用免疫组化技术对瑞士白鼠进行观察，时间范围从胚胎第9.5天（e9.5）到出生后第15天（p15），并在e18.5和p15时使用双重免疫荧光法分析DLK1与ACTH、TSH、GH、FSH和PRL等激素产生细胞的关系。

研究结果表明，DLK1在垂体发育的早期阶段即在Rathke囊和腹侧间脑中被检测到，显示出其在垂体形成初期的重要作用。随着小鼠的发育，DLK1的免疫反应逐渐在前叶、中间叶和tuberal叶以及下丘脑的中位隆起和后叶中表现出区域化的特征。这一发现表明，DLK1在垂体的不同发育阶段可能与特定的内分泌细胞群体存在密切的关联，提示其在垂体细胞分化和功能成熟中的潜在调控作用。

总体而言，本研究为理解DLK1在小鼠垂体发育中的时空分布及其与内分泌细胞的关系提供了新的视角，揭示了DLK1在垂体发育过程中的重要角色，为进一步研究其在内分泌系统中的功能奠定了基础。

items.title: Lineage tracing reveals asynchronous fate restriction in mouse embryos and stem cell-derived embryo models
items.abstract: How a flexible mammalian embryo gives rise to a reproducible body plan remains unclear, partly because cell lineages cannot be followed continuously in vivo. We combined DNA Typewriter lineage recording with tetraploid complementation to reconstruct high-resolution single-cell genealogies across mouse development and built FateVec, an analysis framework that infers fate-bias dynamics and lineage-associated transcriptional programs from reconstructed phylogenies. Loss of developmental potential proved progressive and asynchronous, with multiple lineages acquiring detectable fate bias before morphological diversification at gastrulation. Within the neural crest, most cells remained multipotent over an extended window, while independent founder clades differed markedly in restriction timing. Extending lineage recording to a stem-cell-derived embryo model revealed that cells with shared transcriptional identities can arise from distinct lineage relationships. We further found embryonic-lineage contributions to extraembryonic-like states, exposing an unexplored lineage plasticity. This lineage-resolved view of embryogenesis reveals that cell identity alone predicts neither developmental ancestry nor the timing of fate restriction.
items.authors: Liu, Y.; Park, J.; Amaya, L.; Junyent, S.; Sun, X.; Xiao, J. S.; Wang, Y.; Wang, H.; Lu, Y.; Nakagawa, S.; Park, S.-E.; Hu, W.; Liu, S.; Wei, J.; Kim, H. H.; Thomson, M.; Ju, C.-W.; Bronner, M. E.; Choi, J.; Zernicka-Goetz, M.
items.title_zh: 谱系追踪揭示小鼠胚胎及干细胞衍生胚胎模型中的非同步命运限制
items.summary_zh: 小鼠胚胎如何形成可重复的体型仍不清楚，部分原因是无法在体内持续追踪细胞谱系。我们结合DNA打字机谱系记录与四倍体补充技术，重建了小鼠发育过程中的高分辨率单细胞谱系，并构建了FateVec分析框架，以推断命运偏向动态和谱系相关的转录程序。研究发现，发育潜能的丧失是渐进且非同步的，多条谱系在形态多样化之前就已获得可检测的命运偏向。在神经嵴中，大多数细胞在较长时间内保持多能性，而独立的创始谱系在限制时机上差异显著。将谱系记录扩展到干细胞衍生的胚胎模型中，发现具有相似转录身份的细胞可以源自不同的谱系关系。我们进一步发现胚胎谱系对类外胚胎状态的贡献，揭示了未被探索的谱系可塑性。这一谱系解析的胚胎发生视角表明，仅凭细胞身份无法预测发育祖先或命运限制的时机。
items.l1_lead: 研究揭示小鼠胚胎发育中细胞命运的非同步性和谱系多样性，强调细胞身份不足以预测发育潜能和命运限制的时机。
items.l2_summary:
小鼠胚胎的形成及其可重复的体型机制仍然是一个未解之谜，部分原因在于缺乏对细胞谱系的持续追踪。为了解决这一问题，研究团队结合了DNA打字机谱系记录（DNA barcoding）与四倍体补充技术，重建了小鼠发育过程中的高分辨率单细胞谱系，并构建了FateVec分析框架，以推断命运偏向的动态变化和谱系相关的转录程序。研究结果表明，发育潜能的丧失是一个渐进且非同步的过程，多个谱系在形态多样化之前就已获得可检测的命运偏向。

在神经嵴中，大多数细胞在较长时间内保持多能性，而不同的创始谱系在限制时机上存在显著差异。这一发现强调了细胞命运的复杂性和谱系的多样性。此外，研究将谱系记录扩展到干细胞衍生的胚胎模型中，发现具有相似转录身份的细胞可以源自不同的谱系关系。这一结果揭示了胚胎谱系对类外胚胎状态的贡献，表明了未被探索的谱系可塑性。

通过这一谱系解析的胚胎发生视角，研究指出，仅凭细胞身份无法有效预测其发育祖先或命运限制的时机。这一研究不仅为理解小鼠胚胎发育提供了新的视角，也为未来的干细胞研究和再生医学奠定了基础。

items.title: Diversifying stocking practices within rangelands supports diverse plant-pollinator communities and interactions
items.abstract: Understanding how management alters species' biodiversity and interactions is critical for sustainable agriculture. This can be especially important for rangelands, grasslands used for livestock grazing that cover 30% of land worldwide. In rangelands, ranchers need to maximize livestock production while supporting healthy ecosystems. Grazing management can alter the impact of livestock by varying grazing timing and intensity, but its ecological impacts remain poorly understood. One critical function that may be supported in these systems is pollination; how rangeland management may alter this ecosystem service is not systematically understood. We investigated how rotational stocking, where livestock are rotated among pastures, affected plant and pollinator communities and plant-pollinator interactions using working ranches in the Southern Great Plains. Sites were managed through continuous stocking or rotation with low or high frequency. We found that high-frequency livestock rotation supported greater flower abundance, and consequently greater pollinator abundance. Pollinator orders varied in their responses to management with Hymenoptera directly responding to management, and Coleoptera and Lepidoptera responding indirectly via changes in flower abundance. Community-level changes produced more specialized interaction networks that, along with species turnover, led to high interaction turnover across rangeland sites. This suggests that a mosaic of management strategies likely diversifies habitat and helps support plant and pollinator biodiversity at the landscape scale. This study demonstrates that rangelands can support plants, pollinators, and their interactions, particularly when managed with high-frequency rotational stocking.
items.authors: Pearson, A. E.; Russo, L.; Neff, J. L.; Duffee, B.; Martinez, J.; McKinnis, A.; Medina, N.; Moore, J.; Phillips, E. W.; Lichtenberg, E. M.

items.title: Individual behavioral signatures shape processing of context-dependent social fear
items.abstract: Context processing is an essential function in the cognitive repertoire of numerous species, including humans and mice, allowing them to learn from their environment and adapt their future behavior. Impairments or alterations in context processing are hypothesized to represent one of the core etiological mechanisms underlying trauma- and stressor-related disorders such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Individual behavioral traits are key determinants of post-stress responses; however, how they influence distinct phases of contextual encoding and processing remains incompletely understood. This knowledge gap is further exacerbated by the limited availability of contextual fear protocols based on social stress, even though the latter is among the most frequent and impactful forms of stress exposure. Here, based on social defeat paradigms, we establish a longitudinal social conditioned place aversion (sCPA) protocol that leads to avoidance of the defeat-associated chamber in adult male mice. Prior characterization of mice according to anxiety-related phenotypes revealed that mice displaying high novelty-induced thigmotaxic (i.e. high anxiety-like) behavior showed lasting long-term memory of the defeat-associated chamber as denoted by persistent avoidance. On the other hand, lower levels of exploration/locomotor behaviors prior to stress exposure predicted greater avoidance of the defeat-associated chamber in the short-term. Finally, we reveal that inhibiting the activity of VTAVgat neurons during conditioning sessions abolished sCPA acquisition, while disrupting the predictive ability of locomotor/exploratory profiles derived prior to the sCPA. Our data establishes a robust temporally structured social stress-based conditioning protocol and reveals how prior individual anxiety- and exploration/locomotion-related traits influence distinct stages of context processing.
items.authors: Parapera Papantoniou, L.; Contestabile, A.; Prouvot Bouvier, P.-H.; Bezzola, C.; Lucchini, M.; Pfister, C.; Vityk, O.; Alazmi, B.; Tzanoulinou, S.

items.title: Nested Male Reproductive Strategies in a Tolerant Multilevel Primate Society
items.abstract: Male reproductive success varies within populations. Models explaining reproductive skew emphasise dominance, yet the determinants of male reproductive success in egalitarian societies remain poorly understood. Using nine years of behavioural and genetic data from five parties, we investigated male reproductive monopolisation in wild Guinea baboons (*Papio papio*), an egalitarian multilevel society with one-male "units" nested within "parties" and low male-male contest competition. Genetic analyses showed 93% of the 69 infants were sired by the female's "unit male", with extra-unit paternities consistent with limited control models. Reproduction was distributed among multiple unit males, resulting in low reproductive skew at the party level, with top males siring 23-40% of offspring, well below levels in despotic species. Female takeovers were rare, suggesting male restraint. Among prime-aged males, the number of unit females was only weakly positively associated with dominance ratings. Prime-age predicted reproductive success better than dominance. Non-prime-aged males had fewer females across dominance ratings. In conclusion, male Guinea baboons' reproductive potential is shaped less by dominance than by age and stable associations with females, who play an active role in inter-sexual relationships. These results emphasise the need to move beyond frameworks focused solely on dominance-based mechanisms and to consider species-specific social organisation.
items.authors: Dal Pesco, F.; Neumann, C.; Trede, F.; Zinner, D.; Fischer, J.

items.title: Coordinated Enhancement of Molecular and Spatial Fidelity for Biological Inference in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.abstract: Understanding tissue organization requires accurate molecular quantification and faithful spatial localization. Spatial omics, particularly spatial transcriptomics (ST), face measurement trade-offs that limit simultaneous achievement of molecular and spatial fidelity across spatial resolution, detection sensitivity, molecular-tissue alignment and cell-level fidelity. Existing computational methods typically target individual aspects and optimize them in isolation, despite their interdependence. Here we present FOCUS, a multimodal generative foundation model for coordinated ST enhancement. FOCUS integrates native ST with histology images, cell masks, scRNA-seq references and spatial co-expression priors through task-specific modules, with cross-task coordination enabling joint correction of co-occurring limitations. FOCUS improved the performance of individual enhancement tasks and provided additional gains with coordinated mitigation of coupled limitations. Across immunology, tissue development and oncology, FOCUS recovered biologically consistent patterns obscured in native ST or isolated enhancement, enabling clearer inference of neutrophil-tumor interactions, spatial osteocyte differentiation and primary-metastatic HNSCC programs. Together, FOCUS establishes coordinated enhancement of molecular and spatial fidelity as a strategy for downstream biological inference from ST.
items.authors: Wang, X.; Que, N.; Liu, H.; Tao, C.; Jiang, Y.; Jiang, Y.; Zhu, P.; Xu, J.; Yan, H.; Ye, B.; Price, S.; Xi, J.; Wang, X.; Li, C.

items.title: Inherent limitations of zero-shot mutation prediction in protein engineering
items.abstract: Predicting mutation effects is critical for protein engineering. A commonly pursued strategy is zero-shot prediction with deep-learning models, whose performance is typically evaluated using aggregate benchmark scores that obscure multidimensional biological tradeoffs. Here, we evaluate sequence, structure, and hybrid foundation models across curated datasets to expose the practical limitations of zero-shot predictions. We demonstrate that model performance is highly variable and heavily influenced by experimental noise and competing phenotypic goals. Notably, predictions from competing models often correlate more strongly with one another than with experimental outcomes. While current models effectively filter deleterious mutations and enrich high-scoring variants for natural functions, they struggle to identify precise optimal mutations and consistently fail to predict mutations that drive new-to-nature functions. These models learn from evolutionary constraints that tend to oppose the extreme biophysical optimizations required in targeted engineering. Consequently, zero-shot scoring serves as a valuable initial filter but cannot substitute for task-specific prediction.
items.authors: Woolley, P. R.; Feller, A.; Ellington, A. O.; Wilke, C. O.

items.title: A critical evaluation of Gene Ontology priors in biologically-informed neural networks
items.abstract: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) embed prior knowledge such as the Gene Ontology (GO) into their architecture to produce interpretable representations, yet whether and how this prior improves performance or interpretation remains unclear. We introduce GONNECT, a BINN incorporating GO into an autoencoder. We evaluate GO constraints in the encoder, decoder, or both on RNA-seq tumour samples from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), comparing against published BINNs (OntoVAE, VEGA), an unconstrained baseline, randomized priors, and untrained networks. Across various performance metrics, GO structure adds little to reconstruction or latent-space organization, frequently matched by randomized or unconstrained models. Node activations agree with a gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA)-derived reference, but this agreement largely arises from the architectural constraint: it is lost when GO connections are randomized, present even before training in the encoder, and learned in the decoder. Regularized soft links outside GO (GONNECT-SL) are unstable across runs and concentrate where the ontology is sparse, compensating for the prior's constraints rather than revealing new biology. Within this setting, we find no evidence that node activations capture biological information beyond that encoded by the predefined gene sets, suggesting that their apparent interpretability largely reflects the prior imposed by the architecture.
items.authors: Verlaan, T.; Lieftinck, M.; Mwine, W.; Reinders, M.
items.title_zh: 对生物信息神经网络中基因本体先验的批判性评估
items.summary_zh: 生物信息神经网络（BINNs）将基因本体（GO）等先验知识嵌入其架构中，以生成可解释的表示，但这种先验是否以及如何改善性能或解释仍不明确。我们提出了GONNECT，一个将GO融入自编码器的BINN。我们评估了在编码器、解码器或两者中施加GO约束对来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的RNA-seq肿瘤样本的影响，并与已发表的BINNs（OntoVAE、VEGA）、无约束基线、随机先验和未训练网络进行比较。在各种性能指标中，GO结构对重建或潜在空间组织的贡献有限，常常被随机或无约束模型匹配。节点激活与基因集富集分析（GSEA）衍生的参考结果一致，但这种一致性主要源于架构约束：当GO连接被随机化时，这种一致性消失，且在编码器中训练前就已存在，并在解码器中学习到。超参数软连接（GONNECT-SL）在不同运行中不稳定，并集中在本体稀疏的地方，补偿了先验的约束，而非揭示新的生物学信息。在这种情况下，我们未发现节点激活捕捉到超出预定义基因集编码的生物信息，表明其表面可解释性主要是由先验决定的。
items.l1_lead: 生物信息神经网络中嵌入基因本体的先验知识对性能和解释的提升有限，且其可解释性主要受架构约束影响，而非揭示新的生物学信息。
items.l2_summary:
生物信息神经网络（BINNs）在其架构中嵌入基因本体（Gene Ontology, GO）等先验知识，以期生成可解释的表示。然而，关于这些先验知识是否以及如何改善模型性能或解释能力仍然不明确。为此，研究团队提出了GONNECT，一个将GO融入自编码器的BINN。研究评估了在编码器、解码器或两者中施加GO约束对来自癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas, TCGA）的RNA-seq肿瘤样本的影响，并与已发表的BINNs（如OntoVAE、VEGA）、无约束基线、随机先验和未训练网络进行了比较。

研究结果显示，在多项性能指标中，GO结构对重建或潜在空间组织的贡献有限，常常与随机或无约束模型的表现相当。尽管节点激活与基因集富集分析（Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, GSEA）衍生的参考结果一致，但这种一致性主要源于架构约束。当GO连接被随机化时，这种一致性消失，且在编码器中训练前就已存在，并在解码器中学习到。此外，超参数软连接（GONNECT-SL）在不同运行中表现出不稳定性，并集中在本体稀疏的地方，显示出其更多是对先验约束的补偿，而非揭示新的生物学信息。

在这种情况下，研究未发现节点激活能够捕捉到超出预定义基因集编码的生物信息，这表明其表面可解释性主要是由先验决定的。综上所述，GONNECT的研究结果对GO在生物信息神经网络中的应用提出了批判性评估，强调了先验知识在模型性能和解释性中的局限性。

items.title: Histology-aware Inference of Cell-cell Communication in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.abstract: Cell-cell communication (CCC) is fundamental to tissue organization and function, yet inferring communication from spatial transcriptomics (ST) remains challenging because molecular and spatial information does not fully capture the anatomical context of signaling. Paired hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained images provide complementary insights into tissue architecture and cellular morphology, which remain underutilized as the explicit contextual constraint of CCC inference. Here we present HARMONIC, a histology-aware graph learning framework for anatomically contextualized CCC inference from ST and H&E images. HARMONIC uses conditional mutual information to model dependencies among tissue architecture, ligand-receptor-mediated signaling, gene expression and morphology, and integrates these representations through self-supervised graph learning. Across synthetic and biological datasets spanning platforms, species and tissues, HARMONIC suppresses less anatomically plausible interactions while recovering context-supported signaling across tumor-immune interfaces, necrotic transitions, anatomical compartments and microvascular structures. These findings establish tissue architecture as the explicit contextual constraint of spatial CCC inference.
items.authors: Wang, X.; Tao, C.; Jiang, Y.; Jiang, Y.; Liu, H.; Jiang, Z.; Zhu, P.; Que, N.; Xi, J.; Price, S.; Qian, B.; Xu, J.; Li, C.
items.title_zh: 基于组织学的空间转录组细胞间通信推断
items.summary_zh: 细胞间通信（CCC）对组织的构建和功能至关重要，但从空间转录组（ST）推断通信仍然具有挑战性，因为分子和空间信息无法完全捕捉信号的解剖背景。配对的苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色图像为组织结构和细胞形态提供了互补的见解，但在CCC推断中未得到充分利用。本文提出了HARMONIC，一个基于组织学的图学习框架，用于从ST和H&E图像中进行解剖背景的CCC推断。HARMONIC使用条件互信息建模组织结构、配体-受体介导的信号、基因表达和形态之间的依赖关系，并通过自监督图学习整合这些表示。在跨平台、物种和组织的合成和生物数据集中，HARMONIC抑制了不太符合解剖学的交互，同时恢复了肿瘤-免疫界面、坏死转变、解剖区室和微血管结构中的背景支持信号。这些发现确立了组织结构作为空间CCC推断的明确上下文约束。
items.l1_lead: HARMONIC框架通过整合空间转录组和组织学图像，成功推断细胞间通信，强调组织结构在解剖背景中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
细胞间通信（Cell-Cell Communication, CCC）在组织的构建和功能中扮演着重要角色，但从空间转录组（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）中推断这种通信仍面临挑战，因为现有的分子和空间信息无法充分捕捉信号的解剖背景。配对的苏木精-伊红（Hematoxylin and Eosin, H&E）染色图像能够提供组织结构和细胞形态的互补视角，但在CCC推断中尚未得到充分利用。为此，本文提出了一种名为HARMONIC的基于组织学的图学习框架，旨在从ST和H&E图像中进行解剖背景的CCC推断。

HARMONIC通过条件互信息建模组织结构、配体-受体介导的信号、基因表达和细胞形态之间的依赖关系，并利用自监督图学习方法整合这些表示。该框架在多个跨平台、物种和组织的合成及生物数据集中表现出色，能够有效抑制那些不符合解剖学的细胞间交互，同时恢复肿瘤-免疫界面、坏死转变、解剖区室及微血管结构中的背景支持信号。这些结果表明，组织结构可以作为空间CCC推断的明确上下文约束，从而为理解细胞间通信提供了新的视角和方法。

通过HARMONIC框架的应用，研究者能够更准确地推断细胞间的信号传递机制，进而为组织的生物学功能和病理状态提供更深入的理解。这一研究不仅拓展了空间转录组学的应用范围，也为未来的细胞间通信研究提供了新的工具和思路。

items.title: 'broadSeq', a benchmarking tool to contrast differential gene expression methods and identify when genomic neighbourhood matters
items.abstract: Several tools are available to detect differential gene expression. The predominant approach of different statistical methods is to consider changes in gene expression independent from their genomic context. Previously, DELocal was introduced that takes into consideration gene expression dynamics in the genomic neighbourhood. Whereas DELocal was shown to identify developmentally regulated genes in developing mouse tooth, its performance in other biological conditions remains undetermined. To benchmark DElocal together with other methods, we develop another tool 'broadSeq'. It provides easy to use interface for methods like DELocal , deseq2, limma, edger, EBSeq and many more. Here we report benchmarking results on different data sets that comprise wild type developing mouse organs from different embryonic time points, and also human cancer data. The examined datasets are from the heart, kidney, liver, brain, forebrain, and hindbrain. We found that most methods produce relatively comparable lists of differentially expressed genes. Nevertheless, DELocal identifies partially distinct sets of genes compared to the other methods. Evaluating the identified genes using gene and disease ontology terms show that the uniquely detected genes by DELocal are biologically relevant and also highly expressed compared to the genes identified by the other methods. Because consistently highly expressed genes show relatively subtle fold changes, the neighbourhood concept of DELocal appears to correct for the difficulty in detecting these differential expression of highly expressed genes. Finally, we provide the tools as combined bioconductor packages, allowing researchers to explore and decide the best methods for their data and questions.
items.authors: Das Roy, R.; Hallikas, O.; Kuure, S.; Jernvall, J.
items.title_zh: 'broadSeq'：对比差异基因表达方法的基准工具
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了'broadSeq'工具，用于对比多种差异基因表达（DE）方法，包括DELocal、deseq2、limma、edger和EBSeq等。以小鼠发育器官和人类癌症数据为研究对象，分析了来自心脏、肾脏、肝脏、大脑、前脑和后脑的不同数据集。结果显示，大多数方法产生的差异表达基因列表相对可比。然而，DELocal识别的基因集与其他方法部分不同。通过基因和疾病本体术语评估发现，DELocal独特检测的基因在生物学上具有相关性，并且表达水平较高。这表明DELocal在特定生物条件下的有效性。
items.l1_lead: 本研究开发的'broadSeq'工具对比多种差异基因表达方法，发现DELocal在特定生物条件下有效识别具有生物学相关性的差异基因。
items.l2_summary:
本研究开发了一个名为'broadSeq'的工具，旨在对比多种差异基因表达（DE, Differential Expression）方法，包括DELocal、deseq2、limma、edger和EBSeq等。研究对象涵盖了小鼠发育器官和人类癌症数据，具体分析了来自心脏、肾脏、肝脏、大脑、前脑和后脑的不同数据集。研究结果表明，大多数方法所产生的差异表达基因列表在一定程度上是可比的，显示出这些方法在识别差异基因方面的相似性。然而，DELocal所识别的基因集与其他方法相比存在部分差异，显示出其独特性。

通过对基因和疾病本体术语的评估，发现DELocal独特检测的基因在生物学上具有显著相关性，并且这些基因的表达水平普遍较高。这一发现表明，DELocal在特定生物条件下的有效性，可能为研究特定疾病或生物过程提供了新的视角和工具。总体而言，'broadSeq'工具的开发为差异基因表达分析提供了一个重要的基准，促进了不同方法之间的比较与评估，为后续的生物医学研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Cell Painting and machine learning for mechanistic profiling of hepatotoxic botanicals and their constituents
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Botanicals are widely consumed as herbal remedies and plant-derived products, but their complex and variable chemical composition presents major challenges for safety assessment. Although hepatotoxicity has been reported for several botanicals, the constituent compounds responsible and the underlying mechanisms often remain poorly characterised. OBJECTIVES We aimed to determine whether Cell Painting could identify candidate constituent drivers of botanical bioactivity and generate hypotheses about potential mechanisms of action in primary human hepatocytes. METHODS We profiled 13 botanical extracts and 85 known constituents across multiple concentrations using Cell Painting alongside assays of metabolic activity and membrane integrity. To interpret morphological phenotypes, we trained machine-learning models using a Cell Painting reference atlas of >1,000 chemicals linked to ToxCast/Tox21 molecular and cellular bioactivity annotations. RESULTS Cell Painting detected bioactivity in 11/13 botanical extracts and 46/85 constituents, compared with 9/13 extracts and 40/85 constituents in the cell-health assays, and generally detected activity at lower concentrations. For 9/13 extracts, at least one constituent was active at a lower concentration than the corresponding botanical extract, supporting the contribution of a subset of potent constituents to mixture-level responses. Aristolochia and goldenseal were the most potent extracts across Cell Painting and cell-health assays and contained highly active constituents. Reference-atlas models generated specific mechanistic hypotheses, including cytotoxicity-, endocrine-, and genotoxicity-associated responses for several botanicals and constituents. CONCLUSION These results support Cell Painting combined with machine learning as a sensitive approach for characterising cellular responses to botanicals, prioritising candidate constituent drivers of hepatotoxicity-associated phenotypes, and generating testable hypotheses about potential mechanisms of action.
items.authors: Ollitrault, G.; Mitchell, C. A.; Ferguson, S. S.; Roe, A. L.; White, B.; Titterton, K.; Ewald, J.
items.title_zh: 细胞绘图与机器学习用于肝毒性植物及其成分的机制分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：植物广泛用于草药和植物衍生产品，但其复杂多变的化学成分给安全评估带来了挑战。尽管已有多种植物报告了肝毒性，但负责的成分及其机制仍不明确。目标：本研究旨在确定细胞绘图是否能识别植物生物活性的候选成分，并生成关于潜在作用机制的假设。方法：我们使用细胞绘图对13种植物提取物和85种已知成分进行多浓度分析，同时评估代谢活性和膜完整性。为了解释形态表型，我们训练了机器学习模型，使用了与ToxCast/Tox21分子和细胞生物活性注释相关的超过1000种化学物质的细胞绘图参考图谱。结果：细胞绘图在11/13种植物提取物和46/85种成分中检测到了生物活性，而细胞健康检测中分别为9/13和40/85，且通常在较低浓度下检测到活性。对于9/13种提取物，至少有一种成分在低于相应植物提取物的浓度下表现出活性，支持了部分有效成分对混合物反应的贡献。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，细胞绘图结合机器学习能够有效识别植物及其成分的生物活性，为肝毒性机制的理解提供了新的线索。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了细胞绘图（cell painting）与机器学习在分析肝毒性植物及其成分机制中的应用。植物因其复杂多变的化学成分而广泛用于草药和植物衍生产品，但这也给安全评估带来了挑战。尽管已有多种植物被报告具有肝毒性，但具体负责的成分及其作用机制尚不明确。研究的目标是确定细胞绘图是否能够识别植物生物活性的候选成分，并生成关于潜在作用机制的假设。

研究中，研究团队对13种植物提取物和85种已知成分进行了多浓度分析，评估了其代谢活性和膜完整性。为了解释形态表型，研究者训练了机器学习模型，利用了与ToxCast/Tox21分子和细胞生物活性注释相关的超过1000种化学物质的细胞绘图参考图谱。结果显示，细胞绘图在11/13种植物提取物和46/85种成分中检测到了生物活性，而在细胞健康检测中，分别为9/13和40/85，且通常在较低浓度下检测到活性。这表明细胞绘图能够有效识别植物及其成分的生物活性。

值得注意的是，对于9/13种提取物，至少有一种成分在低于相应植物提取物的浓度下表现出活性，这支持了部分有效成分对混合物反应的贡献。综上所述，本研究不仅展示了细胞绘图与机器学习结合的潜力，还为进一步理解植物肝毒性成分及其作用机制提供了重要的实验依据。通过这种方法，未来的研究可以更有效地识别和评估植物成分的安全性，推动草药和植物衍生产品的安全使用。

items.title: CLEAR-FORCE: A reservoir computing framework for closed-loop brain stimulation
items.abstract: Electrical stimulation of brain activity has emerged as a key therapeutic intervention for neurological diseases. The success of these approaches relies on precisely tuned stimulation parameters. A major challenge is that these parameters should ideally be adjusted in real-time based on changes in brain activity. Closed-loop controllers address this challenge by monitoring brain activity and adapting stimulation according to ongoing changes in neural dynamics. While machine learning has been helpful in this context, closed-loop controllers typically do not adapt in real-time to fluctuations in brain activity. Here, we propose a novel framework based on reservoir computing to train a closed-loop, real-time neural controller. This approach, termed CLEAR-FORCE, trains the output weights of a recurrent network based on a combination of target signals and feedback from brain activity. Two series of simulations were performed, where the controller was successful at (1) inducing neural oscillations in a population of spiking neurons and (2) suppressing pathological oscillations. This framework provides a promising avenue for the implementation of neural controllers in low-powered, real-time, and adaptive hardware that harnesses machine learning for the personalized treatment of brain disorders.
items.authors: Moreno-Gris, A.; Godin, C.; Thivierge, J.-P.

items.title: Impaired Control Symptoms in Alcohol Use Disorder Show Convergent Associations Across Behavioral and Neural Markers of Inhibitory Control and Drinking Behavior
items.abstract: Background: Deficits in inhibitory control are considered a central feature of alcohol use disorder (AUD), yet behavioral and neuroimaging findings have been inconsistent. One potential explanation is the marked heterogeneity of AUD, which encompasses multiple symptom dimensions that may differ in their underlying neurocognitive mechanisms. In this study, we investigated whether behavioral and neural markers of inhibitory control are associated with specific DSM-5 AUD symptom domains. Methods: A total of 589 participants (432 with non-treatment seeking AUD, 157 controls) completed a Stop-Signal Task (SST) during fMRI. Associations between DSM-5 symptom domains (impaired control over alcohol use, risky use, social problems, physical dependence) and SST performance, inhibition-related brain activation, and alcohol consumption were examined. Real-life drinking behavior was additionally assessed over 12 months using ecological momentary assessment (EMA). Results: Greater impaired control symptom severity was associated with poorer performance on go trials and diminished post-error slowing during SST. At the neural level, higher impaired control symptom severity was associated with reduced activation across fronto-insular, parietal, cingulate, supplementary motor, and cerebellar regions. In contrast, other symptom domains showed little to no associations with inhibition-related behavioral or neural measures. Higher impaired control symptom severity was associated with greater alcohol consumption across questionnaire-based and EMA-based assessments. Conclusions: In this large cohort, altered behavioral performance and recruitment of inhibition-related brain regions in the SST was selectively linked to impaired control symptoms. These findings highlight the importance of symptom-based approaches for understanding heterogeneity in addiction and may inform the development of more targeted interventions.

items.title: Cerebral hemodynamics and cytochrome c oxidase in hypoxic-ischemic rabbit fetuses
items.abstract: Background: Understanding fetal brain responses to hypoxia-ischemia is of growing interest, as it remains unclear to what extent these responses differ from those of newborns and whether developmental adaptations during gestation contribute to such differences. Materials and methods: Using a combination of broadband near-infrared spectroscopy (bNIRS) and diffuse correlation spectroscopy (DCS), we measured brain microvascular oxygen saturation (StO2), total hemoglobin concentration (THC), relative cerebral blood flow (rCBF), and the oxidation state of cytochrome c oxidase (oxCCO) during an acute ischemic challenge in the brains of five rabbit fetuses in utero. Simultaneous measurements were acquired from four control fetuses located in the contralateral uterine horn. Results: During the hypoxia-ischemia phase, we observed a rapid reduction of CBF (47% +/- 29%) and StO2, (from 64.7% +/- 1.5% at baseline to 40.6% +/- 2.0%) together with an increase of oxCCO (3.7 uM +/- 0.5 uM). Conclusion: The simultaneous increase in oxCCO and decrease in rCBF and StO2 during hypoxia-ischemia reveals a cerebral response pattern that differs from that commonly reported in the newborn brain. These findings support the hypothesis that unique developmental adaptations influence fetal cerebral metabolism during hypoxic-ischemic stress.
items.authors: Cortese, L.; Lo Presti, G.; Berdun, S.; Bale, G.; Kovacsova, Z.; Eixarch, E.; Gratacos, E.; Tachtsidis, I.; Durduran, T.

items.title: Default Mode Network Connectivity Is Associated with Capture by Distractors Assigned to Learned Spatial Regularities
items.abstract: Salient distractors interfere with visual search, but observers can learn to filter out distractors that occur frequently and in predictable locations. We examined whether within-default-mode-network (DMN) task-run connectivity was associated with distractor capture and its location-dependent modulation in task-fMRI data from two groups in which either orientation or color distractors carried a spatial-probability bias. Higher within-DMN connectivity was associated with greater distractor capture by the biased distractor dimension, which was also the most frequent distractor type, whereas capture by the unbiased dimension was essentially unrelated to connectivity. A hierarchical trial-level model also showed stronger DMN-distractor-capture coupling for the biased than for the unbiased dimension when both were evaluated under the same frequent-/rare-region weighting. DMN connectivity was also associated with spatial-probability learning, indexed by the rare-minus-frequent reaction-time difference on biased-dimension trials, but this association was closely tied to overall capture. When the physical distractor dimension was held constant, orientation showed stronger DMN-distractor-capture coupling when it carried the spatial bias; in contrast, the corresponding color comparison remained uncertain. The broader network analyses provided converging support for this DMN-distractor-capture coupling pattern. Higher DMN connectivity was thus not associated with poorer performance in general, but with less effective filtering of the distractor that the task set was tuned to suppress. This pattern is consistent with a DMN state that interferes with implementing the optimal task set.
items.authors: Chen, S.; Mueller, H. J.; Shi, Z.

items.title: Physicians' Industrial Action: An Interrupted Time Series Analysis Assessing Impact in 11 Kenyan Neonatal Units
items.abstract: Background. Skilled healthcare workers are essential for neonatal survival; however, the Kenyan public health system has historically faced strikes compounded by a human resource crisis. Evidence on how strikes affect neonatal care and mortality remains limited. This study evaluated changes in neonatal admissions, clinical care processes, and inpatient mortality associated with 56 days of disruption during the 2024 Kenyan physicians' strike. Methods. We conducted a retrospective interrupted time-series analysis of 12,184 admissions to 11 Kenyan neonatal units implementing with the NEST360 Alliance, recorded in the Neonatal Inpatient Dataset from December 2023 to August 2024. Weekly admissions and inpatient mortality were modeled over a 72-week window (27,638 admissions) using hospital-clustered generalized estimating equations with seasonal terms. Care processes, case fatality, and birthweight-specific mortality were compared across study periods. Results. Weekly admissions fell from 413 to 189 during the strike (incidence rate ratio (IRR) 0.49, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.31-0.75), approximately 1,700 fewer admissions than expected, and returned to baseline afterward (IRR 1.00, CI 0.81-1.23). Newborns admitted during the strike were of lower birthweight, more often premature, and more often outborn. Admissions fell across all birth-location categories, most steeply among inborn neonates. No measurable change was detected in documented inpatient coverage of care measures, in crude mortality (12.5% to 14.9%; risk ratio (RR) 1.07, CI 0.85-1.33), or in trend-adjusted mortality (IRR 0.88, CI 0.53-1.45). Case fatality among neonates with recorded infection doubled, from 4.7% to 9.6% (RR 2.06, CI 1.18-3.58; adjusted p = 0.047). Conclusions. The 2024 physicians' strike was associated with severe disruption to neonatal service utilization, with admissions returning to baseline when the strike ended. Among newborns who continued to reach care, inpatient mortality did not change measurably, but case fatality among those with recorded infection doubled. This analysis was confined to inpatient data; hence, the outcomes of newborns who did not reach the hospitals were not captured. Both inpatient and population-level data are needed to assess the full impact of the strike. Mitigating harm during future labor disruptions requires interventions such as resilient care models, formalized task-shifting protocols, and minimum service coverage agreements.
items.authors: Paral, M. M.; Manyasi, C.; Wainaina, J.; Okello, G.; Mochache, D. R.; Mwaniki, H.; Muinde, D. M.; Okech, F. O.; Lawn, J. E.; Rhoda, N. R.; Richards-Kortum, R.; Oden, Z. items.title: Comparing immersive mindfulness and nature interventions for managing preoperative distress in breast cancer patients: A randomized controlled trial.
items.abstract: Preoperative distress in breast cancer patients is highly prevalent and associated with adverse post-surgical outcomes. While both virtual reality (VR) distraction and mindfulness exercises have been increasingly utilized to manage this distress, the clinical impact of integrating active mindfulness meditation into the immersive experience remains under-investigated. Here, we present a pilot randomized controlled trial evaluating the feasibility, acceptability and preliminary efficacy of brief, first-time immersive nature and mindfulness interventions for patients admitted to the holding area prior to the operating room for breast cancer surgery. Sixty participants were randomized to receive an 8-minute preoperative VR experience with mindfulness instruction (VR+Meditation), a standard VR nature experience without audio guidance (VR Only), or Care-as-Usual (CAU). The intervention was feasible and well tolerated with zero patient dropout and minimal indications of cybersickness or general discomfort. Outcomes included patient-reported anxiety and fear, physiological measures, and a computational semantic analysis of post-operative patient interviews. Compared with standard care, both VR interventions significantly reduced self-reported anxiety and heart rate. Although no significant differences were observed between the two active intervention groups, the VR+Meditation group demonstrated a significant and clinically meaningful reduction in surgery-specific fear relative to standard care. Analysis of brief patient interviews provided convergent evidence supporting these findings, showing that patients receiving VR+Meditation used language more strongly aligned with relief than those receiving standard care. These findings suggest that immersive VR represents a feasible and well-tolerated first-time immersive intervention for reducing preoperative distress in patients undergoing breast cancer surgery. The addition of guided mindfulness may provide additional benefit by specifically addressing surgery-related fear, supporting the hypothesis that different digital interventions may target distinct dimensions of preoperative distress. Larger randomized studies are warranted to confirm these preliminary findings. Author summaryWaiting for breast cancer surgery is an incredibly stressful experience, and high levels of anxiety before an operation can negatively impact a patients recovery and mental health. Because surgical wards are fast-paced, providing individualized psychological support in the moments just before an operation is challenging. In this study, we tested whether an immersive Virtual Reality (VR) experience may help reduce preoperative distress by transporting patients to a calming digital environment immediately before surgery. We compared standard VR distraction with the same immersive experience combined with guided mindfulness meditation. Both VR interventions reduced anxiety and heart rate compared with standard care. Only the group receiving VR with guided mindfulness showed a significant reduction in surgery-related fear and, when describing their experience after surgery, used language more strongly associated with relief. Our findings suggest that immersive interventions provided to patients for the first time on the day of surgery can provide simple, well-tolerated psychological support during one of the most stressful moments in the patient journey. They also suggest that different digital approaches may influence different aspects of preoperative distress, with guided mindfulness offering additional support for surgery-related fear.
items.authors: Pinto, D.; Andres-Luna, R.; Sandru, R.; Mavioso, C.; Correia-Anacleto, J.; Pedro, G.; Cruz, A.; Vaz, P.; Travado, L.; Mainen, Z. F.; Cardoso, M. J.; Rennie, S.; Fettweis-Netto, L.
items.title_zh: 比较沉浸式正念与自然干预对乳腺癌患者术前焦虑的影响
items.summary_zh: 乳腺癌患者术前焦虑普遍存在，且与术后不良结果相关。本研究评估了沉浸式自然和正念干预对术前焦虑的可行性、可接受性及初步疗效。60名参与者随机接受8分钟的虚拟现实（VR）体验，分为VR+正念组、标准VR自然体验组和常规护理组。干预可行且耐受性良好，无患者退出，网络晕动症和不适感极少。结果显示，与常规护理相比，两个VR干预组均显著降低了自报焦虑和心率。尽管两个主动干预组之间未观察到显著差异，但VR+正念组表现出更好的效果。
items.l1_lead: 沉浸式正念与自然干预均能显著降低乳腺癌患者术前焦虑，且VR+正念组效果更佳，干预可行且耐受性良好。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对乳腺癌患者术前焦虑问题进行了评估，旨在比较沉浸式正念（mindfulness）与自然干预对患者术前焦虑的影响。乳腺癌患者在手术前普遍存在焦虑情绪，这种焦虑与术后不良结果密切相关，因此寻找有效的干预措施显得尤为重要。研究共招募了60名参与者，随机分为三组：VR+正念组、标准VR自然体验组和常规护理组。所有参与者均接受了8分钟的虚拟现实（VR）体验，研究重点评估了干预的可行性、可接受性及初步疗效。

结果显示，所有干预均表现出良好的可行性和耐受性，且没有参与者因不适而退出，网络晕动症和不适感的发生率极低。通过比较，发现与常规护理组相比，两个VR干预组在自报焦虑和心率方面均显著降低，表明VR干预在缓解术前焦虑方面具有积极效果。尽管VR+正念组与标准VR自然体验组之间未观察到显著差异，但VR+正念组的效果相对更佳，提示沉浸式正念干预可能在缓解焦虑方面具有潜在优势。

综上所述，本研究表明沉浸式正念与自然干预在降低乳腺癌患者术前焦虑方面均具有可行性和有效性，尤其是VR+正念组显示出更好的效果，为未来的临床应用提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Electronic health record (EHR)-detectable statin intolerance phenotypes: Prevalence and validation in real-world general practice
items.abstract: Aims: This study aimed to identify patients with statin intolerance and estimate the prevalence of statin intolerance among patients prescribed statins for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease using electronic health record (EHR) data. It also aimed to identify, implement, and evaluate the performance of EHR-detectable electronic phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance. Methods: This study used the Electronic Practice Based Research Network (ePBRN) dataset. The methodology took place in four stages: (1) a literature review to identify EHR-detectable phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance, (2) implementation of the identified algorithms in the ePBRN dataset, (3) development and implementation of a reference standard, and (4) evaluation of algorithm performance against the reference standard. Results: Six EHR-detectable electronic phenotyping algorithms for statin intolerance were identified, including the Minnesota Combined Rule-Based algorithm, Japan statin induced myopathy (SIMs), USA SIMs, Singapore SIMs (algorithms A, B, C, and D), Japan statin-associated muscle toxicity (SAMT), and NHS-UK statin intolerance pathway. The prevalence of statin intolerance in the ePBRN dataset was 5.09%. No algorithm performed consistently well across all performance measures. The Singapore SIMs-B algorithm showed the highest accuracy (57.05%), sensitivity (92.95%), negative predictive value (43.43%), and F1 (71.51%) scores, while the Japan SAMT algorithm showed the highest specificity (99.13%), and positive predictive value (76.19%). Overall correspondence with the reference standard was weak, with correlation coefficients ranging from approximately -0.02 to 0.05. Conclusion: The prevalence of statin intolerance in ePBRN dataset was at the lower end of the 5-15% estimates reported in Australia and internationally.
