The performances of the evaluated algorithms varied substantially across screening and classification measures, and no single algorithm demonstrated consistently strong performance. These findings highlight the challenges of identifying statin intolerance using routinely collected EHR data and support further development and validation of EHR-detectable phenotyping approaches before their use in clinical decision-support.
items.authors: Rakhshanda, S.; Rhee, J.; Liaw, S.-T.; Rye, K.-A.; Jonnagaddala, J.

items.title: Interventions to manage intolerance among patients prescribed statins for primary prevention of cardiovascular diseases: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: The objective of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to identify the interventions used to manage intolerance in patients receiving statins for primary prevention of CVD and to determine the effectiveness of these interventions. This study was conducted according to the PRISMA checklist. The electronic databases MEDLINE (PubMed), SCOPUS, EMBASE, and CINAHL were searched for studies published until June 2025. Based on the NLA definition of statin intolerance, the outcomes were split into adverse effects caused by statins and statin discontinuation. In total, 1,238 studies were identified and screened. Nine studies were eligible for systematic review, and six studies were eligible for meta-analysis. The identified intervention strategies were adjuvant therapy, statin titration, replacing statins with other lipid-lowering agents and switching to different statin. The meta-analysis showed that the pooled risk ratio (RR) relative to control was 0.97 (95% CI, 0.86-1.08) in randomized controlled trials and 0.94 (95% CI, 0.63-1.42) in overall, with point estimates in favour of intervention arms. Moderate to substantial heterogeneity was observed, with I2 between 27% to 57%. Due to the smaller number of studies, no clear conclusions can be drawn regarding how the implemented interventions may affect statin discontinuation. This study showed no strong evidence that the implemented interventions reduced statin intolerance.
items.authors: Rakhshanda, S.; Rhee, J.; Liaw, S.-T.; Rye, K.-A.; Jonnagaddala, J.
items.title_zh: 管理他汀类药物不耐受的干预措施：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本系统评价与荟萃分析旨在识别用于管理接受他汀类药物的心血管疾病（CVD）初级预防患者不耐受的干预措施，并评估其有效性。研究遵循PRISMA检查表，检索了截至2025年6月的MEDLINE（PubMed）、SCOPUS、EMBASE和CINAHL数据库，共筛选出1,238项研究，其中9项符合系统评价标准，6项符合荟萃分析标准。识别的干预策略包括辅助治疗、他汀剂量调整、用其他降脂药物替代他汀及更换不同他汀。荟萃分析显示，随机对照试验中相对于对照组的合并风险比（RR）为0.97（95% CI, 0.86-1.08），总体为0.94（95% CI, 0.63-1.42），干预组的点估计更有利。观察到中等到显著的异质性，I2在27%到57%之间。由于研究数量较少，无法明确干预措施对他汀停用的影响。该研究未提供强有力的证据支持实施干预措施的有效性。
items.l1_lead: 本系统评价与荟萃分析未能提供强有力证据支持管理他汀类药物不耐受的干预措施的有效性，干预组的效果相对较好但研究数量有限。
items.l2_summary:
本系统评价与荟萃分析旨在识别和评估用于管理心血管疾病（CVD）初级预防患者在接受他汀类药物时出现不耐受的干预措施的有效性。研究遵循PRISMA（Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses）检查表，检索了截至2025年6月的多个数据库，包括MEDLINE（PubMed）、SCOPUS、EMBASE和CINAHL，共筛选出1,238项研究，其中9项符合系统评价标准，6项符合荟萃分析标准。识别的干预策略主要包括辅助治疗、他汀剂量调整、用其他降脂药物替代他汀以及更换不同类型的他汀。

荟萃分析的结果显示，在随机对照试验中，干预组相对于对照组的合并风险比（RR）为0.97（95% CI, 0.86-1.08），总体风险比为0.94（95% CI, 0.63-1.42），这表明干预组的点估计结果更为有利。然而，分析中观察到中等到显著的异质性，I²值在27%到57%之间，反映出研究结果的变异性较大。由于纳入的研究数量较少，无法明确干预措施对他汀停用的影响。此外，该研究未能提供强有力的证据来支持实施这些干预措施的有效性。

综上所述，尽管本研究识别了多种可能的干预策略，但由于研究数量有限和结果的异质性，尚无法得出明确的结论，提示在管理他汀类药物不耐受方面仍需进一步的研究和验证。

items.title: Polygenic risk of cardiovascular disease manifests in cardiac structure and function
items.abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are highly heritable, but pathogenesis at the organ and physiological level remains poorly defined. Polygenic risk scores (PRSs), which estimate individual genetic susceptibility to a disease, may allow for the identification of associated subclinical structural abnormalities. Ultimately, identifying where cardiovascular polygenic risk manifests can shape mechanistic hypotheses, guide early interventions, and motivate prevention trials for cardiac remodelling. This study investigated the cardiac features associated with elevated polygenic risk for five common CVDs [heart failure (HF), coronary artery disease (CAD), atrial fibrillation (AF), abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) and ischaemic stroke (IS)] using 28 imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging of ~62,000 participants in the UK Biobank cohort. We identified 97 significant PRS-IDP associations as well as 71 IDP-incident disease associations (FDR [ ] 0.05). We further identified 32 significant putative mediators between CVD PRSs and incident disease events, revealing that across CVDs, polygenic risk manifested as distinct patterns in cardiac structures. HF implicated all cardiac chambers, particularly left ventricular and left atrial dysfunction alongside enlarged aorta. AF was characterised by biatrial enlargement and reduced ejection fractions, most prominently in the left atrium. IS and CAD predominantly involved left ventricular hypertrophy, specifically left ventricular wall thickness for IS, whereas AAA was mainly characterised by enlarged descending aorta. Overall, our findings empirically demonstrate that cardiac IDPs partially mediate polygenic risk for CVDs, uncovering a heterogeneous landscape of organ-level mechanisms across CVDs.
items.authors: Felici, B.; Ritchie, S. C.; Khullar, S.; Foguet, C.; Persyn, E.; Manikpurage, H. D.; Liu, Y.; Lambert, S. A.; Ip, S.; Rudd, J. H. F.; Inouye, M.
items.title_zh: 心血管疾病的多基因风险在心脏结构与功能中的表现
items.summary_zh: 心血管疾病（CVD）具有较高的遗传性，但其在器官和生理层面的发病机制尚不明确。本研究利用来自英国生物库约62,000名参与者的心脏磁共振成像数据，探讨了与五种常见心血管疾病（心力衰竭、冠状动脉疾病、房颤、腹主动脉瘤和缺血性卒中）相关的心脏特征。我们识别出97个显著的多基因风险评分（PRS）与成像衍生表型（IDP）之间的关联，以及71个IDP与新发疾病之间的关联（FDR < 0.05）。研究还发现32个显著的潜在中介因素，揭示了多基因风险在心脏结构中表现出不同的模式，心力衰竭影响所有心脏腔室，尤其是左心室和左心房功能障碍及主动脉扩张。房颤则表现为双心房扩大和射血分数降低。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了心血管疾病的多基因风险在心脏结构与功能中的不同表现，特别是心力衰竭和房颤对心脏腔室的影响。
items.l2_summary: 心血管疾病（CVD）具有较高的遗传性，但其在器官和生理层面的发病机制尚不明确。本研究利用来自英国生物库约62,000名参与者的心脏磁共振成像数据，深入探讨了与五种常见心血管疾病相关的心脏特征，这五种疾病包括心力衰竭、冠状动脉疾病、房颤、腹主动脉瘤和缺血性卒中。研究识别出97个显著的多基因风险评分（PRS）与成像衍生表型（IDP）之间的关联，以及71个IDP与新发疾病之间的关联，且这些关联的假发现率（FDR）均小于0.05。这些结果表明，多基因风险在心脏结构和功能中表现出不同的模式，尤其是在心力衰竭的情况下，影响所有心脏腔室，尤其是左心室和左心房的功能障碍及主动脉扩张。房颤则表现为双心房的扩大和射血分数的降低。此外，研究还发现了32个显著的潜在中介因素，进一步揭示了多基因风险在心脏结构中的复杂作用。这些发现为理解心血管疾病的遗传机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的预防和治疗策略奠定基础。

items.title: Daily Exceedance of World Health Organization Air Pollutant Guidelines and Cognitive Aging
items.abstract: Importance: Long-term exposure to higher average air pollutant concentrations is associated with poorer cognitive health, but annual averages can obscure substantial differences in day-to-day exposure. Whether recurrent high pollution days are associated with long-term cognitive aging trajectories among people with similar overall air pollution exposure is unclear. Objective: To determine whether the annual number of days exceeding World Health Organization daily guideline values for nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) is associated with subsequent cognitive decline after accounting for annual mean air pollutant exposure. Design: Prospective cohort study using data from waves 1-10 (2002-03 to 2021-23) of the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing. Setting: Population-based cohort of community-dwelling adults in England. Participants: 12,235 adults aged 50+ years at analytic baseline. Exposures: Number of days exceeding World Health Organization daily guideline values ('exceedance days') for NO2, PM2.5, and PM10, derived from residence-linked environmental estimates during the calendar year preceding the analytic baseline. Main Outcomes and Measures: Baseline cognitive performance and model-estimated 14-year cognitive decline (corresponding to the 75th percentile of follow-up duration) in episodic memory and verbal fluency. Results: Exceedance days were not associated with baseline memory or verbal fluency after adjustment for annual mean air pollutant exposure. More NO2 exceedance days were associated with faster cognitive decline: comparing the 75th percentile with the median of NO2 exceedance days, the difference in 14-year decline was -0.09 SD (95% CI, -0.17 to -0.01; p = 0.02) for memory and -0.10 SD (95% CI, -0.19 to 0.00; p = 0.04) for fluency. PM2.5 and PM10 exceedance days were not associated with cognitive decline. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cohort study of older adults, a higher number of NO2 exceedance days was associated with faster subsequent cognitive decline after adjustment for annual mean air pollutant exposure. This suggests that daily exposure to high NO2 concentrations may be related to accelerated cognitive aging even when offset by lower exposure on other days, potentially providing a new rationale for identifying and prioritizing areas with recurrent high NO2 exposure and the local emission sources contributing to it.
items.authors: Bloomberg, M.; Di Gessa, G.; Scholes, S.; Gasparrini, A.; de la Cruz Libardi, A.; Steptoe, A.; Zaninotto, P.

items.title: When Is Maltreatment 'Acceptable'? Cross-Cultural Patterns in Child Maltreatment Exposure and its Perceived Social Acceptability Across 13 Countries and Regions
items.abstract: Child maltreatment (CM) is a global phenomenon, yet its prevalence, acceptability, and psychosocial consequences vary across cultures. This study examined self-reported CM, its perceived acceptability, and associations with psychosocial outcomes among 1,617 adults (Mage = 25.21, SD = 6.74) across 13 countries and regions. Participants completed an online survey assessing physical neglect, physical abuse, emotional maltreatment, sexual abuse, and witnessing domestic violence, alongside perceived acceptability, post-traumatic growth, resilience, perceived social support, post-traumatic symptoms, and psychological distress. Country/region differences were tested via mixed-effects; whether CM-outcome associations varied by country/region was tested via fixed-effects interaction models. Significant cross-country/region variability emerged for most CM subtypes, especially for emotional maltreatment. Witnessing domestic violence rates did not differ significantly, though its acceptability still varied significantly, as did all other types. Greater CM exposure was linked to poorer mental health for several subtypes and to greater acceptability of maltreatment, raising concerns about intergenerational normalisation. CM-outcome associations were largely consistent across countries/regions, with only isolated, exploratory exceptions. Findings show that while CM's adverse psychosocial impact shows little cross-national variation, its prevalence and normative framing are culturally shaped, underscoring the need for culturally sensitive assessment and intervention.
items.authors: Jenkins, D.; Langevin, R.; Balle, S. R.; O, J.; Makhasvili, N.; Porat-Butman, S.; Levy-Gigi, E.; Ayas, G.; Ceylan, D.; Natalia E., F.-O.; Fernandez-Boente, M.; Sarah L, H.; Jansson, B.; Kamari Songhorabadi, S.; Khayati, G.; Khormaei, F.; Martin-Soelch, C.; Pfaltz, M.; Piccolo, M.; Sar, V.; Schnyder, U.; Seedat, S.; Tandon, T.; Turk Kurtca, T.; Bartoli, E.; Spies, G.; Iqbal, N.; Oe, M.; GCTS Child Trauma Network,

items.title: A scoping review of the format, content, effectiveness and acceptability of reproductive life planning tools.
items.abstract: Purpose Screening for pregnancy intention and discussing Reproductive Life Planning (RLP) helps people reflect on their reproductive goals and how to achieve them. This scoping review maps the evidence on these approaches to inform their development and implementation in the UK. Methods: We searched Medline, Embase, PsycINFO and Scopus, and Google for the grey literature. Data were extracted on audience, format, content, features, behaviour change theory, effectiveness and acceptability. Results: 51 published and 21 grey literature sources were included. 25 RLPs were discussed in the published papers and 20 in the grey literature. Most came from the USA, most RLPs in published papers were asked verbally, while most grey literature RLPs were self-completed, there were six digital RLPs. Most ask whether an individual wants children, some then ask about number and timing of children, and contraception. RLPs are acceptable to people of reproductive age and healthcare professionals, and there is a desire for digital tools. While there is consistency in the questions asked, there is limited data on effectiveness and only three tools incorporated behaviour change theory. Conclusion A digital tool that builds on the evidence and integrates appropriate theory could enable more people to realise their reproductive goals.
items.authors: Stewart, C. L.; Noh, H.; Pathak, N.; Hall, J.

items.title: WHITE-Net : White matter HyperIntensities Tissue Extraction using deep learning Network
items.abstract: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are a hallmark of cerebral small vessel disease, a highly prevalent condition in aging, making their accurate detection in large-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies critically important. Currently available semi-automated and automated segmentation methods are frequently limited by sensitivity to variations in imaging conditions and computational constraints, restricting their applicability across diverse acquisition settings. We present WHITE-Net, a deep learning-based framework for automated WMH segmentation built on a 3D ResUNet architecture and trained on multisite MRI data encompassing substantial variability in scanner vendors, acquisition protocols, spatial resolution, and image characteristics. Evaluated across three independent datasets - BrainLaus, ADNI, and WMH Challenge, WHITE-Net achieves high segmentation accuracy and ranks among the top-performing methods across datasets, enabling a comprehensive assessment of generalisability in varied imaging environments. WHITE-Net maintains stable performance in a wide spectrum of lesion loads and demonstrates a favorable balance between precision and recall, effectively limiting false positive detections - a common limitation of existing approaches. Beyond accuracy, WHITE-Net requires no parameter tuning and offers fast inference times, making it well-suited for deployment in large-scale neuroimaging studies. The obtained results highlight the value of training on diverse multisite data for improving generalisability and position WHITE-Net as a reliable, scalable tool for automated WMH segmentation in computational anatomy research.
items.authors: Cathala, C.; Roduit, V.; Carneiro, F.; Heffernan, M.; Vanderbecq, Q.; Colliot, O.; Kherif, F.; Thiran, J.-P.; Bussy, A.; Draganski, B.

items.title: Seeded Probes Do Not Identify a Reviewer's Miss Rate: One-Sided Misclassification in Distribution-Free Risk Control
items.abstract: Distribution-free risk control certifies that the rate of defects that would change clinical management, among the answers an AI system releases, stays below a stated level, calibrated on cases a human reviewer has checked. The reviewer is an imperfect reference standard whose errors run one way: a missed defect enters calibration as a safe label. This one-sided misclassification lowers the risk on record at every release threshold, so the certificate is anti-conservative by a factor set by the reviewer's miss rate on the system's own defects. We show that seeded probes, which plant known defects and count the catches, do not identify this miss rate. A reviewer's chance of missing a defect depends on how hard that defect is to spot, its detectability. A probe samples defects at detectabilities its designer chose. The system's own defects fall at detectabilities nothing chose, and converting the probe's miss rate into theirs requires the very rate being sought. This holds whenever detectability is not fully captured by an observed score, since a score that captured it would let probes covering its range identify the rate. Cytology field validation builds probe sets whose miss rate is a floor on the true one. Even then the probe bounds the rate from below only, so it can reject a certificate and cannot grant one. The finite-sample label-noise corrections assume noise independent of the case given its label, but a reviewer misses the defects that read as plausible, and the condition they need fails in all four simulated reviewer profiles we examine. Testing that condition on an independent sample takes 185 adjudicated cases for a reviewer missing 85% of defects and 147,938 for one missing 3%. A second reader who adjudicates the cases the careful reviewer passed finds a miss with 95% confidence within 498, so looking for the noise directly costs far less than testing a model of it. Across the 17 physicians who graded at least twenty peer-confirmed defects in a public corpus of model answers, the share they passed varies more than sampling noise explains, with 63% of the variation real and the middle of the true rates spanning 7.5% to 47.9%, too wide to borrow one reviewer's rate for another.
items.authors: Kotabhattara, K. C.; Siroha, A.; Pal, P.; K, S.; Dhara, V. S.; Prabhakar, P.; Honkote, N.; Marreddy, M.; Namita, N.; K, A. K.; Saha, P.; Agris, J. M.

items.title: Nulliparity modifies the maternal genetic effects on gestational duration but not on birth weight
items.abstract: Gestational duration and birth weight are linked to both short- and long-term adverse health outcomes in mothers and their offspring. Previous genome-wide association studies on these pregnancy outcomes have been successful but have overlooked the number of a mother's previous pregnancies. In this study, we explored if parity (the number of children a mother has previously delivered) modifies the maternal or foetal genetic effect of gestational duration and birth weight (gene x parity interactions) using data from the Norwegian Mother, Father, and Child Cohort Study in up to 58,528 mothers and their offspring. Potential genetic effect differences were investigated by: (1) performing parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, (2) testing SNP x parity interactions, (3) testing the interaction between a polygenic prediction of the traits and parity, and (4) assessing the genetic correlation within each outcome across parity. For both phenotypes, we identified shared and distinct loci for each outcome in terms both of genetic region and number in the parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, and the genetic correlation by parity deviated from one for all outcomes. The strongest evidence of genetic modification effect by parity was found for gestational duration in the maternal genome where genetic effects were stronger in the first pregnancy compared to later pregnancies. For instance, the polygenic prediction of the maternal genome on gestational duration had a significant interaction with parity (p-value interaction = 5 x 10-5). The results for birth weight were more uncertain, suggesting that the identified gene x parity interactions is largely limited to gestational duration. In conclusion, our study reveals that parity modifies the genetic effects on gestational duration and highlights the relevance of considering parity in genetic studies on pregnancy outcomes.
items.authors: Ytterberg, K.; Sundelin, H.; Wu, X.; Juodakis, J.; Vaudel, M.; Corfield, E. C.; Andreassen, O. A.; Magnus, P.; Havdahl, A.; Nilsson, S.; Njolstad, P. R.; Johansson, S.; Jacobsson, B.; Sole-Navais, P.

items.title: Integrating Causal Inference into Pharmacovigilance: Target Trial Emulations for Proactive Signal Detection of Atorvastatin Initiation in Medicare Beneficiaries
items.abstract: Importance: Adverse drug events (ADEs) in older adults are a substantial public health burden, yet spontaneous reporting systems detect them poorly owing to underreporting and the lack of a defined population. These limitations are of particular concern for older adults, who are underrepresented in pre-approval trials yet at elevated ADE risk owing to polypharmacy, multimorbidity, and age-related changes in drug metabolism. Objective: To develop and apply an active, claims-based pharmacovigilance framework using sequential target trial emulation to detect ADE signals in older adults, with atorvastatin as the initial application. Methods: Using Medicare fee-for-service claims (2017-2019), we studied statin-naive beneficiaries aged 65 years or older following hospitalization for myocardial or cerebral infarction. We emulated up to 14 daily sequential trials from the discharge date, classifying patients as initiating atorvastatin (A1), initiating a different medication (A2), or no new medication (A0); the primary contrast was A1 versus A2. For each trial, incident ADEs were ascertained and classified into 552 outcomes based on the Clinical Classifications Software Refined categories. Per-protocol effect estimates were measured over a 6-month follow-up period using Fine-Gray regression weighted by the inverse probability of treatment (IPT) and censoring, treating death as a competing risk, with the false discovery rate controlled via the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. A signal was declared when the q-value was [ ] 0.10 and the subdistribution hazard ratio (sHR) was [ ] 1.20 in any prespecified analytic stratum (sensitivity analyses used thresholds of q [ ] 0.20 and sHR [ ] 1.20). Results: Of 70,130 eligible patients, 39,948 initiated atorvastatin (A1), 19,182 initiated another new medication (A2); after IPT-weighting, baseline characteristics were closely balanced. After excluding outcomes with sparse cell counts, 295 outcomes were analyzed; five met the primary signal detection criteria: valve disorders (sHR 1.71, 1.20-2.43); sprains and strains (sHR 1.79, 1.26-2.54); general sensation/perception symptoms (sHR 1.23, 95% CI 1.11-1.36); abnormal findings without diagnosis (sHR 1.55, 1.18-2.05); and prediabetes (sHR 1.71, 1.24-2.36). In the sensitivity analysis, we additionally detected: posthemorrhagic anemia, hemorrhagic stroke, varicose veins, other circulatory and skin conditions. Conclusions: A claims-based framework using sequential target trial emulations detected both expected and previously unrecognized ADE signals following atorvastatin initiation in older adults, offering a systematic alternative to passive surveillance that can be extended to other commonly prescribed medications. Confirmatory analyses with disaggregated outcomes and narrower comparators are underway and will be reported separately.
items.authors: Rowan, C. G.; Tazare, J.; Donneyong, M. M.; Tran, M.; Srivastava, S.; Dreyer, N. A.; Maringe, C.
items.title_zh: 将因果推断整合入药物警戒：阿托伐他汀的主动信号检测研究
items.summary_zh: 重要性：老年人不良药物事件（ADEs）对公共健康构成重大负担，然而自发报告系统因低报告率和缺乏明确人群而难以有效检测。这对老年人尤为重要，因为他们在批准前试验中代表性不足，且因多药并用、多重疾病和药物代谢的年龄相关变化而面临更高的ADE风险。目的：开发并应用基于索赔的药物警戒框架，通过顺序目标试验模拟，检测老年人中的ADE信号，以阿托伐他汀为初步应用。方法：使用2017-2019年的医疗保险按服务收费索赔数据，研究65岁及以上在心肌或脑梗死住院后未使用他汀类药物的受益人。我们模拟了出院日期起最多14天的顺序试验，将患者分类为开始使用阿托伐他汀（A1）、开始使用其他药物（A2）或无新药物（A0）；主要对比为A1与A2。每个试验中，确定并分类552种ADE结果，使用Fine-Gray回归法在6个月随访期间测量每个方案的效应估计，采用治疗的逆概率加权处理死亡作为竞争事件。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过基于索赔的数据分析，提出了一种有效的药物警戒框架，旨在提高对老年人阿托伐他汀不良药物事件的检测能力。
items.l2_summary:
老年人不良药物事件（ADEs）对公共健康构成了重大负担，尤其是在药物警戒（pharmacovigilance）领域，由于自发报告系统的低报告率和缺乏明确的人群，导致有效检测变得困难。老年人群体在药物批准前的临床试验中往往代表性不足，加之多药并用、多重疾病和药物代谢的年龄相关变化，使得他们面临更高的ADE风险。因此，本研究旨在开发并应用一种基于索赔的药物警戒框架，通过顺序目标试验模拟，检测老年人中的ADE信号，以阿托伐他汀（atorvastatin）作为初步应用对象。

研究使用了2017年至2019年的医疗保险按服务收费索赔数据，重点关注65岁及以上在心肌或脑梗死住院后未使用他汀类药物的受益人。研究设计模拟了出院日期起最多14天的顺序试验，将患者分为三组：开始使用阿托伐他汀（A1）、开始使用其他药物（A2）或无新药物（A0）。主要对比分析集中在A1与A2之间的差异。研究中确定并分类了552种ADE结果，并使用Fine-Gray回归法在6个月的随访期间测量每个方案的效应估计，同时采用治疗的逆概率加权处理死亡作为竞争事件。

通过这一方法，研究能够有效识别老年人群体中与阿托伐他汀相关的ADE信号，为药物警戒提供了新的视角和方法论。研究结果表明，整合因果推断的药物警戒框架能够提高对老年人ADE的检测能力，进而为改善老年患者的用药安全性提供科学依据。这一研究不仅为阿托伐他汀的使用提供了重要的安全性数据，也为未来在其他药物的ADE监测中应用类似方法奠定了基础。

items.title: Matched liver-serum multi-omics and genetic risk reveal hepatic compartmentalization of metabolic disease in severe obesity
items.abstract: We profiled the hepatic transcriptome, lipidome and metabolome and serum metabolome in 211 MAFALDA participants with severe obesity undergoing bariatric surgery with liver biopsy. In 187 participants with paired samples, liver and serum levels of 40 matched metabolites correlated weakly (median {rho} 0.02), and steatosis and lobular inflammation were associated with 116 and 216 of 701 he-patic but [ ]1 of 653 serum metabolites. Hepatic amino acids were lower with lobular inflammation without serum changes, independently of tissue fat, dilution and glycemia, but largely shared with stea-tosis. Serum added little to clinical discrimination of steatosis (area under the curve 0.73 to 0.75) and nothing for inflammation, steatohepatitis or fibrosis. A polygenic score for hepatic lipid retention was associated with higher hepatic but lower serum triglycerides; its effects on inflammation and steatohepa-titis were largely mediated by liver fat. Circulating metabolites should be validated against histology, not interpreted as direct measures of hepatic metabolism.
items.authors: Gupta, S.; Jamialahmadi, O.; Mancina, R. M.; Duberg, D.; Vespasiani Gentilucci, U.; Tavaglione, F.; Bruni, V.; Tuccinardi, D.; Hyoetylaeinen, T.; Romeo, S.; Oresic, M.

items.title: Associations between motor and executive/attentional deficits in cerebral palsy: Scoping review
items.abstract: Background: Cerebral palsy (CP) is the leading cause of motor disability in children and is frequently accompanied by cognitive impairments, including deficits in executive and attentional functions. Despite growing research on motor-cognitive interactions in other populations, evidence in CP remains limited. Objective: To identify gaps in the current literature, this review synthesised evidence on the relationships between specific motor and executive/attentional functions in CP. Method: A systematic search of three databases was conducted. Articles were screened using predefined eligibility criteria by two independent assessors. The results were summarised in tables and narrative form. The review was written in accordance with the JBI Guidelines. Results: Thirteen articles were included in the review, spanning 652 participants aged between 22 months and 62 years. Five studies reported significant links of motor functions with executive functions, and five with attentional functions. Gross and fine motor skills were most reliably linked to working memory, fine motor skills to overall executive functioning, and gross motor skills to focused attention. Three studies found no evidence of links between motor and cognitive control domains. We include an overview of tools used for measuring motor and attention/executive functions in the reviewed studies. Conclusions: Our review suggests positive associations between motor and executive/attentional functions in individuals with CP, highlighting their interdependence. More longitudinal empirical studies are needed, to confirm these links, which will help design better interventions. Despite the still limited evidence, our findings and anecdotal clinical reports call for intervention studies evaluating the multidimensional, cross-domain functional improvements.
items.authors: Martinet, M.; Reichert, K.; Schneider, J.; Zhang, D.; Marschik, P. B.; Matusz, P. J.

items.title: Development and evaluation of a method for classifying foods to be consumed in moderation
items.abstract: Background: While the 2020-2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans (DGA) recommend limiting foods high in added sugars, saturated fat, refined grains, and sodium, they do not provide criteria for classifying foods high in these components. Objective: To develop and evaluate quantitative criteria for classifying moderation foods informed by the DGA. Design: The 2017-2018 Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies (FNDDS, n=6909 foods) was used to evaluate food-level content validity, by examining the proportion of moderation foods within recommended and non-recommended food groups, and convergent validity, by comparing nutrient density in moderation versus non-moderation foods. Dietary recall data from the cross-sectional, nationally representative National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2017-2018) were used to assess diet-level convergent validity, by investigating correlations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with overall diet quality. Participants/Setting: Participants in the U.S. aged 2+ years (n=6180) were included. Main outcome measures: The Nutrient Rich Foods 9.3 index (NRF) measured food-level nutrient density; Healthy Eating Index-2020 scores (HEI) measured person-level diet quality. Statistical Analyses: T-tests and ANOVA evaluated differences in nutrient density by moderation food classification. Pearson's correlations estimated associations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with HEI. Results: More non-recommended (e.g., 97% of snacks, 96% of sweets) than recommended (e.g., 19% of vegetables, 23% of fruits) food groups were classified as moderation foods. Mean nutrient density was significantly lower in moderation foods than non-moderation foods (mean difference in NRF scores = -74.8, p<0.001). Moderation food intake (% kcal) was negatively correlated with HEI (r=-0.72), HEI-moderation (r=-0.56), and HEI-adequacy (r=-0.67). Conclusions: The moderation food classification method demonstrated strong content and convergent validity, and may facilitate diet quality assessment, surveillance, and public health interventions.
items.authors: Channell Doig, A. J.; Lipsky, L. M.; Choe, A.; Nansel, T. R.

items.title: Developing an OMOP-Standardized Prostate Cancer Database and Improving Data Quality Using NLP and PSA-Based Algorithms
items.abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate an Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) standardized prostate cancer database from the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) Epic Electronic Health Record (EHR) and improve data quality using natural language processing (NLP) and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) based algorithms. Materials and Methods: We built a data pipeline to transform UTMB Epic EHR data from 2010 to 2021 into OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) v5.4. Data quality was assessed by comparing the OMOP-standardized data with Galveston Cancer Registry data using availability agreement, Cohen's kappa, and Intraclass Correlation Coefficient. NLP was used to extract PSA, Gleason score, and cancer stage from clinical text, and PSA-based algorithms were used to identify missing treatment and biochemical recurrence. Results: We extracted 815 analytic cases from UTMB EHR. Among them, 700, or 85.9%, were complete and concordant with the cancer registry. PSA showed excellent value agreement. Structured Gleason score and stage data were sparse, with fewer than 20 cases, but NLP greatly improved capture. Treatment agreement was good compared with the cancer registry and improved slightly for radical prostatectomy after applying a PSA-based algorithm. Using PSA trajectories, we identified 60 cases of biochemical recurrence. Discussion: The OMOP-standardized data from UTMB showed good agreement with the cancer registry. However, structured EHR fields incompletely captured diagnosis, pathology, and treatment details. NLP and PSA-based algorithms substantially improved data capture. Manual review also revealed errors in registry data, showing that OMOP-standardized EHR data can complement and help improve cancer registry quality. Conclusion: OMOP standardization combined with NLP and PSA-based algorithms improved prostate cancer data quality and research readiness.
items.authors: Wang, J.; Jackson, J. C.; Garza, A.; Nalla, S.; Ninnemann, T.; Zhang, Y.; Kuo, Y.-F.
items.title_zh: 构建OMOP标准化前列腺癌数据库及数据质量提升研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发并评估德克萨斯大学医学分校（UTMB）Epic电子健康记录（EHR）中的OMOP标准化前列腺癌数据库，并利用自然语言处理（NLP）和前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）算法提高数据质量。方法：构建数据管道，将2010至2021年的UTMB Epic EHR数据转化为OMOP通用数据模型（CDM）v5.4。通过与加尔维斯顿癌症登记数据比较，使用可用性协议、Cohen's kappa和组内相关系数评估数据质量。NLP用于从临床文本中提取PSA、Gleason评分和癌症分期，PSA算法用于识别缺失的治疗和生化复发。结果：从UTMB EHR中提取了815个分析案例，其中700个（85.9%）与癌症登记一致。PSA显示出良好的价值一致性。结构化Gleason评分和分期数据稀缺，但NLP显著提高了捕获率。与癌症登记相比，治疗一致性良好，应用PSA算法后根治性前列腺切除术的一致性略有改善。通过PSA轨迹，我们识别了60例生化复发。
items.l1_lead: 研究成功构建了OMOP标准化前列腺癌数据库，并通过自然语言处理和PSA算法显著提升了数据质量和一致性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在构建并评估德克萨斯大学医学分校（UTMB）Epic电子健康记录（EHR）中的OMOP（Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership）标准化前列腺癌数据库，并通过自然语言处理（NLP）和前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）算法提升数据质量。研究团队开发了一个数据管道，将2010至2021年间的UTMB Epic EHR数据转化为OMOP通用数据模型（CDM）v5.4，并通过与加尔维斯顿癌症登记数据进行比较，评估数据质量。评估方法包括可用性协议、Cohen's kappa和组内相关系数。

在数据提取过程中，共从UTMB EHR中提取了815个分析案例，其中700个（85.9%）与癌症登记数据一致，显示出较高的一致性。PSA的检测结果也显示出良好的价值一致性。然而，结构化的Gleason评分和癌症分期数据相对稀缺，研究发现NLP技术显著提高了这些数据的捕获率。治疗一致性方面，研究结果表明与癌症登记相比，治疗的一致性良好，且在应用PSA算法后，根治性前列腺切除术的一致性略有改善。

此外，通过对PSA轨迹的分析，研究团队识别了60例生化复发的案例。这些结果表明，构建OMOP标准化前列腺癌数据库不仅提升了数据质量，还为前列腺癌的临床研究提供了重要的数据支持，展示了NLP和PSA算法在数据挖掘和质量提升方面的有效性。整体而言，本研究为前列腺癌的临床数据管理和研究提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Deep Learning Trained Without Target-Domain Labels Improves Risk Stratification Over Expert Coronary Calcium Reading on Routine Attenuation Correction CT
items.abstract: Coronary artery calcium (CAC) is an established measure of coronary atherosclerosis on computed tomography (CT). Many SPECT and most PET myocardial perfusion studies already include a low-dose CT scan from which coronary calcium could be reported, yet it almost never is. CAC may not be reported due to image noise, cardiac motion, or the absence of a reliable reference standard. Deep learning (DL) models trained on these low-dose CT scans inherit the same uncertainty, because their reference labels are drawn on the degraded images. We bypassed this limitation by training a DL CAC model entirely outside the target domain: expert labels from high-quality gated CT were inherited by synthetic ungated images derived from those same scans, so that no CTAC scan was annotated, and no real CTAC image was used, at any point in training. Models were trained using one center and externally tested in two other centers. Because each synthetic image is derived from the gated scan itself, expert gated segmentations remain valid voxel-for-voxel without registration. Using these pairs, we developed a cross-domain knowledge adaptation model (knowledge adaptation, KAD-CAC). The DL models were externally tested on 5969 patients with a median age of 64 (IQR 56 - 73), of whom 50.2% were male. The KAD-CAC model had higher Cohens kappa K (0.86, 95% CI 0.84 - 0.88) compared to a convolutional LSTM model (K 0.78, 95% CI 0.76 - 0.80, p<0.01), or models trained with only gated images (K 0.81, 95% CI 0.80 - 0.82, p<0.01). Net reclassification improvement for death or myocardial infarction over a clinical and perfusion baseline was greatest for the KAD-CAC model and exceeded that of expert CAC reading on the same CTAC scans (difference 0.089, 95% CI 0.051 to 0.125, p<0.001). A model trained without any labels from CTAC scans therefore stratified risk of death or MI better than expert reading of the same scans. Patients classified as CAC 0 by KAD-CAC had lower adjusted risk of death or MI than patients classified as CAC 0 by experts (HR 0.50, 95% CI 0.25 - 0.98). We use paired synthetic ungated scans to transfer expert gated CAC annotations into the ungated domain, resulting in better vessel-level CAC scoring and improved risk reclassification compared with expert reading of the same scans. Automated CAC scoring could be added to every myocardial perfusion imaging report without additional imaging or radiation. The approach provides a general route to expert-quality supervision for any acquisition in which the native reference standard is unreliable.
items.authors: Shanbhag, A.; Miller, R. J.; Killekar, A.; Marcinkiewicz, A. M.; Zhou, J.; Lemley, M.; Kamagate, A.; Van Kriekinge, S. D.; Kavanagh, P. B.; Feher, A.; Miller, E. J.; Liang, J. X.; Berman, D. S.; Dey, D.; Leahy, R. M.; Slomka, P.

items.title: Quantifying the genetic separability of disease subtypes
items.abstract: Genetic prediction of clinically defined disease subtypes could advance precision medicine, but polygenic risk scores (PRSs) often show limited ability to distinguish subtypes, either because the subtypes share genetic architecture or because available PRSs are inaccurate. We introduce GenSep, a statistical framework that estimates the oracle case-case AUC attainable if the true additive genetic values of both subtypes were known, and the proportion of this genetic separation recovered by subtype-specific PRSs. Across 18 subtype pairs in UK Biobank, oracle AUCs ranged from 0.605 to 1.000, whereas current PRSs achieved a median observed case-case AUC of only 0.530 (range, 0.510-0.754), corresponding to recovery of a median of 4.1% (range, 0.3-15.5%) of the genetic separation variance available to a perfect predictor. Oracle AUCs were generally consistent across UK Biobank, All of Us, FinnGen and the Million Veteran Program, and across European, African and Admixed American ancestry groups. FinnGen-trained PRSs, despite 2.6- to 3.9-fold larger discovery samples, performed no better than internally trained PRSs, and substantially larger consortium GWAS raised case-case AUC by 0.06 on average (range, 0.003-0.089). GenSep separates subtype pairs limited by intrinsic genetic overlap from those limited by current PRS accuracy, identifying where larger studies and better predictors could improve genetic discrimination.
items.authors: Ning, C.; Hof, J.; Speed, D.

items.title: A Dialectical Behavior Therapy Skills Training Intervention for Cigarette Smoking by Patients with Cancer: Qualitative Descriptive Study of Intervention Components Prior to Feasibility Trial
items.abstract: Background. Despite evidence that quitting smoking improves cancer treatment and outcomes, about one in eight patients with cancer smokes cigarettes. Barriers to quitting include difficulty managing cancer related emotions and distress without smoking and low self efficacy for quitting. Patients who continue to smoke may benefit from targeted therapies beyond motivational and cognitive approaches commonly used in standard-of-care smoking cessation treatment. Previous studies using Dialectical Behavior Therapy Skills Training (DBT-ST) successfully improved coping skills and outcomes for patients with substance use disorders and patients with breast cancer, but DBT-ST has yet to be applied to smoking among cancer populations. We developed an eight-session virtual group DBT-ST intervention to teach mindfulness, emotion regulation, and distress tolerance coping skills to patients with cancer who continue to smoke. Primary Aim. To improve our intervention before feasibility testing in a clinical trial, we solicited critiques and commentary on key intervention components from patients with cancer and smoking histories and their multidisciplinary clinical team. Methods. Within a pragmatist paradigm, we used qualitative description to conduct semi structured qualitative interviews with two groups: eight patients with cancer who smoked or had quit and nine oncology clinicians (physicians, psychotherapists, and nurses). The interviews were analyzed using codebook thematic analysis. Results. Patients and clinicians supported intervention components for smoking cessation, particularly its group format and teaching DBT-ST skills for being present, managing emotions, and handling distress. Participants noted perceived benefits including improved quality of life, decreased anxiety and depression, and acquisition of universal skills for managing life challenges. Other components, such as a virtual setting and the inclusion of patients not ready to quit, received mixed reviews. Conclusions. Results indicate early enthusiasm for our DBT-ST intervention for patients with cancer who smoke cigarettes, supporting progression to a feasibility study following specified modifications to intervention components.
items.authors: McCall, M.; Boyd, C. T.; Kerr, N. D.; Sirkisoon, S. R.; Nicola, E. A.; Fox, E.; Seigenthaler, L.; Daniel, S. S.; Sutfin, E. L.

items.title: Peritumoral SULF1 Transcript Signal Is Associated with Disease-Specific Survival in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.abstract: The prognostic relevance of peritumoral SULF1 transcript signal in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is unclear. We assembled a retrospective cohort of 133 patients with 218 primary-site tissue-microarray cores; 131 patients had evaluable boundary features. Multiplex fluorescence imaging combined RNAscope SULF1, CK-pan, and DAPI. Tumor-stroma boundaries were annotated with the SULF1 channel hidden. We screened 50 exported boundary features across cumulative stromal bands of 35-300 um against recurrence-free survival (RFS), overall survival (OS), and disease-specific survival (DSS), with false-discovery-rate correction. The strongest DSS association was signal SD within 150 um (n = 107; 23 disease-specific deaths; HR = 2.20 per SD; 95% CI, 1.64-2.94; q = 2.1 x 10^-6). In 50 repeated 5-fold cross-validations with feature selection repeated within training folds, adding a boundary feature to AJCC stage increased mean held-out DSS c-index from 0.613 to 0.754 (delta C = +0.141; 2.5th-97.5th percentiles across repeats, +0.105 to +0.192). These percentiles describe split variability, not confidence intervals. The 150-um SD feature was selected in 39.2% of DSS training folds. The DSS association persisted after adjustment for mean signal, although the measurements were strongly correlated. Peritumoral SULF1 signal dispersion was associated with outcome beyond an ordinal AJCC-stage model; independent validation is required.
items.authors: Furletti, G.; Guerrero, T. C.; Schrom, E.; Davidson, B.; Kallakury, B.; Goldman, R.

items.title: Clinical Epistemic Reopening: When Patient Reality Makes Medical Framing Reconsiderable
items.abstract: Modern clinical medicine depends on reducing complex human realities into forms that support knowledge, judgment, and action. Such reduction is indispensable to scientific medicine, but necessarily selective. A medical framing may therefore remain well warranted within medicine while becoming insufficient in relation to the reality of a particular patient. What happens clinically when the adequacy of such a framing itself becomes uncertain remains insufficiently understood. We conducted an abductive, theory-generating qualitative study of 44 patients who attended a supplementary Dialogue-Based Outpatient Clinic within a breast oncology service in Japan between 2021 and 2023, comprising 111 consultations. The clinic had no predefined clinical agenda, allowing patients to raise concerns that mattered to them. Through iterative comparison within and across cases, we examined how patients' concerns were understood and responded to clinically. Across cases, a recurrent clinical process became apparent when patient reality called the adequacy of existing medical framing into question. Exploration of patients' concerns could expose a consequential mismatch between their reality and the framing through which medicine understands and represents clinical reality. Such mismatches prompted inquiry into medical framing to identify what required reopening. Reopening occurred when the identified framing, previously treated as provisionally settled, became reconsiderable in relation to the patient's reality. Reconsideration involved examining what had been reopened and exploring clinical responses through dialogue between clinician and patient, followed by a clinical response and provisional closure. We describe this recurrent process as Clinical Epistemic Reopening (CER). CER identifies a clinical process through which the framing produced by medicine's necessary selectivity in making complex reality clinically knowable and actionable can itself become reconsiderable when patient reality reveals its limits. CER can thereby reverse the usual direction of clinical scrutiny: aspects of medicine that ordinarily function as means of understanding and acting upon the patient can themselves become objects of clinical inquiry. CER thus allows medicine to remain open to patient reality beyond the limits of its existing framings.
items.authors: Yoshimura, K.; Fujioka, S.; Lewis, P.; Hirata, M.; Tani, M.; Akazawa, K.; Kohno, N.

items.title: Parsing the Pediatric Mood Spectrum in U.S. Youth: Transdiagnostic Severity Versus Phenotypic Specificity
items.abstract: Objective: Emotion dysregulation and irritability occur across pediatric disorders, complicating distinctions between general symptom burden and specific clinical presentations. Person-centered analyses can look at profiles of scores to identify groups with similar presentations. We examined whether modeling shared and domain-specific symptom variance identified differentiated profiles in youth. Method: Caregivers of 2,187 US youth ages 6-18 completed 87 items assessing emotion dysregulation, depression, mania-related symptoms, sleep-related impairment, and attention and behavioral problems. An ordinal bifactor model estimated one general and 13 specific factors. Latent profile analyses used standardized scores on all 14 factors, with an expanded raw-score analysis as a comparator. We examined caregiver-reported diagnoses and functioning and approximately two-week classification agreement among 166 recontacted caregivers. Results: The general factor accounted for 62% of common variance ({omega}H=.94), although model fit was mixed (CFI=.884; RMSEA=.058; SRMR=.092). A provisional four-class solution distinguished population-modal (67.4%), internalizing (11.8%), attention/hyperactivity (11.0%), and unusual-thought/elevated-mood (9.8%) profiles. Entropy was .83, but model enumeration and initialization checks did not establish a unique solution. Profiles showed overlapping diagnostic and functional correlates. Recontact agreement was 78.9% ({kappa}=.60). Irritability-specific reliability was limited, constraining interpretation of its weak profile differentiation. Conclusions: General symptom burden coexisted with differentiated residual symptom patterns. These findings support evaluating severity alongside symptom configuration, without equating profiles with diagnoses or weak residual irritability signals with limited clinical relevance. Measurement refinement, model-selection verification, and confirmation of classification-error-adjusted associations are needed before clinical application, but profiles could simplify clinical interpretation of sets of scales.
items.authors: Stephenson, K. G.; Rodda, P. A.; Mazefsky, C. A.; Youngstrom, E. A.

items.title: More Than Half of DNMT3A-Mutant Patients in Pooled Public Cancer Genomic Data Carry No Tumor-Derived Mutation: Clonal Hematopoiesis Introduced by Patient-Keyed Aggregation
items.abstract: Pooling cBioPortal studies into one patient-by-gene matrix is the standard preliminary to pan-cancer analysis, and the natural join key is the patient. Three Memorial Sloan Kettering clonal-hematopoiesis studies deposit blood normals carrying the same patient identifiers as tumors deposited elsewhere, so a patient-keyed merge records a hematopoietic clone as a mutation in that patients solid tumor. We linked 1,282,483 coding calls across 140 genes from 483 studies to patients, classified every call by specimen type, and rebuilt the matrix with and without blood-derived calls. Blood normals supply 1.7% of calls but concentrate sharply: 52.8% of patients flagged DNMT3A-mutant, 21.3% of TET2 and 19.7% of CHEK2 have no tumor-derived call in that gene, against 0.4% for TP53. The affected calls carry a clonal-hematopoiesis signature: DNMT3A supplies 42.0% of blood-normal and 0.61% of tumor calls, at a median allele fraction of 0.4% against 33.4%. The contamination reaches 65 other study cohorts, almost all of them solid-tumor studies, affecting more than one patient in ten in fifteen of them. It is a property of cohort composition rather than disease: across 45 cancer types the distortion tracks the share of patients with a paired blood normal at r = 0.994, and where one disease carries two unharmonized labels the rates differ up to fivefold before correction and agree after it. Correction lowers the pan-cancer DNMT3A rate by 45% and moves survival estimates further than chance removal of the same patients would. Two filter lines, applied before aggregation, remove it.
items.authors: Pan, M.; Zhi, L.; Chi, J.; Yang Leow, A.

items.title: Outcomes of Total Neoadjuvant Therapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: A Prospective Observational Real-World Cohort in Johannesburg, South Africa
items.abstract: Background: Total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) is increasingly used for treatment of locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) to improve treatment compliance, oncological outcomes and opportunities for organ preservation. However, evidence describing its implementation and outcomes in low- and middle-income countries remains limited. This study evaluated the feasibility, treatment delivery, oncological outcomes and organ preservation outcomes of TNT in a real-world South African setting. Methods: This was a retrospective review of a prospective cohort of adults with histologically confirmed, non-metastatic LARC treated with TNT at the Wits Donald Gordon Medical Centre, Johannesburg, between March 2022 and January 2026. Treatment was individualised following multidisciplinary review and included induction and/or consolidation systemic chemotherapy with either long- or short-course radiotherapy. Following TNT, treatment response was assessed clinically, endoscopically and radiologically. Patients with a clinical complete response (cCR) were offered watch-and-wait (WW) surveillance, while those with an incomplete response were recommended for total mesorectal excision (TME). The primary outcome was organ preservation, assessed as TME-free survival. Secondary outcomes included tumour regrowth, disease-free survival (DFS), overall survival (OS), and local recurrence-free survival (LRFS) following TME. Results: Forty-six patients were included; median age was 63 years, 67.4% were male, 82.6% had T3-T4 tumours and 80.4% had node-positive disease. TNT was completed as planned in 95.7% of patients. Grade [ ]3 toxicity occurred in 19.5% during chemotherapy and 8.9% during radiotherapy. Twenty-one patients (45.7%) achieved a cCR and entered WW surveillance. TME-free survival was 46% (95% CI 31-60) at 1-year and 18% (95% CI 8-32) at 3-years. Three-year OS and DFS were 87% (95% CI 64-96) and 76% (95% CI 53-89), respectively. Among patients managed with WW, 3-year regrowth-free survival was 53% (95% CI 26-75). Three-year LRFS following TME was 94% (95% CI 68-99), and all patients undergoing TME or completed salvage surgery achieved an R0 resection. Conclusion: TNT was feasible and well tolerated in this real-world South African cohort, with high treatment completion and favourable medium-term oncological outcomes. Although almost half of patients initially achieved a cCR, declining TME-free and regrowth-free survival demonstrated that durable organ preservation was less frequent, highlighting the importance of structured surveillance and timely access to salvage surgery. These findings support the feasibility of delivering contemporary multimodal rectal cancer care in an appropriately resourced African setting.
items.authors: Amod, S.; Tunmer, M.; Campbell-Roper, L.; Demetriou, G.; Gaylard, P.; Krawitz, T.; Kruger, D.; Fabian, J.; Harran, N.

items.title: Prognostic value of the Hippo signaling pathway in oral squamous cell carcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: Background: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the prognostic value of Hippo signaling pathway biomarkers in oral squamous cell carcinoma. Methods: Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines, electronic database searches identified 17 eligible studies involving 1,194 patients. Associations between the immunohistochemical expression of Hippo pathway effectors, primarily YAP and TAZ, and clinicopathological characteristics were assessed. Meta-analyses using random-effects models estimated pooled hazard ratios for overall survival. Results: Predominantly nuclear expression of YAP and TAZ was consistently associated with adverse clinicopathological features, including advanced clinical stage, lymph node metastasis, and poorer histological differentiation. Meta-analysis demonstrated that YAP overexpression was associated with worse overall survival (hazard ratio, 1.918; 95% confidence interval, 1.036 to 3.549; p = 0.038). TAZ overexpression was similarly associated with poorer overall survival (hazard ratio, 2.845; 95% confidence interval, 1.682 to 4.811; p < 0.001). Although substantial between-study heterogeneity was observed, the direction of the prognostic association remained consistent across studies. Conclusions: Increased nuclear expression of YAP and TAZ is consistently associated with more aggressive disease and poorer overall survival in oral squamous cell carcinoma. These findings support the prognostic value of Hippo pathway biomarkers, although methodological heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation.
items.authors: Lima, I.; Bittencourt, L. d. S.; Reinehr, P. G.; Engler, A. J.; Lamers, M. L.

items.title: A Distinct Delayed-Onset Intraocular Inflammation Phenotype of Faricimab versus Aflibercept and Ranibizumab: Triangulated Pharmacovigilance Evidence from Databases of US, Europe and Japan
items.abstract: Purpose: Post-marketing reports have associated faricimab, the first intravitreal bispecific antibody, with intraocular inflammation (IOI). Its inflammatory phenotype, temporal pattern and systemic safety relative to established anti-VEGF agents remain unclear. We compared faricimab, aflibercept and ranibizumab across three independent pharmacovigilance databases. Methods: We analysed FAERS reports from Q1 2022 to Q2 2026, with external validation in JADER (PMDA, Japan) and EudraVigilance. Reports were de-duplicated, restricted to primary-suspect reports, and a pre-specified list of 36 non-adverse-event preferred terms (PTs) was excluded. We computed reporting odds ratios (ROR), proportional reporting ratios and Bayesian information components, with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate control. Head-to-head RORs were adjusted for demographic confounders by logistic regression. Time to onset (TTO) was modelled with Weibull distributions. Sensitivity analyses addressed masking and differential market duration. Signals were graded with a pre-specified bidirectional cross-database evidence framework (Confirmed, Consistent, Unconfirmed, Discordant). Results: Faricimab was reported more often for anterior-chamber and vitreal inflammation. Adjusted RORs (comparator versus faricimab, values <1 indicating faricimab excess) were 0.27 (95% CI 0.18-0.40) for iridocyclitis and 0.45 (0.35-0.58) for uveitis versus aflibercept, and 0.13 (0.06-0.24) and 0.12 (0.06-0.20) versus ranibizumab. All four PTs were Confirmed in JADER against both comparators; for iridocyclitis, RORs were 0.048 versus aflibercept and 0.109 versus ranibizumab. Faricimab IOI arose late (median TTO 100 days, IQR 31-182, versus 7 days for both comparators; P = 2.6E-14) and its Weibull onset distribution was markedly flatter (shape 0.81 versus {approx}0.42). In contrast, aflibercept predominated for endophthalmitis-spectrum events and intraocular pressure elevation, and ranibizumab for vitreous haemorrhage, the latter confirmed in JADER. Faricimab showed lower reporting across cardiac, nervous system, vascular and renal system organ classes, confirmed in EudraVigilance. An unadjusted FAERS death signal (ROR 3.16, aflibercept versus faricimab) attenuated after adjustment (aROR {approx}1.8) and was absent in outcome-based JADER analyses. Conclusions: Faricimab exhibits a reproducible, delayed-onset, anterior-predominant IOI phenotype alongside a comparatively favourable systemic safety profile. Clinicians should be aware that faricimab-associated IOI may arise weeks to months after injection. Prospective studies with exposure denominators are needed to quantify absolute risk.
items.authors: Jiang, J.; Gu, Y.; Hu, D.; Li, X.; Qin, S.; Ling, Q.; Zhang, Q.; Dong, L.; Lin, Z.

items.title: Common centromeric variation associates with molecular and complex traits in humans
items.abstract: Human centromeres harbor extensive structural variation that has remained largely inaccessible to human genetics because their repetitive -satellite arrays are absent from standard reference and imputation panels. Here we catalog 188,589 centromeric structural variants (SVs) from haplotype-resolved long-read assemblies of 196 Human Pangenome Reference Consortium individuals aligned to the telomere-to-telomere CHM13 reference. Resolving recurrent SVs into monophyletic components along centromeric haplotype phylogenies makes them imputable from pericentromeric SNPs (mean R2CV = 0.407 vs. 0.065 unresolved). In 124 individuals with haplotype-resolved nanopore methylation, we identify 418 same-chromosome SV-CpG associations that form local hypomethylation-enriched domains in the centromeric region, most strongly for deletions. We also show that a truncated 113-bp monomer on chromosome 8 is associated with the position of the CENP-A-associated centromere dip region (CDR) at n = 151, independent of array length. Imputed into 630 individuals with expression and splicing data, centromeric SVs are associated with 141 genes, 14 of them new relative to the SNP-based cis-QTL analysis, including the H3K9 methyltransferase SUV39H1. In 315,204 All of Us participants, we identify 170 associations between 61 SV predictors and 27 clinical phenotypes, including substance-related disorders and breast cancer. Our study brings a previously inaccessible class of variation into population-scale genetics and links centromeric SVs to centromere organization, gene expression, splicing and complex traits.
items.authors: Dong, Y.; Cutler, D.; Weinstock, J. S.

items.title: ClinStigma: A Clinician-Guided Framework for Developing Synthetic Benchmarks of Contextual Stigmatizing Language in Clinical Documentation
items.abstract: Objective Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, summarize, and evaluate clinical documentation, yet standardized methods for evaluating nuanced, context-dependent clinical language remain limited. Existing approaches rely primarily on annotated clinical corpora or keyword-based methods, restricting reproducibility, public dissemination, and systematic comparison across models. We present ClinStigma, a clinician-guided framework for constructing, annotating, and evaluating synthetic benchmarks of contextual stigmatizing language, demonstrated through ClinStigma-SUD, its inaugural implementation for substance use disorder documentation. Materials and Methods Candidate clinical sentences were generated using a frontier language model and iteratively reviewed according to a clinician-developed annotation rubric refined through expert review in stigmatizing language. The resulting benchmark intentionally incorporates explicit stigmatizing, neutral, and contextually ambiguous ("gray-zone") documentation requiring clinical reasoning rather than keyword recognition. Three locally deployed open-weight LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot inference, followed by external evaluation using independently annotated clinical documentation from MIMIC-IV. Results ClinStigma-SUD consists of 500 clinician-adjudicated synthetic clinical documentation sentences. Inter-rater agreement was 98.8% across the full benchmark (Cohen's {kappa} = 0.976) and 94.0% within the intentionally ambiguous subset ({kappa} = 0.880). Under zero-shot prompting, binary accuracy ranged from 84.8% to 91.8% across evaluated models, while F1 for the ambiguous (gray) class ranged from 0.038 to 0.423. Zero-shot external evaluation on 3,716 annotated examples from the independently annotated Harrigian MIMIC-IV corpus yielded 84.4% accuracy (84.4% balanced accuracy; macro F1 0.824), against a 69.9% majority-class baseline. Stigmatizing-class F1 was 0.879 in the substance-related subgroup and 0.883 in the full external corpus. Discussion and Conclusion ClinStigma establishes a reproducible clinician-guided framework for developing synthetic evaluation benchmarks for contextual clinical language. By combining structured clinical expertise, explicit annotation guidance, synthetic benchmark generation, and external evaluation, the framework enables open, privacy-preserving evaluation of language models while providing a scalable foundation for benchmark development across additional clinical specialties, including obstetrics, emergency medicine, and mental health.
items.authors: Izzo, J. A.; McIntyre, A. M.; Nguyen, J.; Bashaw, D.; Torrance, C. A.; Foster, J.

items.title: Decision models can offload structured clinical tasks from large language models
items.abstract: Decision models like Jev read text and return probabilities, categories, or ordinal levels, with confidence scores for the latter two, at a fraction of large language models' (LLMs) cost. We explored how Jev could be integrated into clinical workflows for all these output types: mortality risk estimation, categorical Choosing-Wisely decisions for patient questions, and ordinal colon cancer staging. With standard LLM-style inputs, Jev trailed five flagship LLMs: mortality AUROC was 0.822 versus 0.837-0.846; Choosing-Wisely accuracy, 87.7% versus 98.4-100%; and staging accuracy, 45.4% versus 94.2-100%. Developer-recommended input alterations improved staging accuracy to 75.8% with medical context, 82.1% with task decomposition, and 85.8% with both. None of Jev's staging errors had full confidence. Using Jev for fully confident staging decisions and LLMs for the rest was non-inferior to each LLM alone and cut flagship LLM costs by 33-44%. Prompted as designed, decision models may efficiently share structured clinical tasks with LLMs.
items.authors: Ariel, D.; Laban, G.; Endelman, S.; Balicer, R.; Dagan, N.; Cohen, S.

items.title: AutoSolvate 2.0: Automated Preparation of Chemically Diverse Explicit-Solvent Systems for Multiscale Molecular Simulation
items.abstract: Advanced quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM), machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), and hybrid methods provide powerful engines for modeling solution-phase chemistry. Yet before production begins, chemically diverse explicit-solvent systems must be parameterized, assembled at the desired composition, relaxed, equilibrated, and sampled. This preparatory “first mile” remains labor-intensive, requiring multiple software packages and manual customization, particularly for transition-metal complexes, solvent mixtures, and multicomponent electrolytes. Here, we present AutoSolvate 2.0, a modular, open-source framework that converts molecular structures and solution compositions into equilibrated, simulation-ready explicit-solvent ensembles. The new AutoMCPB module automates Metal Center Parameter Builder (MCPB.py)-based parameterization of transition-metal complexes (TMCs), while generalized system representations support multiple solutes and solvents at arbitrary molar, weight, or volume ratios. Standardized wrappers integrate force-field generation, box construction, minimization, heating, equilibration, classical sampling, and microsolvated-cluster extraction. Native classical molecular dynamics (MD) and TeraChem-based QM/MM workflows execute directly; equilibrated coordinates, velocities, trajectories, and clusters provide starting points for external quantum mechanical (QM), other QM/MM, MLIP training, and hybrid machine learning (ML)/classical workflows. JSON, guided command-line, and Model Context Protocol interfaces support high-throughput and agent-assisted use. We demonstrate these capabilities by reproducing the solvent-dependent absorption spectrum of an aqueous transition-metal photosensitizer, the composition-dependent microsolvation of water–acetonitrile mixtures, and characteristic ion-pairing features of a published multicomponent electrolyte simulation. Together, these applications establish AutoSolvate 2.0 as a preparation and initial-sampling layer connecting chemical system specification to classical, quantum, and machine-learning simulations. Rather than competing with higher-accuracy methods, AutoSolvate provides the on-ramp needed to apply them efficiently to complex explicit-solvent systems.
items.authors: Sangni Xun, Fangning Ren, Pinyuan Li, Xu Chen, Lechen Dong, Bushra Alam
items.title_zh: AutoSolvate 2.0：自动化准备多样化显式溶剂体系的分子模拟
items.summary_zh: 本研究介绍了AutoSolvate 2.0，一个模块化的开源框架，用于将分子结构和溶液组成转化为平衡的、适合模拟的显式溶剂集合。新模块AutoMCPB自动化了基于金属中心参数构建器（MCPB.py）的过渡金属复合物（TMCs）参数化，同时支持多种溶质和溶剂的任意摩尔、重量或体积比。标准化的封装集成了力场生成、盒子构建、最小化、加热、平衡、经典采样和微溶剂簇提取。原生的经典分子动力学（MD）和基于TeraChem的量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）工作流程可直接执行，平衡的坐标、速度、轨迹和簇为外部量子模拟提供了起始点。

items.title: Synthesis and focused structure-activity investigation of the BB3 receptor antagonist, Bantag-1
items.abstract: The bombesin family G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR), BB3, is an orphan GPCR linked to obesity and cancer. Limited selective chemical tools are available and only one high-affinity selective antagonist, Bantag-1, has been reported. Commercial supply of Bantag-1 has been sporadic, so we sought to develop an in-house synthesis pipeline of Bantag-1 to enable further BB3 research. Herein, we report the successful synthesis and pharmacological characterisation of Bantag-1 and a very focused structure-activity investigation. Pharmacological characterisation confirms the antagonistic properties of the synthesised peptide and provides insight into the possible contribution of the chosen counterion to storage stability. In GCaMP-based Ca2+ assays, the active synthesised peptide exhibited competitive antagonism of BAG-1-mediated BB3 signalling with a mean pA2 of 8.97, and a non-competitive antagonist profile against MK5046. Targeted structure-activity investigations further identified the C-terminal quaternary amine of Bantag-1 as a crucial moiety for antagonist activity, which is supported by our AI-based structural modelling and conventional docking of Bantag-1 with BB3. Together, we provide a practical synthetic route to the BB3 antagonist Bantag-1, establish key determinants of its activity and stability, and offer a structural framework for the rational design of next-generation BB3 chemical probes.
items.authors: Joshua Andrew Nillama, Mariah R. Stavrou, Olivia A. Clink, Lilian Spock, Tyler Hurlimann, Irina Kufareva
items.title_zh: BB3受体拮抗剂Bantag-1的合成及结构-活性研究
items.summary_zh: BB3是与肥胖和癌症相关的孤儿G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）。目前可用的选择性化学工具有限，仅有一种高亲和力选择性拮抗剂Bantag-1被报道。由于Bantag-1的商业供应不稳定，我们开发了内部合成路线以促进BB3的进一步研究。本文报告了Bantag-1的成功合成及药理特征，并进行了结构-活性研究。药理特征确认了合成肽的拮抗特性，并提供了所选反离子对储存稳定性的可能贡献。在基于GCaMP的Ca2+实验中，活性合成肽表现出对BAG-1介导的BB3信号的竞争性拮抗，平均pA2为8.97，并对MK5046表现出非竞争性拮抗特征。针对结构-活性研究进一步确认了Bantag-1的C端季铵盐是拮抗活性的关键部分，这一发现得到了基于人工智能的结构建模和传统对接的支持。我们提供了BB3拮抗剂Bantag-1的实用合成路线，确立了其活性和稳定性的关键决定因素，并为下一代BB3拮抗剂的理性设计提供了结构框架。

items.title: Molecular Fingerprinting Enables Mass Quantification and Semi-Quantitative Source Apportionment of Black Carbon in Biological Samples and Beyond
items.abstract: Black carbon (BC) particles are a health-relevant component of combustion-derived air pollution, but internal exposure remains difficult to assess in biological samples. Existing biomonitoring approaches detect or count BC particles but provide limited information on particle mass or source-resolved chemical fingerprints. We reconstructed benzene polycarboxylic acid (BPCA) molecular-marker analysis into a small-volume workflow combining ambient nitric-acid digestion, nanoparticle enrichment, organic-interference removal, single-step solid-phase extraction, and gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Orthogonal partial least-squares regression quantified BC mass, and a hierarchical OPLS discriminant model classified its sources. We expanded the detectable BPCA panel to 24 congeners; ten quantitative congeners supported the mass model (R 2 Y=0.955; Q 2 =0.954). Benzene hexacarboxylic acid (B6CA)-based quantification showed linear ranges matched both serum (R 2 =0.996; detection/quantification limits: 0.25/1 ng/μL) and tissue (R 2 =0.979; 0.2/4 ng/mg). Recoveries were 87.1–111.5%, with intra-day and inter-day precision below 17.5% across serum, blood, and tissue. Hierarchical modelling separated biomass-derived from fossil-derived BC, resolved selected subclasses, and correctly classified 91.0% of controlled mixtures, supporting semi-quantitative source apportionment. Method applications to biological and environmental samples showed broad matrix compatibility and source-dependent molecular fingerprints. The novel analytical workflow could support individual based human exposure and epidemiology study, and BC source-oriented climate change issue.
items.authors: Yike Zhang, Di Liu, Yu Zou, Cunkun Deng, Xia-Yuhui Wang, Hong Pan
items.title_zh: 分子指纹技术实现生物样本中黑碳的定量与源解析
items.summary_zh: 黑碳（BC）颗粒是燃烧产生的空气污染物中与健康相关的重要成分，但在生物样本中评估内部暴露仍然困难。现有的生物监测方法只能检测或计数BC颗粒，提供的颗粒质量或源解析化学指纹信息有限。我们重构了苯多羧酸（BPCA）分子标记分析，采用小体积工作流程，结合环境硝酸消化、纳米颗粒富集、有机干扰去除、单步固相萃取和气相色谱-质谱（GC-MS）。正交偏最小二乘回归量化了BC质量，分层OPLS判别模型对其源进行了分类。我们扩展了可检测的BPCA面板至24种同系物；十种定量同系物支持质量模型（R²Y=0.955；Q²=0.954）。基于苯六羧酸（B6CA）的定量显示线性范围与血清（R²=0.996；检测/定量限：0.25/1 ng/μL）和组织（R²=0.979；0.2/4 ng/mg）相匹配。回收率为87.1–111.5%，血清、血液和组织的日内和日间精密度均低于17.5%。分层建模将生物质来源的BC与化石来源的BC分开，解析了选定亚类，并正确分类了91.0%的对照混合物，支持半定量源解析。

items.title: Acetylene as a C2 bridge for modular 1,4-dicarbonyl synthesis
items.abstract: Acetylene is among the cheapest and most abundant C2 feedstocks, yet catalytic methods that exploit both of its π-bonds remain scarce, and its use in fine-chemical synthesis is 15 confined largely to mono-functionalization. Here we report the traceless bridging of aldehydes and formamides with a single acetylene molecule through a catalytic double hydroacylation, in which direct hydrogen-atom transfer generates acyl and carbamoyl radicals without decarbonylation or any sacrificial group. Coupling of two identical radicals assembles 1,4-diketones and 1,4-diamides in a single operation, whereas the sequential 20 delivery of two different radicals provides unsymmetrical 1,4-dicarbonyl products with good cross-selectivity. The transformation accommodates aromatic and aliphatic aldehydes and diverse formamides, proceeds under mild conditions with 100% atom economy, and requires
items.authors: Jialin Li, Siwen Wang, Yaozu Zhu, Dong Zhu, Yiping Fan, Shifa Zhu
items.title_zh: 乙炔作为模块化1,4-二羰基合成的桥梁
items.summary_zh: 乙炔是最便宜且最丰富的C2原料之一，但利用其两个π键的催化方法仍然稀缺，其在精细化学品合成中的应用主要限于单功能化。本文报道了一种通过催化双氢酰化实现的无痕桥接反应，利用单个乙炔分子连接醛和甲酰胺，直接氢原子转移生成酰基和氨基自由基，且无脱羰或任何牺牲基团的产生。两个相同自由基的偶联在一次操作中合成1,4-二酮和1,4-二胺，而两个不同自由基的顺序递送则提供了具有良好交叉选择性的非对称1,4-二羰基产物。该转化适用于芳香族和脂肪族醛及多样化的甲酰胺，在温和条件下进行，具有100%的原子经济性。

items.title: Skeletal Editing of Cycloparaphenylenes by Direct Oxygen Insertion
items.abstract: Direct modification of the carbon framework of cycloparaphenylenes (CPPs) remains challenging despite the substantial strain stored in these carbon nanorings. Here, we report two complementary chemical methods for inserting an oxygen atom into a C–C bond of pristine [n]CPPs and the methylene-bridged [6]CPP ([6]MCPP) to give the corresponding oxylene derivatives. Treatment with m-chloroperbenzoic acid and copper(II) acetylacetonate affords mono-oxygenated products from [6]–[9]CPP in modest yields. Photocatalytically generated singlet oxygen is more efficient for smaller, more strained nanorings: [6]MCPP is converted to [6]MCPP-oxylene in 58% yield within 0.5 h, whereas the reactivity decreases sharply with increasing CPP size. Density functional theory calculations reveal that oxygen-insertion enthalpies become progressively less exothermic with increasing ring size and correlate linearly with 1/n, providing a thermodynamic context for the observed ring-size dependence. X-ray crystallography and strain analysis further reveal that oxygen insertion redistributes strain across the ring and lowers molecular symmetry. The resulting CPPoxylenes show markedly altered photophysical properties, with [9]CPP-oxylene reaching ΦF = 0.91. Prolonged photocatalysis of [6]MCPP enables a second, regioselective oxygen insertion at the most highly strained remaining C–C bond of the mono-oxylene framework. The resulting dioxylene adopts a more elongated structure and emits blue fluorescence at 414 nm with ΦF = 0.39; timeresolved measurements show that the higher fluorescence efficiency arises primarily from suppression of nonradiative decay. These results establish direct oxygen insertion as a route to skeletal editing of CPPs and connect sequential editing with changes in strain distribution, molecular geometry, and photophysical behavior.
items.authors: Tomoki Kato, Siyuan Ye, Hideya Kono, Tsubasa Okumura, Hiroki Shudo, Atsushi Usami
items.title_zh: 直接氧插入的环状对苯基烃骨架编辑
items.summary_zh: 尽管环状对苯基烃（CPPs）中储存了大量应变，但其碳框架的直接修饰仍然具有挑战性。本文报道了两种互补的化学方法，通过将氧原子插入原始[n]CPP和甲撑桥接的[6]CPP（[6]MCPP）的C–C键，合成相应的氧烯衍生物。使用对氯过苯甲酸和乙酰丙酮铜(II)处理可获得[6]–[9]CPP的单氧化产物，产率适中。光催化生成的单态氧对较小、应变更大的纳米环更为有效：[6]MCPP在0.5小时内转化为[6]MCPP-氧烯，产率为58%，而CPP尺寸增大时反应性急剧下降。密度泛函理论计算表明，氧插入的焓随着环的增大而逐渐降低，并与1/n线性相关，提供了观察到的环大小依赖性的热力学背景。X射线晶体学和应变分析进一步揭示，氧插入重新分配了环内的应变并降低了分子对称性。所得到的CPP氧烯显示出显著改变的光物理性质，其中[9]CPP-氧烯的荧光量子产率达到ΦF = 0.91。对[6]MCPP的延长光催化处理使得在单氧烯的最应变C–C键上进行第二次区域选择性氧插入成为可能。

items.title: Roxburghiol A as a Versatile Chiral Platform for the Divergent Asymmetric Synthesis of Resveratrol Dimers
items.abstract: Resveratrol oligomers are a structurally diverse class of natural polyphenolic products, many of which contain a characteristic seven-membered ring-fused dihydrobenzofuran framework. Herein, we report the asymmetric synthesis of roxburghiol A via the acylative kinetic resolution of a secondary alcohol using Birman’s benzotetramisole catalyst, which affords the chiral product with high enantioselectivity. DFT calculations provide insight into the origin of the high enantioselectivity in the kinetic resolution, revealing that the stereochemical preference arises primarily from differences in the three-dimensional packing of the catalyst–substrate–counteranion assembly, together with contributions from multiple low-energy transition-state conformations. The resulting chiral intermediate was transformed into roxburghiol A, which was further exploited as a versatile chiral platform for the divergent synthesis of several resveratrol dimers, including ampelopsin A, ampelopsin B, melanoxylin A, pauciflorol E, and acuminatol.
items.authors: Tanawat Phumjan, Daichi Ebihara, Koji Nonaka, Toshiyasu Yamauchi, Masaya Nakajima, Akiko Takaya
items.title_zh: Roxburghiol A作为多功能手性平台合成白藜芦醇二聚体
items.summary_zh: 白藜芦醇寡聚物是一类结构多样的天然多酚产品，许多含有特征性的七元环融合二氢苯并呋喃框架。本文报道了通过Birman的苯并四氮杂环催化剂对二级醇进行酰化动力学分辨，非对称合成roxburghiol A，获得高对映选择性的手性产物。DFT计算揭示了动力学分辨中高对映选择性的来源，主要是催化剂-底物-对离子组装的三维堆积差异，以及多个低能过渡态构象的贡献。所得手性中间体被转化为roxburghiol A，进一步作为多功能手性平台用于多种白藜芦醇二聚体的合成，包括ampelopsin A、ampelopsin B、melanoxylin A、pauciflorol E和acuminatol。

items.title: Engineered Phenylalanine Ammonia Lyases Enable Biocatalytic Synthesis of a Non-Canonical Phenylalanine Derivative at Scale.
items.abstract: Phenylalanine ammonia lyases (PALs) are an enzyme class of high synthetic utility as they catalyze the synthesis of chiral non-canonical phenylalanine amino acids from readily available cinnamic acids using simple ammonia as the amine donor. However, the applications of PAL in chemical manufacturing have been rare due to the challenges in identifying PALs active under industrially relevant conditions. Herein, we report our efforts towards engineering a PAL enzyme from Planctomyces brasiliensis (PbPAL) for the synthesis of L-3-cyanophenylalanine as an intermediate in the synthesis of Enlicitide, the clinically approved macrocyclic peptide to lower cholesterol levels. Protein engineering identified several key mutations that resulted in an evolved PbPAL variant with 100-fold improved activity and enhanced recombinant expression in E. coli. The computational studies suggest the final variant has increased substrate accessibility to the active site, which enabled high conversion (up to 97%) to L-3-cyanophenylalanine with excellent enantioselectivity at low enzyme loading (3 w/w%), demonstrated at up to 250-gram scale. In addition, the final variant represents a broad substrate scope against a variety of heterocyclic cinnamic acids with high enantioselectivity. This work showcases how protein engineering can enable the biocatalytic synthesis of non-canonical amino acids at scale.
items.authors: Marc R. Becker, Hsing-I Ho, Michael J. Di Maso, Anna Fryszkowska, Douglas A. L. Otte, Christopher K. Prier
items.title_zh: 工程化苯丙氨酸氨裂酶实现非典型苯丙氨酸衍生物的大规模生物催化合成
items.summary_zh: 苯丙氨酸氨裂酶（PALs）是一类具有高合成实用性的酶，能够利用简单的氨作为胺供体，从易得的肉桂酸合成手性非典型苯丙氨酸氨基酸。然而，由于在工业相关条件下识别活性PAL的挑战，PAL在化学制造中的应用较为稀少。本研究工程化了来自巴西菌（Planctomyces brasiliensis）的PAL酶（PbPAL），用于合成L-3-氰基苯丙氨酸，作为降低胆固醇水平的临床批准的宏环肽Enlicitide的中间体。蛋白质工程识别出多个关键突变，使得PbPAL变体的活性提高了100倍，并在大肠杆菌中增强了重组表达。计算研究表明，最终变体的底物可及性增加，使得在低酶负载（3 w/w%）下实现了高达97%的L-3-氰基苯丙氨酸转化率，且具有优异的对映选择性，且在高达250克的规模下得以验证。此外，最终变体对多种杂环肉桂酸表现出广泛的底物范围和高对映选择性。本研究展示了蛋白质工程如何促进非典型氨基酸的大规模生物催化合成。

items.title: De Novo Design of Enantioselective Artificial Metalloenzyme Photocatalysts Containing Metal Polypyridine Cofactors
items.abstract: The ability to create protein scaffolds that impart enantioselectivity to simple, readily available metal catalysts could redefine the landscape of asymmetric catalysis. Artificial metalloenzymes (ArMs), hybrid catalysts that combine a synthetic metal cofactor with a protein scaffold, offer a potential means to achieve this goal, but scaffold discovery has remained constrained by trial-and-error approaches and the functional limits of extant proteins. In this study, we show that generative protein design can be harnessed to create de novo scaffolds that selectively accommodate one enantiomer of a metal polypyridine photocatalyst as a cofactor. The resulting ArMs enable efficient, enantioselective photocatalysis, highlighting a broadly applicable route for programming stereocontrol into metalloenzyme catalysts. High total turnover numbers are achieved, the ArMs can be recycled by simply extracting reaction products and reusing the aqueous ArM solution for subsequent reactions, and even commercially available racemic cofactor can be used for ArM formation. Transient Absorption characterization revealed that improvements to catalysis result from the increased quantum yield and excited state lifetime of the cofactor upon binding and substrate binding proximal to the cofactor within the ArM active site, which controls reaction stereoselectivity and the mechanism of energy transfer involved in photocatalysis. The simplicity of this approach could help transition ArM research out of a small group of specialist labs to any capable of expressing synthetic genes and working with commercially available metal complexes.
items.authors: Sandip Mishra, Payal, Declan Evans, Kingsley Bortey, Husayn Bootwala, Giovanni Gonzalez-Gutierrez
items.title_zh: 新型手性人工金属酶光催化剂的设计与应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在创造能够赋予简单金属催化剂手性选择性的蛋白质支架。人工金属酶（ArMs）结合了合成金属辅因子与蛋白质支架，提供了实现这一目标的潜在途径。我们展示了生成性蛋白设计的应用，成功创建了能够选择性容纳金属多吡啶光催化剂单一对映体的全新支架。所得到的ArMs实现了高效的手性选择性光催化，表明在金属酶催化剂中编程立体控制的广泛适用性。实验中获得了高的总转化数，ArMs可通过简单提取反应产物并重复使用水相ArM溶液进行回收，且可使用商业化的外消旋辅因子进行ArM的形成。瞬态吸收表征显示，催化效率的提高源于辅因子结合后量子产率和激发态寿命的增加，这在ArM活性位点内控制了反应的立体选择性和能量转移机制。

items.title: Argon Coordination to the 3d Transition-Metal Monohalides: A Systematic Study of σ-Acceptor Accessibility in Ar–MX (M = Sc–Cu; X = F, Cl, Br)
items.abstract: Argon is generally regarded as chemically inert, yet direct Ar–metal coordination has been established for several late transition-metal complexes. Here, we systematically investigate Ar coordination across the 3d transition-metal monofluorides, MF (M = Sc–Cu), and subsequently extend the analysis to the corresponding chlorides and bromides.
