items.abstract: Reinforcement learning is increasingly deployed in autonomous systems whose reward functions encode operational priorities and decision-making objectives. However, observable behavior can enable external observers to infer sensitive reward parameters through inverse reinforcement learning. Existing deployment-time defenses mainly rely on action randomization or deception, without explicitly accounting for how previously released behavior affects the additional reward-sensitive information contributed by subsequent actions. To address this gap, we propose FisherShield, a deployment-time mechanism that balances task value against marginal reward-information exposure. Under a specified reference observer model, FisherShield computes the sensitivity of action log-likelihoods to the private reward and accumulates the sensitivity directions of released actions in an empirical information matrix. For each candidate action, the increase in the matrix’s log-determinant measures its marginal reference-score exposure and is converted into a weighted penalty subtracted from the task value. Updating the matrix after each release makes the penalty depend on the observation history, enabling sequential exposure control without retraining the task policy. Experiments show that FisherShield reduces cumulative reference-score log-det exposure by 26.4% in FourRooms and 34.3% in LavaGrid relative to Expert while preserving near-expert utility. The results are limited to the specified reference-model Bayesian observer and do not establish robustness to model misspecification or a defense-aware attacker.
items.authors: Guangyu Pan, Yao Chen, Bo Hou, Wende Yang, Yuhui Chen

items.title: Suboptimality of Probability Matching: A Formal Characterization, a Graphical Analysis and an Impulse Balance Interpretation
items.abstract: We characterize the suboptimality of probability matching in prediction tasks with an arbitrary (finite) number of equally rewarded, independent and identically distributed outcomes and an arbitrary number of repetitions, for deterministic, randomized and history-dependent guessing. The characterization gives the condition under which probability matching attains the maximal expected payoff and quantifies the loss it entails otherwise. For the common case of binary prediction tasks, we also provide a graphical representation of the result. Finally, we relate probability matching to impulse balance equilibrium theory and show when probability matching is consistent with its predictions.
items.authors: Vittorio Larocca, Luca Panaccione

items.title: “Truths We Don’t Suspect”: Binary Frameworks, Epistemic Excess, and the Production of Data About Nature Across Five Fields
items.abstract: Binary oppositions used in scientific practice—such as male/female for classifying organisms, natural/social for delimiting causal explanations, signal/noise as variations recorded by measurements, and normal/anomalous for sorting meaningful observations—do not merely describe a preclassified world. They shape what researchers expect to find, what instruments and databases are designed to record, what counts as reliable evidence, and what is relegated to error or exception. This exploratory, theory-building study draws on 10 in-depth interviews (2 per participant) with 5 researchers in paleoecology, microbial ecology, astronomy, glaciology, and human geography/climate science. Each participant’s interviews were integrated into a field-specific case, yielding five cases for cross-case analysis. I examined reported binary distinctions and related classificatory boundaries across three interconnected moments—observation, instrumentation, and data production—and distinguished their evidentiary status in each case. Binary thinking constitutes a particular form of categorization: it organizes phenomena into two mutually exclusive positions, often treated as exhaustive. When embedded in research procedures and infrastructures, these distinctions can shape what becomes observable and recordable, while rendering phenomena that do not fit either position harder to recognize, preserve, or investigate. Through abductive comparison, I conceptualize observations, ambiguities, and possibilities that do not fit previously established categories as epistemic excess and propose epistemic accountability as the practice of documenting classificatory decisions, preserving uncertainty and the production history of data, and keeping categories open to revision. The findings generate propositions for field-specific research rather than estimates of disciplinary prevalence and suggest that making classificatory choices visible may support more inclusive and reliable knowledge and policy.
items.authors: Claudia Matus

items.title: Transformational Leadership and Heterogeneity in Teachers’ Readiness for AI Integration: A Complementary Variable- and Person-Centered Approach
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in education has attracted increasing global attention. Existing studies have mainly examined teachers’ AI adoption intention in relation to technology-related perceptions and broader school-level conditions, but the role of transformational leadership remains underexplored. Drawing on complementary perspectives from the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology 2 (UTAUT2) and Self-Determination Theory (SDT), this study examined transformational leadership in relation to teachers’ readiness for AI integration using complementary variable- and person-centered analyses of data from 596 Chinese in-service K-12 teachers. The variable-centered results showed that transformational leadership was positively associated with teachers’ behavioral intention to use AI tools, with indirect associations involving willingness to develop AI competence and constructivist teaching beliefs. The person-centered analysis identified four readiness profiles: (1) Favorable Orientation but Behavioral Hesitation, (2) Limited Orientation and Behavioral Hesitation, (3) Low Orientation and Weak Behavioral Inclination, and (4) Favorable Orientation and Behavioral Inclination. Profiles 1 and 4 both showed relatively high constructivist beliefs and willingness to develop AI competence, but Profile 4 reported stronger behavioral intention to use AI tools. Profiles 2 and 3 were below the sample average across all three indicators, with Profile 3 showing the lowest behavioral intention. Relative to Profile 1, higher transformational leadership was associated with greater odds of membership in Profile 4 and lower odds of membership in Profile 3. These findings suggest that teachers’ readiness for AI integration varies in both level and configuration, highlighting the need for differentiated leadership and professional support.
items.authors: Yaxuan Geng, Kangjie Geng, Kai Wang, Qianqian Ruan

items.title: Longitudinal Course of Gait Kinematics and Kinetics After Guided Growth for Idiopathic Genu Valgum: Three-Dimensional Gait Analysis to Skeletal Maturity
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Guided growth changes frontal-plane gait mechanics in idiopathic genu valgum, but the durability of these adaptations through skeletal maturity remains uncertain. This study examined their long-term course. Methods: Seventeen participants (31 treated limbs) underwent three-dimensional gait analysis before plate insertion (t0), shortly before plate removal (t1), and after skeletal maturity (t2). Primary outcomes were the mean frontal knee angle during single support and the early- and late-stance peaks and stance mean of the internal frontal-plane knee moment. Longitudinal changes were assessed using linear mixed-effects models accounting for participant and limb dependence. Exploratory comparisons used laboratory reference data from 11 healthy participants. Results: Mean follow-up after plate removal was 59.66 ± 12.13 months. The mean frontal knee angle changed from −5.34° ± 2.61° at t0 to −0.08° ± 2.66° at t1 and −0.61° ± 2.27° at t2. The model-estimated change from t1 to t2 was −0.53° (95% confidence interval, −1.50° to 0.44°; Bonferroni-adjusted p = 0.798). All three knee-moment measures increased from t0 to t1, with no significant further changes to t2. These moments were below the laboratory reference values at t0 but above them at t1 and t2. Hip- and knee-rotation differences from the reference group persisted. Conclusions: Frontal-plane knee adaptations observed shortly before plate removal persisted, with small mean changes through skeletal maturity. Persistent kinetic and rotational differences suggest incomplete convergence toward the laboratory reference pattern. Further studies should examine the clinical relevance of these differences.
items.authors: Philipp Scheider, Ghanem El-Isa, Sebastian Farr, Andreas Kranzl

items.title: Buckwheat Hulls as an Emerging Industrial Feedstock: Valorisation Pathways, Technological Readiness, and Scale-Up Challenges
items.abstract: Buckwheat dehulling produces a concentrated side stream rich in dietary fibre and phenolic compounds. The lignocellulosic structure of the hull also makes it suitable for several forms of material and thermochemical processing. Earlier reviews have focused mainly on composition, extraction, and food applications; much less attention has been paid to whether the proposed uses are ready for industrial implementation. This critical narrative review compares direct food and fibre use, extraction of bioactive compounds, biosorption, production of biochar and engineered carbons, polymer and wood-based composites, and solid-fuel applications. Peer-reviewed studies formed the primary evidence base, while targeted patent screening was used as supplementary evidence of buckwheat-hull-specific technological concepts and was not treated as proof of pilot- or commercial-scale readiness. The available evidence was assessed with regard to unit operations, product function, processing intensity, application-relevant testing, scale-up limitations, and indicative Technology Readiness Levels. Among the assessed pathways, direct food incorporation showed the highest technological maturity, with BH-enriched bakery products produced under commercial bakery conditions, providing evidence beyond laboratory-scale validation. Pelletisation and combustion, together with selected biochar applications, showed intermediate technological readiness, whereas extraction and engineered carbon applications remain supported mainly by laboratory-scale studies. Composite processing can draw on established industrial equipment, although this does not by itself confirm the readiness of complete BH-specific processes. Selected biochar studies extend performance testing to laboratory fixed-bed metal removal or agronomic reuse after phosphorus adsorption. Across all routes, the most important barriers to industrial implementation are feedstock variability and lack of standardisation, insufficient validation at pilot or operational scale, and limited techno-economic and life-cycle evidence. Logistics and resource requirements represent additional constraints, particularly for low-value and resource-intensive pathways. Cascading use, in which valuable fractions are recovered before the remaining solids are directed to material or energy applications, is a promising option, but integrated buckwheat hull biorefineries have yet to be demonstrated beyond laboratory scale.
items.authors: Dariusz Dziki

items.title: Sustainable Bio-Oil Production from Sugarcane Bagasse: Modified Natural Clinoptilolite as a High-Performance, Low-Cost Alternative to ZSM-5 Zeolite
items.abstract: In Colombia, annual sugarcane bagasse (SCB) generation reaches 10.86 Mt, and the residue has a higher heating value (HHV) of approximately 13.0 MJ kg−1. This study evaluated SCB catalytic pyrolysis using natural clinoptilolite (CLI) modified by sulfuric acid (CLI-SA), phosphoric acid (CLI-PA), or ammonium chloride exchange (CLI-AC), with commercial ZSM-5 as a benchmark. A mild 2 vol.% H2O2 treatment was applied for 12 h at 25 °C primarily for biological stabilization and as a gentle oxidative wash; no quantitative delignification is claimed. Pyrolysis was conducted at 475 °C for 5 min under N2 (60 mL min−1) with 5 wt.% catalyst. CLI-PA achieved the highest bio-oil yield (65.1%) and estimated HHV (20.5 MJ kg−1), compared with 46.5% and 16.8 MJ kg−1 for ZSM-5 and approximately 16.4 MJ kg−1 for the thermal liquid. Targeted GC-MS/SIM profiles, interpreted semi-quantitatively, showed a toluene-normalized area of 28.989% for CLI-PA versus 7.287% for thermal pyrolysis; oxygenated products nevertheless remained substantial. A cradle-to-gate screening LCA (1 kg catalyst, OpenLCA/CML Baseline) showed ZSM-5/CLI-PA ratios of 6.00–6.50 across nine impact categories (mean 6.19), while the estimated catalyst-related cost was 42.95-fold higher for ZSM-5. These findings identify CLI-PA as a promising low-cost catalyst under the tested conditions, while catalyst structure, acid-site distribution, reuse, gas-phase products, and effluent treatment remain priorities for further validation.
items.authors: Lorena Santa Taborda, Nancy Montes, Paola Andrea Villega-Bolaños, Omar D. Gutiérrez

items.title: Care Practices: A Concept Analysis
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: To analyze the concept of “care practices” as an abstract, relevant element of interest to the nursing discipline. Methods: The Walker Avant methodology was followed, a structured eight-stage process that ranges from the choice of the concept and the identification of its essential features to the creation of comparative examples (cases) and the definition of their practical effects. The analysis was based on the paradigm of simultaneity, a vision that breaks with the traditional biomedical model, to understand the human being as an indivisible unit. Recognizing the tension between the analytical-positivist roots of the method and the chosen paradigm, Walker Avant was used in an adaptive, heuristic way. Results: Based on the review of 12 predominantly qualitative articles, “care practices” are defined as actions aimed at solving needs in situations of vulnerability through an interpersonal bond influenced by the environment. Five defining dimensions were identified: awareness of vulnerability, activities in the intersubjective human bond, influence of the environment, recognition of intersectionality without judgment, and the active care of the self. Conclusions: Concept analysis provides nursing with scientific rigor, allowing for the delimitation of its scope and grounding its practice. “Care practices” transcend a mere activity to become a profound human encounter based on the recognition of shared vulnerability, involving not only healthcare personnel but human beings in general.
items.authors: Marcio Jiménez-Gutiérrez, Elizabeth Vargas-Rosero, Gloria Mabel Carrillo-González, María de los Ángeles Torres-Lagunas, Guillermina Arenas-Montaño, Irma Cortés-Escárcega

items.title: A New Bowhead Whale-like Genus from the Early Pliocene of Antwerpen Illuminates Phylogenetic Relationships and Body Size Evolution in Balaenidae (Cetacea, Mysticeti)
items.abstract: Right and bowhead whales represent key species in modern-day marine ecosystems because of their capacity to catch enormous amounts of prey items (especially calanoid copepod crustaceans). However, their evolutionary history is still not completely understood. Morphology- and molecule-based phylogenetic analyses failed to find a consensus view about the relationships of balaenids and other mysticete species and in determining the intra-family relationships of extant and fossil taxa. The fossil record may help in increasing the precision of morphology-based phylogenetic results when new balaenid species are discovered because the new fossils may add new character combinations able to change previously published hypotheses of relationships. Here, we describe a new balaenid genus and species, Quasibalaena portisantuerpiae, based on a partial skull from the Early Pliocene of Belgium. The new specimen preserves relevant portions of the cranium, periotic and tympanic bulla, and shows a character combination never observed up to now in other balaenid fossils. We compared the new taxon to all the other balaenid species known and included it in a morphology-based phylogenetic analysis. The results suggest that Balaenidae includes a stem group and two main subclades, respectively related to the extant bowhead whale (Balaena mysticetus) and to the right whales (genus Eubalaena). Quasibalaena portisantuerpiae belongs in the former subclade. Body size reconstruction allowed us to infer that the origin of the Balaena-related clade was characterized by a miniaturization process and that gigantism occurred independently in bowhead and right whales.
items.authors: Michelangelo Bisconti, Mark Bosselaers

items.title: Some Synthetic Approaches for Copper-Containing Terpyridine-Functionalized Polysiloxane Complexes
items.abstract: Terpyridine-containing polysiloxanes (tpy-PMHS and tpy-PDMS) were synthesized via hydrosilylation and used as macromolecular ligands for coordination with copper(I) and copper(II) precursors. As a result, a series of novel polymer–metal complexes (Cu-tpy-PMHS and Cu-tpy-PDMS) with diverse architectures (cross-linked and end-functionalized polymers) and different copper oxidation states were obtained. These polymer–metal complexes were comprehensively characterized by solid-state NMR, UV–vis, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and thermogravimetric analysis. The redox activity of the cross-linked Cu-tpy-PMHS-2 sample was investigated using cyclic voltammetry. Cu-tpy-PDMS-1 exhibited catalytic activity in mechanochemical azide–alkyne cycloaddition, affording the target product in 80% yield.
items.authors: Sofia S. Kryukova, Elena R. Votchel, Sergey V. Baykov, Vadim P. Boyarskiy, Regina M. Islamova

items.title: Dual-Domain Fusion for Small-Object SAR Ship Detection in Complex Scenes
items.abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection is essential for maritime surveillance, yet coherent speckle can obscure tiny offshore vessels, while high-response coastal structures can produce target-like responses. Repeated downsampling further weakens sparse vessel signatures, whereas a separate high-resolution prediction head increases dense prediction costs. We propose a dual-domain detector that embeds spatial–frequency encoding, multiscale refinement, and high-resolution feature transfer within the backbone–neck–pyramid representation. Scharr-derived boundary cues are coupled with learned frequency context and remain discriminative as features are fused across scales, while sample-preserving space-to-depth transformation and global–local receptive-field modeling integrate shallow detail into semantically stronger P3 features without introducing a separate P2 prediction head. Coordinated FSEM, MSFE, and SOEP modules preserve fine vessel structure and reduce clutter-induced ambiguity throughout the detection hierarchy. Experiments on SSDD, HRSID, and RSDD-SAR evaluate detection accuracy, cross-dataset transfer, limited-data behavior, sensitivity to controlled perturbations, and edge deployment. Across 30 seed-matched SSDD runs, the method improves mAP50:95 over the baseline by 2.70±0.34 percentage points. It achieves 69.3% and 71.5% mAP50:95 on HRSID and RSDD. On the Atlas 200I platform, the compiled FP16 model retains 69.3% mAP50:95 while running at 101.8 frames/s.
items.authors: Zijing Song, Panlong Tan, Xiaoyu Zhang

items.title: How Urbanization and Land Transfer Shape Carbon Emissions in Agricultural Systems: Evidence from Central China
items.abstract: Reducing agricultural carbon emissions (ACE) requires understanding how urban–rural transformation and land reallocation jointly reshape agricultural production. Using county-level data from Hubei Province, China, for 2019–2021, this study examined the spatial and nonlinear associations among urbanization (URB), agricultural land transfer (ALT), and ACE through spatial autocorrelation analysis, spatial panel models, and geographical convergent cross-mapping. URB, ALT, and ACE exhibited significant spatial dependence, with high-value clusters concentrated mainly in central Hubei. ALT showed a significant level-dependent nonlinear association with URB. URB and ALT were also significantly associated with ACE in a level-dependent nonlinear manner, with negative linear and positive quadratic components, whereas their joint term showed the opposite pattern. The directional-linkage analysis further revealed both recurring and year-specific connections between multiple dimensions of URB and ALT. Taken together, these findings show that the relationships among URB, ALT, and ACE are spatially interdependent, multidimensional, and dependent on local development conditions rather than adequately represented by constant linear relationships. Agricultural carbon mitigation should therefore combine cross-county spatial coordination with differentiated policies that reflect local URB and ALT conditions, particularly in spatially clustered areas.
items.authors: Jianling Liu, Kaili Peng, Nannan Liu, Shenglong Fan, Shengpeng Li

items.title: Computational Modeling of Thoracic Aortic Stent-Grafts: Bibliometric Analysis and Current Trends
items.abstract: Computational modeling has become an important tool for investigating complex cardiovascular conditions and supporting the development and evaluation of endovascular treatments. In thoracic aortic disease, numerical approaches provide tools for examining the interaction between blood flow, arterial mechanics, and implanted stent-grafts under physiologically relevant conditions. This study reviews the application of computational methods to thoracic endovascular aortic interventions, considering the main approaches used to investigate their hemodynamic, structural, and biomechanical behavior. The database was retrieved from the Web of Science on 20 March 2026, yielding a total of 99 records, of which 94 were retained. A bibliometric analysis is first presented to quantify the available literature, characterizing the evolution of the field, major research directions, and methodological developments. Then, the literature is discussed with a focus on the capabilities of computational methodologies, particularly computational fluid dynamics, the finite element method, and fluid–structure interaction. The literature shows a growth in computational investigations, with computational fluid dynamics being the most frequently employed approach, complemented by finite element and fluid–structure interaction methods. The representative studies examined also illustrate the development of patient-specific and multiphysics approaches alongside more conventional computational models. These developments have expanded the potential of computational simulations for studying disease progression, device performance, treatment strategies, and post-intervention outcomes. However, challenges related to computational cost, physiological boundary conditions, material properties, model assumptions, and experimental or clinical validation remain.
items.authors: Neyling Macalopú, Nicolás Amigo

items.title: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Investigation of Fat Mass and Lean Mass in 193 Male Elite Youth Soccer Players
items.abstract: Background: Youth soccer is practiced worldwide. However, body composition during youth soccer practice has received limited attention despite its well-known impact on performance. Methods: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) estimated whole-body and regional fat and fat-free soft tissue mass, and percent fat mass in a large sample (n = 193; 172 White, 21 Black) of male elite youth soccer players aged 14–19 years competing in an Italian Serie A Club. The role of playing position in shaping body composition was also explored. Results: Black players had higher appendicular fat-free mass index (p = 0.009) and lower total body less head (TBLH) fat mass index (p = 0.050) than White players. Within the entire sample of players, analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) conducted using several confounding variables as covariates showed a statistically significant effect of playing position for TBLH fat-free soft tissue mass (p = 0.049) and appendicular fat mass (p = 0.039), with the goalkeepers showing higher appendicular fat mass than defenders (p = 0.031). Also, playing position showed a significant effect on TBLH fat-free mass index (p = 0.044). Effect sizes for statistically significant ethnic differences ranged from η2p = 0.02–0.06, whereas positional effects ranged from η2p = 0.05–0.21, indicating that several, but not all, observed effects were small in magnitude. Descriptive percentiles for demographic and body composition variables and indices were calculated in three two-year age classes for White players only, because of the limited number of Black players. Conclusions: In our cross-sectional, single-club sample of male elite youth soccer players, DXA analysis provided descriptive data on fat- and lean-mass variables overall and according to playing position. Findings related to ethnicity should be interpreted cautiously because of the limited number of Black players. The percentiles provided for White players may serve as descriptive benchmarks for youth players.
items.authors: Valentina Cavedon, Carlo Zancanaro, Chiara Milanese

items.title: Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Joint Fault Diagnosis in Inverter-Fed Induction Motor Drives
items.abstract: In intelligent electric vehicle (EV) traction drives, pulse-width modulation and field-oriented control (FOC) introduce broadband harmonics and non-stationary start-up transients. These dynamics obscure incipient inter-turn stator faults (ITSF), particularly when inverter switch failures and measurement interference co-occur. To meet the low-latency requirements of on-board vehicle control units (VCUs), this paper proposes a data-centric, physics-guided diagnosis pipeline. Relying exclusively on current measurements, the framework jointly detects and localises ITSF (1–3% severity), open-circuit IGBT faults, and additive white Gaussian noise (5–20 dB SNR). A compact 27-dimensional feature vector is constructed by fusing db4 discrete wavelet transform sub-band energies, residualised negative-sequence phasors, αβ hodograph descriptors, and harmonic energy ratios. This targeted extraction empowers an ensemble of bagged decision trees to perform lightweight classification suitable for embedded edge hardware. In a simulation-based evaluation across four scenarios (transient and steady state, with and without AWGN), the pipeline achieves cross-validated accuracies of 91.63–98.97% and hold-out test accuracies of 93.13–98.75%. Unlike traditional threshold detectors that conflate inverter or sensing artefacts with ITSF, this approach achieves subsystem-level localisation across motor, inverter, and sensing hardware, providing the reliable condition monitoring required for cyber–physical EV digital twins.
items.authors: Peter Makeen, Fang Duan

items.title: Freshwater Plankton Biodiversity Under Urban Pressure: Contrasting Responses of Phytoplankton and Zooplankton in Urban Ponds
items.abstract: Urban ponds are increasingly recognised as important refuges for freshwater biodiversity within human-dominated landscapes. However, phytoplankton and zooplankton are often studied separately, leaving unresolved whether different plankton components provide a consistent picture of biodiversity responses to urban pressure. We investigated both plankton groups in 15 small urban ponds in Poznań (western Poland) differing in the degree of human impact. We compared community structure, species richness, abundance, indicator taxa, and relationships with trophic state. A total of 339 phytoplankton and 148 zooplankton taxa were recorded, including 99 rotifers, 35 cladocerans, and 14 copepods. Zooplankton responded strongly to human impact, with significantly lower species richness in more strongly impacted ponds than in less disturbed ponds. This difference was also reflected in cumulative richness, which reached 128 taxa in only seven less disturbed ponds compared with 91 taxa in eight human-impacted ponds. In contrast, phytoplankton richness did not differ between pond categories, although its abundance was significantly higher in more strongly impacted ponds. Increasing trophic state was associated with lower zooplankton richness but higher abundance of both zooplankton and phytoplankton. Notably, corresponding biodiversity metrics of phytoplankton and zooplankton were not significantly related, indicating that the two groups conveyed largely independent ecological information. Community composition analyses further revealed contrasting responses: the degree of human impact significantly explained zooplankton composition, whereas none of the tested environmental variables significantly explained phytoplankton composition. Several eutrophic rotifer taxa, including Brachionus angularis, Anuraeopsis fissa, and Keratella tecta, were associated with anthropogenically influenced ponds, while fourteen indicator species characterised less disturbed ponds. Our results show that the ecological picture of an urban pond depends partly on which plankton component is examined. Despite sharing the same ponds and environmental setting, phytoplankton and zooplankton conveyed contrasting and largely independent biodiversity signals. Zooplankton provided a clearer signal of local anthropogenic disturbance, whereas phytoplankton responses were expressed mainly through changes in abundance and trophic-state-related patterns. Thus, relying on a single plankton group may provide only a partial assessment of biodiversity responses to urban pressure. Integrating phytoplankton and zooplankton can provide a more complete ecological assessment, while the high taxonomic richness recorded particularly in less disturbed ponds reinforces the biodiversity value of small urban waters.
items.authors: Natalia Kuczyńska-Kippen, Anna Kozak

items.title: Hydrogeochemical and Mineralogical Constraints on the Origin of Elevated Uranium and Radon in a Fractured Granitic Aquifer
items.abstract: This study investigated the hydrogeochemical and mineralogical factors governing the occurrence of U and Rn in a fractured granitic aquifer. A 120-m-deep borehole was drilled, and depth-discrete groundwater samples were collected during wet and dry seasons for analyses of water quality and naturally occurring radioactive materials; petrographic and mineralogical analyses were conducted on the recovered drill core. U and Rn concentrations reached 488.1 μg L−1 and 1549.8 Bq L−1, respectively, exceeding Korean drinking-water criteria. Both generally increased with depth and were lower in the dry season than in the wet season. Oxic, mildly alkaline groundwater with elevated HCO3− favored U mobilization through uranyl–carbonate complexation, whereas Rn was primarily controlled by fracture connectivity and mixing between shallow and deep groundwater. Microfractures and pores in metamict U–Th-bearing minerals provided reactive surfaces and release pathways that promoted U leaching and Rn emanation. The occurrence of U and Rn therefore reflects the coupled effects of hydrogeochemical conditions, fracture development, groundwater mixing, and the susceptibility of radioactive minerals to alteration. These findings provide a mechanistic basis for interpreting and predicting naturally occurring radionuclide behavior in fractured granitic aquifers.
items.authors: Jihyeon Yun, Si-On Seo, Jong-Hwan Lee, Woo-Chun Lee, Sang-Woo Lee, Do Hwan Jeong

items.title: Beyond the Image: Xiang and the Changing Functions of Christian Images in Late Ming and Early Qing China
items.abstract: Studies of Christian images in late-Ming China have largely focused on the iconographic and stylistic adaptation of European pictorial models. This article shifts attention from pictorial transformation to the changing functions of images across different contexts of circulation and reception. Taking Johann Adam Schall von Bell’s Jincheng Shuxiang 進呈書像 (1640) as its central case, it examines the historical semantics of xiang 像, the book’s material organization of text and image, differences among its surviving copies, and Yang Guangxian’s later appropriation of its illustrations in the anti-Christian Budeyi 不得已. The analysis situates xiang within the overlapping vocabulary of late-Ming illustrated books rather than treating it as a self-contained theory of religious images. More importantly, the transmission from Jincheng Shuxiang to Budeyi demonstrates that pictorial recognizability and image function did not necessarily travel together. Christian pictorial material could remain recognizable while being redirected from devotional and didactic contexts into anti-Christian polemical argument, while textual and pictorial components could follow partially independent trajectories of transmission.
items.authors: Yichen Hu

items.title: The Glial Coupling in the Developing Brain: Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes and Myelin Formation
items.abstract: Astrocytes and oligodendrocytes contribute to the metabolic, homeostatic and structural organization of the developing brain, yet their interactions evolve across development and remain incompletely characterized during the earliest stages of life. This narrative review examines astrocyte–oligodendrocyte coupling in relation to myelin development and addresses the question of which cellular and metabolic mechanisms support oligodendrocyte maturation and white-matter metabolism before mature astrocytic functions are fully established. Evidence from preterm and ill term neonates is considered together with experimental and adult or elderly studies used exclusively for secondary mechanistic comparison. Astrocytes and oligodendrocytes participate in interconnected metabolic, developmental and homeostatic processes, while perinatal white-matter injury may combine reactive astrogliosis, pre-oligodendrocyte injury and maturation arrest. Neuroimaging, including quantitative susceptibility mapping, synthetic MRI, cranial ultrasound and molecular or myelin-sensitive imaging, provides complementary but indirect information on the structural and maturational consequences of these processes, whereas omics approaches may characterize their molecular environment. Radiomics similarly provides indirect tissue-level biomarkers rather than cell-specific measures of glial biology. Dysglycaemia further illustrates the dependence of developing white matter on coordinated cellular energy handling and the potential relevance of immature astrocyte–oligodendrocyte interactions during metabolic instability. Evidence from very early development suggests that oligodendrocyte maturation occurs within a changing cellular environment in which astroglial maturation, neuronal and vascular processes, and immune and metabolic mechanisms coexist. The Crossword and Foil Effects are proposed as hypothesis-generating frameworks to organize these intersecting developmental, metabolic, cellular, imaging and molecular dimensions rather than as experimentally validated causal models. Overall, no single cellular substitute for mature astrocytic functions is identified; instead, oligodendrocyte maturation appears to emerge within a developmentally changing division of metabolic, homeostatic and signaling labour across astroglial, neuronal, vascular and immune compartments.
items.authors: Maria Ester Canepa, Chiara Santucci, Daiana Mariano, Sara Mangini, Andrea Calandrino, Luigi Gagliardi
items.title_zh: 发育大脑中的胶质细胞耦合：星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞与髓鞘形成
items.summary_zh: 星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞在发育大脑的代谢、稳态和结构组织中发挥重要作用，但它们的相互作用在发育过程中不断演变，且在生命早期阶段仍未完全表征。本文综述了星形胶质细胞与少突胶质细胞的耦合与髓鞘发育的关系，并探讨了在成熟星形胶质细胞功能尚未完全建立之前，哪些细胞和代谢机制支持少突胶质细胞的成熟和白质代谢。考虑了早产和足月新生儿的证据，并结合实验研究及成人或老年研究进行次级机制比较。星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞参与相互关联的代谢、发育和稳态过程，而围产期白质损伤可能结合反应性星形胶质增生、前少突胶质细胞损伤和成熟停滞。神经影像学技术提供了这些过程的结构和成熟后果的间接信息，而组学方法则可表征其分子环境。放射组学同样提供间接的组织水平生物标志物，而非细胞特异性的胶质生物学测量。

items.title: Simultaneous Quantification of Multiple Quality Traits Hidden in Living White/Pigmented Rice Seeds Both at 2D and 3D Level
items.abstract: Rice quality mainly includes milling, appearance, nutrition, eating, cooking and physicochemical qualities. Rice quality/grade assessment depends on multiple indicators (traits) testing based on the recommended methods in the executing rice standards. Regretfully, the quality/grade assessments for white and pigmented rice do not follow a unified standard. The utilization of a series of independent methods means complex operations, higher time requirements and cost because of the hidden, subtle, and irregular characteristics of quality traits. Destructive husking and polishing are usually the prerequisite steps before quality assessment, leading to a loss of seed activity. Additionally, these methods fail to provide spatial information of the quality traits within intact seeds. In this study, microCT was employed to capture the cross-section images of living rice seeds. We performed contrast and segmentation processes by using image segmentation software. Multiple quality traits were simultaneously determined using one group of cross-section images from one microCT scan both in living white and pigmented rice seeds. This research also expanded the scope of quality-related traits and displayed their 2D and (or) 3D information (e.g., linearity, area, surface area and volume). Our achievements can guide the establishment of a new unified standard for white and pigmented rice at the 3D level, and it also shows great potential for application in phenotyping and breeding.
items.authors: Zihan Wu, Min Sun, Qiwen Liang, Zhiwei Deng, Siyuan Wang, Shubo Zhou

items.title: ReversFix-Technology—A Randomized Clinical Trial Investigating Laser Versus Conventional Removal of Ceramic Veneers and Single Crowns
items.abstract: Objectives: The purpose of this prospective, randomized clinical study (RCT) was to investigate laser removal of ceramic restorations in terms of its effectiveness and potential advantages compared to conventional methods. Methods: In two study groups, with 20 patients each, veneers (study group V) and single crowns (study group C) made of lithium disilicate were adhesively fixed to vital, asymptomatic teeth. Following a period of wear of 7 ± 2 days, the patients were randomized into either of the two study arms (n = 10). In the control arm, the restorations were removed conventionally with diamond-coated rotary burs in combination with crown removal instruments. In the intervention arm, removal was performed with a pulsed Er:YAG laser (ReversFix-Technology). Results: In group V, all restorations were successfully removed in both study arms, with a significant time advantage observed in the intervention arm (p = 0.002). In group C, all ten restorations were removed conventionally, while in the intervention arm, seven restorations were removed initially and a further two after an additional week of wear; the time required for removal was comparable between the study arms. Using the laser-assisted technique, two veneers and seven crowns could also be removed completely in one piece. Conclusions: ReversFix-Technology can be considered an alternative to conventional methods for removing ceramic restorations. Laser removal even offers a time advantage, particularly for removing veneers. Moreover, in the case of non-destructive removal of the restorations, the option of recementation is possible.
items.authors: Sarah M. Blender, Heike Rudolph, Jens Dreyhaupt, Ralph G. Luthardt

items.title: Turkish Adaptation and Psychometric Evaluation of the Measure of Processes of Care for Service Providers in Pediatric Care and Rehabilitation
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Family-centered services (FCSs) are a key approach in pediatric healthcare and rehabilitation that promotes collaboration between service providers and families. The Measure of Processes of Care for Service Providers (MPOC-SP) is widely used to evaluate family-centered services from the provider perspective; however, no validated Turkish version is available. This study aimed to translate and culturally adapt the MPOC-SP into Turkish and to examine its factor structure, internal consistency, test–retest reliability, measurement error, and supplementary model-based construct indices among Turkish-speaking service providers working in pediatric healthcare, disability, and rehabilitation settings. Methods: The MPOC-SP was translated and culturally adapted following a structured cross-cultural adaptation process. A total of 267 service providers from multiple professional disciplines, institutional settings, and 15 provinces of Türkiye participated in the psychometric evaluation. Internal consistency was assessed using Cronbach’s alpha and McDonald’s omega. Test–retest reliability was evaluated in 86 participants using ICC(2,1), and measurement error was examined using the standard error of measurement (SEM) and minimal detectable change at the 95% confidence level (MDC95). The hypothesized four-factor structure was evaluated in 267 participants using confirmatory factor analysis based on polychoric correlations and diagonally weighted least squares (DWLS). Composite reliability, average variance extracted, the Fornell–Larcker criterion, and the heterotrait–monotrait ratio were examined as supplementary model-based indices. Institutional-group comparisons were exploratory. Results: The four subscales demonstrated high internal consistency, with Cronbach’s alpha coefficients ranging from 0.884 to 0.968 and McDonald’s omega coefficients from 0.885 to 0.968. Test–retest reliability was good to excellent (ICC[2,1] = 0.819–0.963), although small systematic decreases were observed for SIS and CSI. SEM values ranged from 0.228 to 0.328 and MDC95 values from 0.633 to 0.908. The four-factor model showed a good fit (χ2(318) = 463.24, CFI = 0.998, TLI = 0.998, RMSEA = 0.041, 90% CI [0.033–0.049], SRMR = 0.057), with standardized factor loadings ranging from 0.761 to 0.933. Composite reliability ranged from 0.899 to 0.976, AVE from 0.640 to 0.800, and HTMT values from 0.372 to 0.664. No substantial ceiling effects were observed at the subscale level; however, 14 of 27 items exceeded the predefined 15% criterion for item-level ceiling effects. Conclusions: The findings provide initial evidence supporting the four-factor structure and reliability of the Turkish MPOC-SP in this sample of service providers. Interpretation should focus on the four established subscales rather than an overall total score. Further studies in independent and more balanced samples are needed to examine external construct validity, measurement invariance, responsiveness, and clinically meaningful change.
items.authors: Cemil Özal, Duygu Türker, Mintaze Kerem Gunel

items.title: Understanding Morbihan Disease: A Scoping Review of the Clinical Features, Diagnosis, Histopathology, and Management
items.abstract: Morbihan disease is a rare chronic disorder characterized by persistent facial edema that is thought to result from lymphatic dysfunction associated with chronic inflammation. Because the condition is uncommon, the available literature consists primarily of case reports and small case series. This scoping review aimed to summarize the published literature on the clinical presentation, histopathologic findings, diagnostic approaches, and treatment outcomes of Morbihan disease. A literature search of PubMed identified 55 eligible studies comprising 136 patients. Morbihan disease most commonly affected middle-aged adults and was frequently associated with rosacea. Persistent edema most often involved the upper and lower eyelids, followed by the cheeks and forehead. The most frequently reported histopathologic findings were dermal edema, perivascular lymphocytic inflammatory infiltrates, granulomatous inflammation, and dilated lymphatic vessels. A variety of medical and surgical treatments were reported, with tetracycline-class antibiotics, corticosteroids, and isotretinoin used most frequently. Treatment outcomes were variable, with partial improvement reported more often than complete resolution. Overall, these findings highlight common patterns in Morbihan disease while also showing that its pathogenesis remains incompletely understood and that challenges remain in diagnosis and management.
items.authors: Brooke Heinbigner, Ilya Mukovozov
items.title_zh: 莫尔比汉病的临床特征与管理综述
items.summary_zh: 莫尔比汉病是一种罕见的慢性疾病，主要特征为持续性面部水肿，认为与慢性炎症相关的淋巴功能障碍有关。由于该病罕见，现有文献主要为病例报告和小型病例系列。本综述旨在总结莫尔比汉病的临床表现、组织病理学发现、诊断方法及治疗结果。通过PubMed文献检索，确定了55项符合条件的研究，共涉及136名患者。莫尔比汉病最常见于中年人，常与玫瑰痤疮相关。持续性水肿主要影响上下眼睑，其次是面颊和额头。最常见的组织病理学发现包括真皮水肿、血管周围淋巴细胞炎症浸润、肉芽肿性炎症及扩张的淋巴管。报道的治疗方法多样，以四环素类抗生素、皮质类固醇和异维A酸使用最为频繁。治疗结果各异，部分改善的情况多于完全缓解。总体而言，这些发现突显了莫尔比汉病的常见模式，但其发病机制仍未完全理解，诊断和管理仍面临挑战。

items.title: MSMFusion: A Method for Multiscale Dual-Path State Space Modeling for Multimodal Medical Image Fusion
items.abstract: Multimodal medical image fusion aims to integrate information from different imaging techniques to generate a single fused image that is comprehensive and rich in detail. Structural and functional imaging provide high-resolution anatomical details and tissue metabolic information, respectively. Complementary fusion improves quantitative fusion quality and preserves structural and functional information in one view, which aids clinical interpretation. Currently, convolutional neural network-based methods struggle to efficiently capture global features, whereas Transformer-based models excel at global modeling but incur relatively high computational costs. To address the above issues, we propose MSMFusion, a multiscale state-space modeling method for complementary structural–functional medical image fusion. A multiscale feature extraction module first extracts modality-specific multiscale structural features; subsequently, a dual-path MSMamba establishes long-range dependencies with linear complexity: the full-resolution scanning path preserves fine boundaries and textures, while the downsampled scanning path models global context with a more compact sequence; finally, a gated adaptive fusion module estimates spatial–channel weights based on local content to selectively integrate anatomical structure and functional metabolic information. On the Harvard medical image dataset, MSMFusion achieves a mutual information of 2.2181, a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 32.9390, and a structural similarity of 0.7616 on the MRI–PET task, and also outperforms various representative methods based on CNN, GAN, Transformer, and Mamba on the MRI–CT and MRI–SPECT tasks. Compared with the Transformer backbone, MSMamba reduces the number of parameters from 7.201M to 4.154M and the FLOPs from 476.738G to 159.239G, achieving superior fusion quality at lower computational cost while simultaneously preserving fine anatomical structures and key functional information.
items.authors: Liping Yang, Nairui Sun, Tengchao Sun, Yiming Chen, Yao Xiao, Shu Li

items.title: Lipid Metabolic Rewiring in Cancer Drug Resistance: Mechanisms, Implications, and Therapeutic Oppor-tunities
items.abstract: Cancer remains one of the leading causes of death worldwide, with drug resistance posing a major obstacle to successful therapy. Increasing evidence indicates that metabolic reprogramming enables cancer cells to adapt to therapeutic stress and survive treatment. In this review, we examine the in-terplay between lipid metabolism and drug resistance, discussing how alterations in lipid uptake, synthesis, storage, and utilization drive cancer-cell survival and adaptation. Particular attention is given to fatty acids, phospholipids, cholesterol, and lipid oxidation, and how their reprogramming influences cellular signaling, membrane composition, energy production, oxidative stress, and tu-mour-microenvironment interactions. We further discuss pharmacological strategies targeting de novo lipogenesis (ACLY, ACC, FASN, SCD1), cholesterol metabolism (statins/HMGCR inhibitors, LXR modulators, ACAT/SOAT inhibitors), fatty-acid oxidation (CPT1 inhibitors), lipid uptake and storage (LDLR, CD36, DGAT, and ATGL inhibitors), sphingolipid signaling (SphK1 inhibitors, S1PR1 modulators), and ferroptosis/lipid peroxidation (GPX4 inhibitors) to restore drug sensitivity. We also examine evidence that microRNAs (miRNAs) regulate lipid metabolic pathways and con-tribute to therapeutic resistance. Taken together, we highlight lipid metabolic reprogramming as a coordinated adaptive network rather than a series of independent changes and position lipid me-tabolism as a central node in cancer treatment adaptation, supporting lipid-targeted approaches to overcome drug resistance and improve therapeutic outcomes.
items.authors: Sukkum Ngullie Chang, Chiara Raggi, Vernat Exil
items.title_zh: 癌症药物耐药中的脂质代谢重编程机制与治疗机会
items.summary_zh: 癌症是全球主要死亡原因之一，药物耐药性严重阻碍治疗效果。越来越多的证据表明，代谢重编程使癌细胞能够适应治疗压力并存活。本文探讨了脂质代谢与药物耐药之间的相互作用，分析了脂质摄取、合成、储存和利用的变化如何促进癌细胞的存活与适应。重点关注脂肪酸、磷脂、胆固醇及脂质氧化，及其重编程对细胞信号传导、膜组成、能量产生、氧化应激和肿瘤微环境相互作用的影响。我们讨论了针对新生脂肪生成、胆固醇代谢、脂肪酸氧化、脂质摄取与储存、神经酰胺信号传导及铁死亡/脂质过氧化的药物策略，以恢复药物敏感性。此外，微小RNA（miRNA）在调控脂质代谢途径和促进治疗耐药中的作用也被探讨。总之，我们强调脂质代谢重编程作为一种协调的适应网络。

items.title: The Ethics of Testimony Under Epistemic Violence: Contemporary Iraqi and American War Narratives ( em Frankenstein in Baghdad /em and em The Yellow Birds /em as Case Studies)
items.abstract: This study provides an exhaustive contrapuntal analysis of the narrative representations of collective trauma, ontological disruption, and identity fragmentation arising from the 2003 Anglo- American invasion of Iraq. By setting Ahmed Saadawi’s novel Frankenstein in Baghdad (2013) into direct textual confrontation with Kevin Powers’s war novel The Yellow Birds (2012), the paper interrogates the structural "crisis of testimony"—the fundamental breakdown of established linguistic, symbolic, and narrative frameworks when confronted with industrialized destruction and existential terror. Mobilizing the conceptual paradigms of contemporary trauma studies (Cathy Caruth, Elaine Scarry), Giorgio Agamben’s ontology of the remnant and the impossible witness, Judith Butler’s critique of differential grievability, Edward Said’s contrapuntal methodology, and Gayatri Spivak’s interrogation of subaltern articulation, this paper traces how literary form registers historical catastrophe. The analysis demonstrates that while Saadawi constructs a monstrous, palimpsestic assemblage of severed somatic remains (the Whatsitsname) to allegorize the violent collapse of sectarian purity and national integrity through the aesthetic mechanisms of satirical abjection and dirty realism, Powers resorts to a high-modernist, elegiac lyricism that interiorizes catastrophic violence, effectively converting structural imperial conquest into an individualized narrative of moral injury. This paper argues that this literary encounter yields no reciprocal cross- cultural reconciliation; rather, it documents an unbridgeable epistemic rupture wherein the occupying power exercises the geopolitical privilege of psychic retreat, clinical recuperation, and historical amnesia, while the occupied population remains permanently tethered to ontological precarity, somatic mourning, and the perpetual labor of surviving amidst persistent ruins.
items.authors: Tara Khaled

items.title: Fragmented Networks, Detoured Access: A Nationwide Graph-Theoretic Analysis of Forest Road Connectivity in the Republic of Korea
items.abstract: Forest road networks are almost universally characterised by road density alone, which says nothing about how the roads are arranged. We assembled the 2025 national forest road network of the Republic of Korea (14,007 routes; 25,958 km) with the 1:5000 national road centreline layer into a weighted graph and analysed it with graph-theoretic connectivity indices, centrality and two measures of circuity. Considered alone, the registered forest road system is a disconnected network of 4742 components in which circuitry is close to absent. Public roads bring 96.0% of forest road length into one connected component, almost entirely through minor and unclassified roads, so the system is functionally connected; the quality of that connection is what is measured here. Route-level circuity averaged 1.574 (95% CI 1.568–1.579), whereas the median of the individual circuity ratios between adjacent components was 2.92 (2.82–3.06). The median straight-line gap was 708 m and the median network distance 3002 m, separate medians that need not describe the same pair. Ridge height accounts for part of that variation (Spearman +0.37) but not all of it. Assuming the statutory 10% grade ceiling, the geometrically estimated length of a connecting link was shorter than the existing network path for most adjacent pairs; the estimate is geometric and is not an alignment design. Two-thirds of pairs already lie closer together than half the spacing implied by the national density, so connectivity is a second planning criterion alongside density rather than a substitute for it.
items.authors: Sung-Min Choi

items.title: Study on the Flow Field Characteristics in a Six-Strand Tundish Under Different Baffle Walls with Hydraulic Experiments and Numerical Simulations
items.abstract: Flow characteristics constitute a fundamental factor governing the metallurgical performance of a tundish. The flow behavior of molten steel directly determines the floating removal efficiency of inclusions, the occurrence of slag entrainment, and the uniformity of flow distribution among multiple strands, which ultimately exerts a decisive influence on the quality of the final cast slab. The core objective of flow control device design is precisely to regulate tundish flow characteristics to meet metallurgical requirements. This work investigates the design of flow control devices for multi-strand tundishes and adopts a combined research scheme of numerical simulation and hydraulic physical experiment to systematically analyze the influence of the internal porous baffle structure on the flow characteristics of the tundish. The research indicates that the two research methods have complementary advantages: hydraulic physical simulation can obtain refined flow field information, while numerical simulation can intuitively capture the distribution rules of temperature field and overall flow pattern. The introduction of flow control devices with a porous baffle structure into the tundish can induce more directional circulating flow in the casting region, thereby effectively suppressing the occurrence of short-circuit flow. The regulation effect of different porous baffle schemes on tundish flow is essentially determined by the diameter and arrangement position of the openings on the baffle. In this study, both U-shaped and V-shaped baffles were adopted to reconstruct the internal flow structure of the six-strand tundish by adjusting the direction of the inlet jet and the distribution path of molten steel, which provides a fundamental reference for improving the flow consistency among different strands of the tundish.
items.authors: Yinbo Zhao, Rihan Su, Fulei Guo, Shikai Zhou, Yazhu Zhang, Jun Huang
